reviews.b: Even the free version is easy to use and as customizable as I needed. Very helpful to keep track of my symptoms so I can work with my doctor better as I recover from diverticulitis
Helpful keeping track of moods, eating, and bowel movements.

I downloaded the app to keep track of what I eat as it relates to my bowel movements and this app makes it easy to do just that! I love the notifications option to get reminders to update because I tend to forget.
This app is really helping me manage my ibs symptoms as a teen. It doesn’t try to give solution and gives you the perfect amount of options to track your symptoms with, even with the free version
Bowelle has been helpful for navigating SIBO and Leaky Gut and understanding food triggers

Bowelle really lets you build your own tracker. I use it for a different stomach condition and it lets me build the data I need. I am also able to include other health data, such as heart rate variability, and three or four different ways of tracking the same thing (e.g., sleep, for which I have a number (hours), another number (quality), my personal tags to find patterns, free narrative for any detail).

Have used this app for years, through I had bad IBS then GICovid.
Easy customization and export options—other apps should take note.
A responsive dev keeps it fresh — with no ads, nags, or sale of your app data.
Highly recommend.

reviews.t: Kind developer, good app, but requires $18 :(
reviews.b:
EDIT: the developer has responded and appears to be a kind person. I did not expect a personal response let alone the kind words and honesty. I am updating my rating to 4/5 instead of 1/5. 

I did not know the developer originally paid out of pocket. That is actually really cool of them. 

My only complaint now is not being able to even put one custom tag or have the option to have a version that shows ads and maybe a couple of features. However, it is clear to me now that it likely is not that simple.

The app still is great. It really is. And the developer appears kind. Thoughtful. 

I am leaving my original review below for context but I wanted to update the rating, title, and review itself since the developer responded in a kind, personal, no BS way. 

——————————-
Original review before response and context given by the developer:

6 years ago, when i got diagnosed with Crohn’s disease on my 20th birthday, this is the app i was recommended. 

It was so helpful. And EVERYTHING was free.

Now, 6 years later, you have to pay $18/yr to even place helpful description tags to track your patterns. 

18$ isn’t insane, no. But to make an app that has not appeared even aesthetically to have changed in 6 YEARS and start charging CHRONICALLY ILL PEOPLE $18/YR JUST BECAUSE THEY CAN is GROSS. It is GREEDY.

Most of us suffer almost on a daily basis. Many of us cannot afford the specialized medications let alone health insurance. Many of us will have to have surgical intervention, potential removal of organs, and possibly permanent ostomies placed. A removal of your butt hole because it is not longer functional and more of a problem at that point. I know because i am an operational room nurse . I’ve seen these surgeries. 

To ask sick people. To ask sick people who already suffer constantly who just want an easier way to track their body is so sick. I’m literally crying. I hate this world so much. I hate this greed.

Graphs

The app is good but the line graph is lacking. It only shows days with bowel movements and does not show days with no movements. This results in a straight line graph which is of no help
I’ve been trying to comply with a tracking app for years. Finally something low fiction enough to use every day

I can’t believe I haven’t done a review on this app. It’s amazing. I’ve been using this app since 2023 to help me figure out my GI issues and it’s been real helpful to keep track of my journey and to look back historically. It’s easy to use and pretty straightforward. Will be getting the premium version.
Simple but well designed and easy to navigate. Also able to customize a few things on the free version.
I’m documenting symptoms for gastroenteritis and this makes it much easier! I especially appreciate how it syncs with other apps I already use for water intake, etc.

This app has helped me a ton as I recover from PI-IBS! The interface is easy to use and I like that you can control how to input data, like on a scale, text, or tags. It’s helped me mentally to feel more organized and less stressed
I love the ease of logging the basics so I can look at trends over time with my dr.

Very simple and elegant app that has all the basics and a reasonable price for the premium level.  So much better than the competitors that pile on useless “features “ and then charge a ridiculous cost.

Using this to track my headaches, reflux, supragastric belches and lightheadedness. It’s also really good as a food diary. Heads up to new users, you get one free custom section so use text. Overall pretty good and easy to use. I like that it has timestamps
Love the app! I have colitis and it helps me track my flares and trigger foods. Wish it had a little more nuance in the stool scale tho.
Careful with the subscription service . Three years ago this would have been a one time reasonable fee. Realized this was a subscription way too late
This app is really helpful for my motility issues. I can track the information and have a data chart ready to share with my doc♥️

Nothing ever changes. Ever. No progress. No updates. Just take my money and do nothing to earn it.

I have asked repeatedly for the ability to scroll back on a graph instead of choosing 180 days and hoping to be able to click on a certain day. I have been told they will be implementing this in an update. I have been told that over and over for months. It is never implemented. 

Seeing the entire graph at once I basically useless. Contacting the developer is also, it seems, basically useless. They promise and do not deliver.

A thirty, ninety and 180-day graph is nice, but essentially useless. 

IMPLEMENT SCROLLING!!! It cannot be all that hard. 

It might be time to switch to a different app. I am tired of the lack of response.
I’ve been using this app for 4 years. It’s super easy to use, it’s convenient to scroll through BM history, and I absolutely love having the 7-day average for telling my GI at appointments.
I love this app, very useful and intuitive.
I’ve been using for years. My favorite app ever!

This app is a helpful tool. I am sure it would be even more helpful if I paid for premium, however out of all the free IBS tracker apps this one seems the best. I love how you can also rate your stress since stress affects your stomach as well as what you are eating and how you feel. I wish they had a few more symptoms listed or a note area for the free customers but I get it - if I want that do can pay for it. All and all I would highly recommend.
It is a very thoughtfully executed tracker, with modular elements.  Exactly what I needed.  Well done!

reviews.t: So helpful for the IBS girlies
reviews.b: I’ve had stomach issues my whole life. Using this app has helped me realize what can potentially cause my IBS. I also use it when i visit my gastro to better analyze my data.
Excellent App for people suffering from digestive issues/ disorders and wanting an effective way to communicate with their Dr. My Dr was impressed, she loved it.

I love this tracker. Easy to use and personalize. And when I thought there was a bug in the program and requested support I got very fast, one-on-one support. Turned out I was reading the report incorrectly and the info I thought was missing was there all along
As a person who is trying to be more mindful of what I eat, and how frequent I go this is the perfect tool for me. Easy to use and love that it's free!!!

I have constipation issues and need to track my BM’s to make sure I’m not going way too long before intervention. I was doing it in my head but I also needed to start tracking my  Food and other things. This is so easy nd convenient and even reminds me to track if it gets late in the day. I love it.
Shuts down for no reason when in the middle of adding data

reviews.t: Easy to use to track patterns
reviews.b: This is a great app if you’re just trying to track patterns and make it easy to use. Highly recommend.
Easy to use. I sent 6 weeks of data to ChatGBT to look for patterns and it liked the format. And, I got good feedback.
I think I had previously stated in a review that I wish it had time stamps for the food entries but it actually does I just didn’t notice until today.
This application is good since it helps me see my triggers and helps me better choices…

reviews.t: Great to keep track of BM
reviews.b: I love this app because I suffer from IBS-C. There are times where I haven’t had a BM for 16 days. It makes you feel really bad and you don’t want to move or eat and it is not healthy at all. With this app I can make sure that I don’t go more than 7 days without having a BM. I can keep track of the consistency and timing of my last BM and make sure that I don’t end up dying because I haven’t had a BM

Over the years I have used app after app in the pursuit of finding one that met my needs and worked the way I wanted it to. Something easy to use and quick to enter my meal and BM information without being cumbersome. THIS ONE IS IT. I cannot say enough good things. I am so thankful that I stumbled upon this app. It’s exactly what I have been looking for. I will say that maybe entering notes should be in its own section rather than being grouped and hidden in the “what have you eaten” section. Or perhaps the section should be worded differently because as it is now it isn’t logical, but for the most part this app is damn near flawless. 5 out of 5 stars.

reviews.t: It’s a good database, but not much more
reviews.b:
I find the app easy to use. It is well laid out, easy to navigate and easy to add custom fields/tags.  

The reports do a good job laying everything out, however I expected a bit more ‘intelligence’ from the app.  I was looking for some sort of correlations listed for types of food eaten and times and how they line up with my BMs and the details of the BMs.  

I’m sure we are all different, however my triggers are not immediate.  I’m finding that they are often from the day before, or at least a meal or two before.  The app lays all of your inputs out nice and neat, however you have to do your own sleuthing to figure out triggers and timings.  

Maybe my expectations were just too high.
The graphs/ data is simplified so far (e.g. not even axis labels on compound views) that it’s impossible to glean any insights from the data.
App is simple and i enjoy that quality about it . Sometimes it’s nice to have catchy fun apps to track things but for IBS i enjoy the simplicity.

1. Everywhere you show the date, please show the day of week as well. I forget to enter things sometimes. When I go back to fix things up, I think of the day of week, not the date. 
2. In History, all entries with times should be shown in time order and not separated by category - BMs and food should be listed all together. This would make it easier to see if what’s eaten is having an effect on BMs
3. If you use the time control to enter a time for meals, the text afterward is smaller than it should be. You have to close that entry and reopen it to see the normal size text.

I was looking for a way to keep track of my foods to help with ID’ing possible gut triggers. Bowelle is doing that, plus enabling me to see my daily history at a glance. I’ll either use it myself or share it with a dietitian if I decide to work with one. I’m very glad I found the Bowelle app!

I’ve been using Bowelle for 2 weeks now. I’m able to store everything I eat for the day, track bowel movements, water intake, and created fields for BP.
The notes function allows me to document stressors to rule out food as contributing to IBS.
This is an AMAZING app and you don’t have to pay for any modifications.

I don’t have IBS, but I do have another chronic intestinal issue. This app is so simple and straightforward, very user-friendly. The free version has the basics I need, but there are a few other things I want to track as well, so I plan to upgrade to a subscription. I recommend this app.

This is app is AMAZING for tracking bowel movements and what you eat. I use this app to track the food I eat, bowel movements, and how much MiraLAX I have. It allows you to look at your history of your meals and everything you tracked each day! It is amazing! If you are looking for an app to track those things to show a doctor for an issue you have been having, I definitely recommend!
I like this app because helps me remember what I ate and how much I used the restroom.
Pretty good for being free!! Super easy to track, and of course with the paid option you can be more specific, but honestly the free version works amazingly too!
I find it performs its essential functions well. Felt no impulse to upgrade to the paid plan.

reviews.t: Helps track BM while working through health issues
reviews.b: This app helps me see data that is critical to my health journey. It’s so convenient and easy to use.
This app is really great for tracking my colitis symptoms and my reaction to foods and treatments. Simple layout. Very easy to add custom things to track.

reviews.t: I’m so impressed with this app
reviews.b: I have IBS-C, and need help tracking triggers, symptoms, and attacks, and this app has been great for that. What really makes the most difference to me is how customizable the app is, and how intuitive and easy to use the features are. Very well done!
Helps me track my IBS symptoms.  The free version is great.  I’ve used the paid version too.  Both are simple to navigate.
Awesome app would recommend
I used to keep track of my symptoms and food in my notes app but this has made it a lot easier to keep track of. I like how it tracks pretty much everything that affects IBS issues. Very helpful!

reviews.t: Great app I have been looking for
reviews.b: This app is amazing! I have IBS and this helps me track my meals and my bowel movements. I also like that I can send a report to my nutritionist!
It really helps me track what causes my stomach issues because I have chrones. I just wish it would allow me to add more options to put for free.

not what i expected. doesn't change meals or days easily. 
inflexible design.

reviews.t: Simple, easy way to track data
reviews.b: Simple way to track food, movements, stress and other data to either share with GI doctors or reference yourself to id triggers and other factors.  Can add your own custom fields (ex exercise) to collect more info that is relevant to you.   No ads, easy to use.

I am horrible of keeping track of the things that are important, Bowelle has been helping me tremendously. 
It’s super simple, which I prefer, I haven’t gotten any ads, nor have I been asked to purchase anything. This app helps me record what I eat, when I eat, and that has been helping me with figuring out what triggers my stomach issues.
A nice simple tracker. I use the free version and have been able to consistently track my food and bowel movements without giving up on it. It’s user friendly and easy to navigate.

My doctor wanted me to track my bowel movements, and I just hadn’t found the right way to stay consistent and also have such valuable data. This app has been a godsend. It doesn’t feel like a burden and I love the customization — I’ve added in criteria like gas and amount of hours slept, too.
Good app. Easy to use and read. Tracking is simple which is nice.

The free version of the app is exactly what I needed. If you want more out of your app, by all means go premium, but just logging the basics of my movements each day has brought a lot of peace of mind. Love it!
All this app does is track in a fancy way. You can do the same thing in any app or the apple notes. Not worth paying any money for
I’ve been using the free version for less than a week. Easy to use! I’m not sure how it’ll work for identifying trigger foods but that will take time.
I have IBS and GERD so Bowelle helps me track my digestive issues, food and bowel habits. Easy to use and glad to have room for notes.

The app can be used without needing to create an account, which is good, but it lacks many features needed to keep up with symptoms and health. There is no diary or way to enter medications you’ve taken, or to log additional info. You can create a custom field, but I don’t use an app to have to do the work myself.
I have IBS (Constipation) and it’s very helpful for tracking down my bowel movements. I haven’t had it for a long time but maybe it’ll help me understand what I need to eat to be regular!

reviews.t: it’s a good app but could use more features
reviews.b:
what i really want is to be able for this app to provide me a list of foods based on my inputs that cause discomfort or toilet issues. 
i get that you can search by type of movement etc, but that is too manual for me. it means i have to scroll through all my responses and filter out the highest incidences of food types. 
why not show me a word cloud or a graph of which items (vegetables, dairy, spice, etc) cause discomfort based on my history? 
if not, this app doesn’t do much more than a paper diary. i dont mind paying for this support, but from what i could see, this isn’t a feature of “premium” either,

This app is so simple and easy to use, I highly recommend.
You can even create custom options to track.
Love the simplicity of the app layout. It’s visually appealing and makes the platform easy to use

Needed something for easy tracking of meals and bowel movements while I figure out some health and GI issues. This app has been awesome! It’s quick to use, simple, but flexible enough to customize it to my needs. I highly recommend it!
This app has everything I need to be able to track and share with my gastroenterologist for my IBS. It is so easy to use compared to other apps I have  tried.

This app is making it so easy to keep track of what’s going on in my digestive system… What I’m eating and how it might be affecting me. I decided to pay for the premium, and I’m so glad that I did. It’s nice to be able to run reports and having all of the information to share with my functional nutritionist.

When you have a lot of health conditions that mess with your daily life, it’s so helpful to have an app like this to track your health. Between IBS and medications that mess with my stomach, it’s been nice to have this app to track movements to ensure I don’t go too long without having one. Great way to store data and share with your doctor when you need to.

reviews.t: Only one week in and really enjoying this app and how much it’s helped me already
reviews.b: I’ve struggled with various gut issues, mainly bloating, for literal years. Years and years! And I’ve done food journals in the past, but it’s a burden to carry around a physical journal, so I’ve tried many apps to help. I lost interest in navigating their clunky designs after about 2 days, and always struggled to get a good historical view of all my entries anyway, so what was the point?? Not with Bowelle! I actually look forward to entering in what I eat and how I feel, and the historical view is *awesome! Only used for about two weeks now, but met with a doc and could very quickly, succinctly review my food journal and find a potential trigger straight away. Will definitely be a daily user of this app!!
This is really helping me keep track, so I have documented info when I go to my digestive specialist.
Trying to figure out my gut and food issues. This app is so easy and convenient. Will give me valuable insights at my next doctor appointment.

reviews.t: The app that you didn’t know you needed in life
reviews.b: This app is really good because tracking things helps not only easing your mind, but also but also helps you keep track of ur health in the platform to better communicate those things with your doctor. It’s easy to use and easy to edit as needed.
Great tracking app. Simple to use and allows for great customizations.

reviews.t: Please make it possible to save multiple profiles!
reviews.b: I love this app. It’s the only all in one app I’ve found (I had 2 different apps before this one for BM tracker and food journal). With this app, I can put it all in one place. Would be super helpful to have multiple profiles (even if just offered with a subscription). I have Crohn’s and for the first time my daughter is experiencing the same symptoms but I have to download 2 other apps to keep track of her so adding multiple profiles would really help households with IBS/IBD.
It lets me keep track of when I go to the bathroom. If I forget when I went I can go into history and I can see when I went last. Keep up with the good work.

I’ve started using this app to track my triggers and symptoms and foods I’ve eaten to help identify unknown triggers and it’s actually been pretty awesome, thanks to God! They have a free version, unlike other ones and it allows me to be able to use it without paying first and the premium subscription just has the same stuff but more options so it’s actually not even different from the regular and can be used completely without it. I highly recommend if you’re looking for a food diary app or something to identify your triggers.

I am a woman with lots of different symptoms when it comes to that time of month. Bowell has made it so I can keep track of when I go to the bathroom to help monitor my symptoms, so I don’t have to spend extra time and effort to keep track myself. I would highly recommend for those girlies like me when it gets extra crazy around that time of month!! I also like how the apps reminds me when I haven’t input a bowel movement. Let’s me know when i’m extra constipated. :)
I’m having chronic constipation from Zepbound this is great app to keep track of how things are going and what I take for laxatives
Helps you keep track of anything that could cause stomach/digestive upset. Easily customizable.

I’ve tried a few different apps now for symptom tracking and like this one the most. Weirdly, the thing I think I love about it is that you can only complicate it so much. It just makes tracking easy. And the premium version is really reasonable. You honestly don’t even need it if you want to keep it simple, though.

I feel like I could have made a better layout for an app. But this one does the trick. I’ve downloaded a lot of trackers to see which one I liked the best, and by far this is the one I liked. It connects to the Apple health app, and looks nice with a modern style. Other apps are too silly, I didn’t like how the calendars looked and the logging system. But this one was good.

I looked and looked for a good app to record my bowl movements, the distention of my stomach and other issues. 

I LOVE that you can make all kinds of notes, add stuff into the sections. I added in next to bowl distention. No other app lets you customize like this one. It is the best download I have made in awhile.
Makes tracking SO easy because of all the options they have.
It’s so simple and easy to use! I use it everyday to track how I’m feeling along with the other features. Definitely recommend this app!
I have ulcerative colitis and this app has helped me keep track of my symptoms and my medications. I also show it to my doctor to help adjust medications when needed.
Portability could be better if it could link devices. I work with my iPad at home, it’s easy to see and type on. iPhone at work, Iwatch all the time.

As someone who has been diagnosed with ulcerative colitis for over 15 years and have had chronic constipation since infancy, I go in crazy cycles of having up to 20+ bowl movements a days and then on the flip side can go 20+ days without very productive bowl movements. This app is making it so easy for me to track when I go and how many times a day, plus the added feature of urgency/mucus/blood/discomfort is very helpful for me as I experience those often with a UC flare. I highly recommend this app to fellow IBD warriors!

reviews.t: Easy to use and straight to the point
reviews.b: As it says in the title

reviews.t: Really simple way to track IBS
reviews.b: This app is super simple and helpful. The free version does the trick and covers all bases.
Does not track all information.
Great use for the basics, I bet you could get a lot better use from the paid version but you definitely don’t need to use it, and you can still see a chart of your basic stats
Love the note feature.

reviews.t: A great simple to use comprehensive tracker
reviews.b: Best tracker I’ve come across. Full of features, entry options, … yet easy to use and learn. I’m one week in. Happy, very!
Good app with good features, $18 is steep for a premium membership for some features that should just come with.

I got a new phone. Wanted to track data. Everything should be connected to your apple account, right? lol, nope. I see no point in keeping this if its usefulness is illusory at best. Data should be easily transferable but I guess they wanted to paywall that.
Bowelle is such a good app. I can't have dairy but my mom is gonna find me a allergist cuz it gets worse and worse. This app helps me keep track of what I eat and I love ittttt!! ♡♡

reviews.t: I don’t have IBS but this has helped so much!
reviews.b: I’m barely 20 and I have abnormally high cholesterol, which no one ever tested for until now. I know my diet isn’t that bad, but this app has helped me track everything I want to track and more in one place instead of using several apps (which would make me give up within a week). It’s so easy to use, and the free version is perfect even though I might upgrade just for the perks.

Downloaded last week due to a new chronic diagnosis that requires a new diet. Really great way to track meals and water that doesn’t make you feel like you’re “counting” and falling into diet culture. It’s also minimal in questions so it doesn’t feel overwhelming to answer the questions on a daily basis, effective in tracking mood, stress level and intake/bowel movements. I’m learning so much about myself!

Very User friendly!  
Nice and easy features.
Love that this is an app focused on recorded diet and behavior rather than tracking calories or recording weight.
This app is great. I love the features and it tracks everything I need it to and more!
i like the user interface for the most part. i wish the answer options were less vague and the customized tags/lists had more examples.
Using free version. Would love to see added features to track gas and medications (e.g., when Imodium AD taken).
This app is easy to use and provides data in useful ways. I have multiple gut-related diagnoses and Bowelle has been a helpful way to track ups and downs in my gut health.
Great app for people with IBS & IBD, so used to help track symptoms and trigger foods. I highly recommend to anyone with digestive issues. Also somewhat customizable which is such an awesome bonus
Great simple tracker for food and mood, not just bowl movements
Love this app, feels really great seeing activity over a period of time. Really provides insight. Thank you!!!!

This is the easy logging of food, Bow, habits, attitude, etc., that I’ve ever used. The best thing about it is after a week or so it starts summarizing everything and gives you a percentage of your past history. I have specially like where you can adjust the time if you can’t get to your app right away to log.
From a person who has IBS this is so helpful to tell my doctor how many bowel movements I’ve had

As an ibs sufferer, this has been my go to app. It really helps when I’m experiencing constipation so I can keep track of when and how often I have a bowel movement. Plus I can see what type of foods help to encourage it. On the other hand, if I’m having diarrhea, it helps me recognize trigger foods and things to decrease or stop. I really love this app!

I can’t praise this app enough for being very simple and beautiful and practical to use. A lot of apps always look to busy even with ads, but this app is perfect for going in and out to log EXACTLY what I need to and nothing else. I love the feature to add your own categories and you can even extract a report. Built-in photo log too? Absolute score. This app is everything I needed and more! Thank you, thank you, thank you app developers ☺️
Track down triggers of IBS

I suffer from IBS so this tracker really helps me understand what could be happening within my digestive tract. 

It gives options to describe what comes out too so that you can remember incase I need to tell my doctors etc. It’s basically like logging your logs… (pun intended) 

Due to my condition, I sometimes literally just forget to go so the app also helps remind me how many days since I last went. 

There’s really no ads on this app which I’m thankful for too.

reviews.t: Love this app and easy to use
reviews.b: It is the perfect app to manage IBD symptoms. THANK YOU!
Great app!! Recommended!!
Great app easy to use and track so I can give info to my dr.
It is helping me keep track of my new GF Dairy Free Diet
Easy to use

For what I needed this app for it does the job quite handsomely. I do recommend this app for those ones going through digestive issues and want to have something to go on before visiting the doctor so the doctor is better able to assist.

I have been looking for a good food tracker app for a long time. I don’t suffer from IBS but I do have fibromyalgia and Hashimotos and have flare ups of body pain, fatigue mostly, with the occasional stomach issues (usually heartburn). Every other food diary I’ve found is geared toward weight loss and it’s so annoying. I want to track how I feel, not calories. 

I knew this app was geared toward IBS so I wasn’t sure it would be perfect for me. But since the paid version allows you to add your own custom categories it’s been great. I’m currently tracking energy levels, heart burn, pain levels, and medications on top of the standard categories it comes with.  

Its easy to use and convenient, and I’m hopeful I’ll stick with it much more consistently than any other food diary I’ve tried

Was looking for a food/mood/notes diary that is user friendly and straight to the point.  This is exceeding my expectations!  Never left a review for an app but the developer deserves so much credit, I’ve been telling everyone about this app!  The free version itself is mind blowing, I am debating to upgrade to premium.  The little food section allows for a time clockin with a touch of a button - and don’t feel like writing out what you ate? - instantly take a photo and it inserts into the comment box.  Wow!  Great job, couldn’t think of a better way to create this.  High five excellent work!!

My daughter is having tummy troubles and her pediatrician asked that we keep track of her food intake, bowels, and when she complains. This helps me do just that without any annoying ads or other unnecessary things. Thank you, from a mom who really needed help!
This app is helping me determine what I can eat. I have EPI newly diagnosed and it is a learning curve. Bowell is a life saver.
Every day I’m shocked that this app is free. It has been super helpful tracking my Ibs journey and trying to figure out the health of my body.

I have just got diagnosed with hiatal hernia, GERD and IBS. Trying to figure out my triggers and my baseline this app is SO helpful! Haven’t yet decided if I want to pay for it but the free functions are still great.
Super user friendly and I like all the options. It’s customizable too
This really helped me keep track of my IBS highly recommend!
I got this app at the beginning of the year and have incorporated it into my daily routine. I like the visuals and easy to use format.
I love how user friendly this app is and how organized

I’ve been looking for an app like this for so long I literally gave up. I tried so many things like journals, using my notes app, trying to make other apps work but nothing ever stuck because nothing was as simple as Bowelle. I love that you can customize your own sections. I don’t even have IBS, I just wanted to track different things due to hormone imbalance and food sensitivities. This app honestly should be marketed to more than just people with IBS. So many people could find this app useful! It goes without saying I HIGHLY recommend!
So easy to use and helps me track so easily
The app is very easy to use and is user friendly. The different sections have all the fields you need and the ability to customize fields makes it easy to make the app work best for the user.

This is seriously the best app I’ve used to track everything (food, water, symptoms). The report is helpful and history makes it easy to look at all of the data in a list. Plus being able to go back into the calendar to see specific days.
Very helpful tracking bowel movements for people with digestive issues
I can track just about anything regarding my health on this ap. Mood, weight, bowels, food and water, symptoms, exercise sleep and notes on anything of interest. This is honestly a very helpful tool.
I keep trying to add to notes and every attempt has failed. What do I do?
Great app. Beautiful designed and easy to use.

reviews.t: Great for IBD to find triggers
reviews.b: Loving this app. Really helping me
Great app. Don’t know what I’d do without it!

I have been using this app for several years now.  With a long history of IBS and irregular gut issues, I wanted to track bowel events and note patterns.
This app allows you to track bowel events, write notes, track food, mood, and stress.  Doing all this can reveal correlations that can reduce symptoms.  Making changes can then be correlated to reveal success.  So using this app allows for experiments to see results.
On the other hand, you can choose to track only what you wish.  
The owner is very amenable to feedback.  I wasn’t able to record the events in real time and requested a way to record after the fact.  The owner created a method to do that.  I’ve been meaning to write a positive review ever since.  Finally!  Grateful for this very easy-to-use app that is so valuable to me!
I like this app, easy way to track multiple things regarding health that is straightforward and not super distracting/hard to understand. Thank god for no ads.
Great app, helps me keep track of what I eat!

I’ve tried several other apps like Bowelle and was really unhappy with the data gathering. I have found Bowelle to be the best app available for this. I can track all my food intake and symptoms and it summarizes it so succinctly, and also allows you to see a full picture and history of your data, which helps a lot with transferring the data to my GI. 
I also really appreciate that I can create my own symptoms to track and tag them how I like. 
I ended up paying for the premium version of the app because it’s been so helpful.

Ive been using this app on and off dor a long time! I have IBS and was having a hard time pinpointing “trigger foods” being able to see how my bowel movements are depending on what I ate & stress was SO helpful. I mainly use it on my bad days now to see if theres a reoccurring issue with specific foods

I never write reviews actually. However, I’m very pleased with this app. I’ve recently started having medical issues with my stomach and wanted a good app to track what I’m eating and water/sleep amounts, etc. This app is really good considering they do not make you pay to use the basic features. Most apps will let you use it for minimal features or small amounts of time and then block you in with a subscription. I’m glad this app doesn’t do that. Hats off to the developers and the rest of the team behind this.
This has been great for a food journal and tracking GI symptoms

So far this has been a great app. I have no complaints. As someone with digestive problems I have tried a lot of apps and there is always some gotcha that I ended up deleting it. This app is clean and straightforward and you can tell a lot of thinking went into this. If something is missing you need it also gives you the option for custom fields which I like. This is an amazing app!
Very good app! Has everything that I need to properly track my IBS. Options to buy more customizations, but you get exactly what you need for free.
I’ve started having stomach problems and this is so helpful for me to track and see patterns of what is causing them and to show my doctor.
it got everything i was looking for plus more and it's free
This app has been very helpful for me. I really appreciate having a tool like this and recommend it for anyone!

This app is such an easy way to connect food, water, sleep, and all other biological functions to the way the gut and the bowels are functioning. Really easy to use! A useful way to track these habits all in one place.

I had tried to use this app a few years ago, but it wasn’t what I was looking for… I redownloaded it recently and love it. It’s simple, but pretty robust, and has the ability to customize enough without it being formless or ambiguous. Highly recommended!
Good for simple tracking, doesn’t take long :)
I needed to keep track of my bowel movements for my Dr, and this app works perfect!
Nice and simple way to keep track of what I eat and how it effects my body. I like that you can add your own categories too. It’s made it easy to see what I can eat and what I need to stay away from.

Perfect app I didn’t know I needed! 
Thank you!!
Could add a few things to make it better. But very helpful and easy to use. I use it every time I go to the bathroom and whenever I eat and it just takes a few seconds to a minute to do. Very good

I love this app, wish I didn’t need it, but it is awesome. It is easy to set up and intuitive to use. You can quickly get metrics and track how changes to mood, stress, food, whatever else is important to you is affecting your body. I highly recommend it to everyone.

I was spending so much time journaling and I downloaded at least 10 apps trying to find one that could track water intake and bathroom visits for my 4 year old son with special needs. Most apps were confusing, didn’t track both or were for newborns and not customizable. This app has everything I needed and more! I could add additional tracking such as (headaches, meds, and urine output!) and sharing with his therapist and doctors is so easy!
I love the ease of the app. Easy to use and can see my daily progress. I highly recommend.
The app is very user friendly. No complaints.

Overall, really easy and clean to use app that enables you to closely track what you’re eating, how many bowel movements you have, how you feel, your stress levels, and even your water intake! I also appreciate the graph feature, which helps observe possible trends. This is very helpful with keeping me on track with my daily water intake!

This app has really helped me track not only what I eat but also what could potentially be triggers for my IBS. Would absolutely recommend this to anyone looking to identify food triggers for their digestive issues

This is single-handedly the GREATEST tool to use for tracking your health. Whether you’re keeping a journal on what you eat, medication, bowel movements, sleep, work outs, pain levels, etc. 

I went through a major health battle recently, and this app has really helped me keep track of everything that’s important to me. 

It’s highly customizable. I primarily use it for tracking symptoms, medications and when I take them, meals, and bowel movements. You can be as thorough as you want within the app. It’s spectacular.
I’m having irregular bowel movements and my doctor asked me to keep a diary. Bowell lets me do that quickly and easily and prompts for exactly the info I need to keep track of! Love this app.

This app is pretty cool. Not only does it let you track your bathroom patterns , but there are tons  of other cool features well. I love the fact you can document your sleep patterns , meals, stress levels and more. You can even add pictures and times of your meals. There are customizable tags and categories you can add as well. It’s all neatly summarized on the “History” tab. It’s fun, functional and easy to use. Let’s face it , if any of us are here …it’s because we’re going through something that’s not too enjoyable . But this app makes it a little more pleasant to keep track of those things.  After getting the hang of it , I decided to pay the yearly fee because I can see it being something I use every day. 5 stars!
Having had stomach issues for the past 20 years I decided to try this app. It’s an easy way to track all the details regarding what you eat that affect your BM’s.
Helps keep track of symptoms. Similar to cycle tracking for women, this app helps you see trends. No issues with app crashing.
I have only used it just more than a week, works well simple to use and had the main things and you can customize it a bit and add more fields for other information if needed

reviews.t: Simple and easy daily check in
reviews.b: I like how you can customize the daily tasks to fit your needs!
It’s a simple easy to use excellent app.

I have been hospitalized three times in the last 12 weeks for partial Paul obstructions and decided to use this app to see what I was eating when I was having trouble and it is a blessing it is even doctor approved!
Half of gut health is what and how much comes out. Very important metric.

This app has been tremendous in helping me keep track of my food and my BMs and how things correlate. It’s easy, customizable, and I have found that it has made a huge difference in my daily routine. Highly recommend!

reviews.t: Great app for IBS and allergy sufferers
reviews.b: This is a great app for tracking food and symptoms. It’s very easy to use, and excellent output for analysis.
It’s exactly what i was looking for; something simple to track my bowel movements. Little tips or articles about gut health could be nice 👍🏻

reviews.t: Very helpful in dealing with incontinence
reviews.b: I am thankful to be using Bowelle. I’ve been suffering from incontinence for several years. This helps me track what I have eaten and what happens next. I appreciate the once nightly reminder I receive to complete my daily data. This app has helped me improve my situation.
You have to type everything in so there is no direct connection between what you ate and the response. What a waste of money

I have gotten into the habit of tracking these basic routines daily. It is very helpful for identifying patterns and serve as a reminder for me to be thoughtful about what I eat and the interaction between what I eat and how I feel.
Easy and quick!

This app has everything you need you can log food as complex or simplified as you want and you can add your own section of things to keep track of, it’s perfect if you struggle with stomach issues and are wanting to track it to see what the underlying issue might be. This is the app to get if you are looking for a good one!

reviews.t: Exactly what I was looking for
reviews.b: Simple and easy to use for tacking daily bowel movements.
Very helpful app and allows me to keep track of symptoms for my sickness and every day diet.

reviews.t: Good Combination Food, Water and BM Diary
reviews.b: I like this app. It provides a simple and customizable interface to record what goes in and what comes out of the user's body. It is good for identifying allergies and intolerances, and it generates helpful reports to avoid discomfort and promote wellness.

This app is really easy to use and has just the right prompts t help me track and monitor my symptoms. It allowed me to add a custom prompt for medicines, which will help me track what I’ve eaten that might be causing me the pain that leads to having to take medication. This is a really great tool for tracking your “gut health” and also helps keep you accountable for what you’re eating.
I mainly use this app to track IBS symptoms and triggers. The only thing that would make it better is to incorporate nutritional information (similar to MyFitnessPal) into the food tracking portion.

reviews.t: Hate that I love it so much
reviews.b: I never thought I’d need an app to track this part of my life, but this has been so helpful! Struggles with stomach issues for far too long and now I’m able to track back when I have an upset stomach! It’s easy to use and very helpful!

reviews.t: Great simple app for anyone with gut issue
reviews.b: Great app for tracking the food you eat and symptoms you may have.  Simple interface and good tracking.
Easy to use and a great app!! Really helps me understand what my body is doing.
Newly diagnosed with GERD & struggling to manage my symptoms & find safe foods. This app has been a lifesaver & gives me some semblance of control.

Stable, meaningful features, excellent UI/UX, very responsive Dev Mr. Gummerson. 

Bowelle brought back hope to my life. I don’t have IBS; spinal cord trauma affects my digestive/colon and entire thoracic area.

Bowelle can be used for limitless issues. 

Start small and add details over time. Doing so empowered me with information for MYSELF. Hopelessness has been replaced with community and validation. 

Thank you, Mr. Gummerson.
I’ve tried a few food diaries and symptom trackers over the last several years and none worked for me as well as this one.  Soo good!

I started app on iPad and wanted to sync to iPhone but it stops at  67%• I have enough storage. I have deleted app and reinstalled. I have searched the web for help but no luck. Unfortunately I have purchased a subscription and cannot cancel for a year.

reviews.t: Good app helps keep me accountable and easy to use.
reviews.b: It’s free and a great app have no complaints
Functional app
Nice app ,but have no attraction element
This app is very customizable and makes tracking health quick and easy. I’ve been using it for two months which is a record for me with such apps! Thanks Bowelle!

reviews.t: The app has everything I need.
reviews.b:
I was in need of a simple-to-use app for keeping track of my food intake and output. I’ve tried several other methods, and this one definitely does the best job.

Within a few moments, I can easily take any necessary notes and move on. When the time comes that I need to reference anything, all of my data is nearly presented in a graph with several filtering options.

Can’t really ask for anything better. Thanks for the awesome app!

The app offers up the right metrics to track and the design is easy to navigate

Tracking meals and other metrics can be a pain when you’re busy. This app makes it easy for me to jot down what I’m eating/drinking and make any notes quickly.

Haven’t tried the export function yet but I’m excited that it exists so I can have my doctor take a look if I keep having IBS issues.

I just recently really started focusing on gut heath and Bowelle not only helps me keep track of my “bm”s but also stress and sleep and I can see how all lifestyle factors interact with my gut, it’s been really great for giving a basic variety of information. I wish I could add more data and notes, but I only have the free version which covers a decent amount nonetheless.

I have been struggling with stomach problems since March and I’m still in and out of the hospital. Trying to figure out what’s wrong with me so now I can track all my food and certain things that make me feel sick and go back to days and see if I was sick those days it’s just amazing.

reviews.t: For a free app it is fabulous
reviews.b: Really great. Very easy to track stuff. Wish I could input more notes in other areas but overall very good.
Love this app. Helps me stay on track after taking medication.

reviews.t: Easiest Way To Keep a Food Diary for IBS
reviews.b: I recently just had to see a GI specialist and he wanted me to start a food diary. The task seemed a little daunting but this app has made all the difference!
I’m a combat veteran that battles IBS on a daily basis. This app tracking tool is wonderful and provides a detailed history of your bowel movements for record keeping purposes.
Helps me keep track of my system and stay on top of Crohn’s disease.
Allows me to gather information I can then share with my doctor. Very helpful in gathering information and detecting patterns.
Just a really easy way to journal how things are going if you have bowel problems without having to create a huge document in notes or carry an actual journal. Exactly what I was looking for

Bowelle works well for my purposes. It is very clean and pleasing to the eye. It’s pretty quick and easy to update with just a couple clicks - other than writing out the meals, but you can make shortcuts for common foods too. I used the free version at first - it is possible, however I’m tracking a few more things and had to use the notes feature to write all that down. The subscription was worth it for me to add all the custom trackers I wanted and reduce the text. I like the time feature that can be added to any text, like the meal descriptions.
Great app, easy to use, love that you can set a reminder in case you forget to enter anything for the day
I was looking for an easy to use app to track certain things and this app has everything I need.
Super easy to use, nice tracker. I did not have any problems while using the app.
This app one of my most frequently used. I track things from the moment I get up to before I go to bed. The support staff are really great!
Really helps me keep track of my water intake and correlations.

I was looking to keep track of different daily aspects of my health: meals, drinks, weight, and other custom conditions.
Ability to create filters and reports based on them and add a time of the day sold on the application.
Simple,  yet so helpful. It is worth paying the annual subscription. I use it every day and review trends every weekend.
I was feeling bad and I went to the ER and they recommended me a food and symptoms diary and this is exactly what I was looking for. Thank you
I have been dealing with a flare up of IBS for months. I tried to track my meals, meds and BM’s in a notebook but would forget to write things down. This app has made it way easier to track.
Keeps me organized !!
Very helpful app! I am easily able to track what I need to and see patterns. The information is helping me let my doctor know what is happening. I would highly recommend this app.
I use this in collaboration with my physician and nutritionist. I was able to convert to a Bristol scale. Worth every penny.

I have IBS with a history of bowel obstructions, so this app has been so helpful with tracking my bowel movements. I can look back to see trends/patterns that may be be related to what I ate. It’s been a great way to help me catch constipation before it’s an issue!
I’ve been using this to track my baby’s food allergies through my milk and it’s so user friendly! I love that I can use time stamps and add custom symptoms.
It tracks everything I hoped for and more. I bought the upgraded plan immediately because I was so impressed and it's so reasonable. The features are great, the layout is nice and smooth, great app.
Decent app
It’s helping me figure out why my stomach keeps hurting!

reviews.t: The app I didn’t know I needed!
reviews.b: I’m not one to review apps very often but this one is warranted. I started using it 4 days ago to track various aspects of my IBS-c and I gotta say it’s one of the easiest, well designed health apps I’ve ever used. The ability to customize is so helpful! I have exactly the areas I want to track at my fingertips and it’s just so user friendly. Looking forward to seeing my results/report in 10 days.

Love this app, ever since my ulcertive colitis came on I’ve been having trouble keeping track of what my body can digest easily or not. This app is making it so much easier to remember what I ate and things in my life so I can live my best life and not feel like crap half the time and not remembering what I ate. Thanks Bowelle for this awesome free app!
Interface is easy, reports are useful. I started using this app more and more for things to track rather than other apps because it is so easy.

Chronic pain equals pain medication and pain medication equals constipation. This is not only perfect for tracking bowel movement times and types, but its also great for food sensitivity tracking. Easy to use, great app!
It’s worth the $15, wish they had only a one time fee instead of yearly fee
this app helps me track my symptoms, put in my own symptoms, and rlly rlly helped me
Easy to use and wonderful tracking system!
Great app, I love how it gives you a report of your tracking, but I think it needs a little bit more free things. But I’m total it’s really good for IBD and IBS tracking
like the app for IBS
Best for record keeping. I find this app easy to use. I especially liked the flexibility to adjust to my personal schedule and needs.

This is helping me work with my nutritionist and monitor my eating habits. Very good app, easy to use.   

I tried to email the report but that didn’t work. I wonder if it’s because i’m not paying? Either way this app is good i’ll just screen shot my history and send it to the nutritionist.
Simple and easy to use. Logging with this app helps me find patterns for my ibs.

reviews.t: Very good app; wish it were available on Android as well
reviews.b:
App does its job well.  It would be nice if they provided more info on the mysterious “Premium” version.  Yeah, it gives more custom fields.  Is that it?  Is it just to support the devs?  That’s a fine thing to do - but let us know!
I have several Android devices, but only one IOS device, so using Bowelle is more awkward because I must use it on one particular device.  But the app is valuable enough that that doesn’t seem to be a showstopper.  Thanks for the app!
Just wish there was an easier way to compare and contrast the data points and food, some way to make it a chart with the foood and symptoms you put
Best app I’ve used.  Wish I could add time of day for all types of custom activities.
Great simple tracker

This app is amazing 
Very easy to use and it has been a asset to me improving my life!
It’s simple enough for me to keep up on it but allows customization for my specific issues. Love it!

This is the BEST APP!!! It’s quick and easy because usually you always have your phone close by. Just with a couple clicks and you have all the information you and your doctors need for each visit. Plus you can go through and see what foods may give you problems. I was journaling for my doctor and it took forever!! Please give this a try I promise you won’t regret it. 😃😃😃

I happen to find this app at a time when i was very ill with stomach pain, bloating, weight gain, IBS symptoms and no appetite.  I had gone to the GI Dr finally after waiting a while since its a speciality Dr and he told me to delete this app asap.  He was more of a stop thinking about it - type personality.   I, on the other hand find the app so easy to use and a great track.  I especially love the stress level history.   I am waiting to see the history trend.  Apparently you need to be in the app for 6 days.   I’m also thrilled there is no cost for the free portion. 
Get it.. if your thinking about it.
I’m really getting an understanding of what I’m eating and a better time line of how often I go or things react.
Cool app. Does what it is designed to do.
Very nice to have an app to track this. It’s easy to use and is able to track what I need it to!
I have had it for only about a week or two and I love it! It tracks everything I need it to and when I have a doctors appointment it will help a lot to show what has happened.

Nice way to keep everything recorded, but I’m not big on taking my phone into the toilet closet. I have Gastroparesis and have been on 4 colon cathartics in about as many months. Sometimes I’m in the bathroom a long time. Sometimes it’s back to back. I need a way to record but can’t.

I’m only about a week into my IBS journey, and I’ve known I ought to keep a good diary for a good while but I generally found excuses to get around it. Now granted, I’m a bit more serious about it now, but this app made the process a bit less arduous. I have to do the FODMAP diet so in some ways it would be nice to have more in depth metrics to connect foods with symptoms, but this app does allow you to add some of your own metrics so that’s something. 

Overall I’m pleased. I enjoy putting in the different things I’ve eaten, and you can take pictures if that’s easier (though I’ve personally not tried.) Thank you for making a not fun task a bit more enjoyable :)

reviews.t: A Food Journal and Symptom Tracker All in One
reviews.b:
This app acts as a food journal and a symptom tracker all at once.  I have an AI and immune system issue where I have to track what I eat, when I go to the bathroom and the symptoms that I have throughout the day.  
Bowelle makes it possible for me to have most of my tracking in one place. Thanks Bowelle!
This app really helps me regulate my diet in terms of my symptoms.
The app is great… It’s simple and easy to use. You can print out a report and it’s nice and organized. The only thing I would change is the name of the app.
Easy to use and convenient, couldn’t be better!
Tbh I don't know what to write bc I’m only writing a review bc the app pressured me so…… 😅  umm it’s a good app just needs better reminder for multiple times in a day

reviews.t: Nice app to keep track of digestion
reviews.b:
user friendly
nice looking interface
i'm new so far i love it

I have to follow a low FODMAP diet and didn’t always know where food fit in my diet allowances. Now I simply scan barcodes and I know. This really helps because while looking for items of the same food, some fit my diet and others didn’t depending on the brand.

I don’t think I have IBS but I’m transitioning to a plant based diet and have been having a lot of discomfort because of it. This has helped me a lot to figure out which foods trigger my symptoms. Love how simple it is!

Hi,

The export feature isn’t working. In particular, I’m unable to press the “send” button because it’s not changing to a blue indicating that all forwards have been complete. We have the premium version of the app. In fact I couldn’t send the bug report within the app either. 

Ramya

User-friendly and genuinely a nice interface; it’s not trying to do too much which makes it feel a little less data-driven than other tools I’ve tried (you aren’t scanning barcodes or putting every single ingredient in unless you want to do it yourself) but does a nice job of correlating some key factors like mood, stress levels, and allows tagging/comparisons. Basically like a mindfulness tool for your bathroom times.
Has really helped me watch my UC symptoms closely
I just wish they had more free features or a lower $ paid version… lifetime memebership?
Just wish the print in the food description boxes was larger to make it easier to edit.

reviews.t: 20 years Old in Chronic Pain and trying to get to the bottom of it.
reviews.b: I am a 20 year old Woman that has diagnosed Polycystic Ovary Syndrome, Hypothyroidism, and Hidradenitis Suppurativa. I also have suspected endometriosis and do not get my laparoscopic until March. Turns i have a positive ANA so i most likely have some sort of auto immune disease as well . Bowelle is an app i found when looking for a food tracker that does not count calories and is very straight forward because i knew i needed to figure out my food triggers and fix my diet for my conditions and possible auto immune disease without getting too focused on the calories of everything in the process. This is that for me. I record what i eat everyday as a digital food diary for when i finally am able to see a gastroenterologist. I record my BMS (what it is meant for , IBS) helps track my water intake and i added an additional item to record my chronic pain and where i hurt and its severity everyday. This is an easy way for me to keep track and stay in tune with my body and what its telling me. Thank you for making this app.
Easy to use and gives good details

Great app, glad we can make our own categories to track things. I do wish there was a Notes section outside of the food tracking area- for writing general notes on how that day was etc and symptoms unrelated to food.

This really is a good app. I have been using it for a couple of weeks and have been amazed at how flexible it is. I would like to see a few more icons and a place for tracking medications that effect the bowels. The reporting and history feature is great.

I have to get to the bottom of my flare ups. Even if I’m eating healthy, something I could be eating or drinking is causing something to happen. This app helps me log everything in easily. You can customize it to your needs. I need to know the difference with and without medication. So I added medication as a feature to keep track of. Very simple to use. And allowing me to use my keyboard to its extent like using emoji’s in my text, really helps to see my progress. As I was using emojis on a regular calendar before this app. 

I’ve tried journals and calendars .. but having an app at your fingers .. especially since I take my phone with me when I go.. has helped me log absolutely everything. And I can also go back months if I need to to edit or add. 

I’m giving it 4 starts because after entering your bowel movement, if you don’t add a “Tag” initially (the app has a feature to tag a specific note you would like attached like “discomfort” or “urgency”) you can’t edit it later to add one. So you have to delete it and add your bowel again. Kind of annoying for someone who is not feeling great.
Easy to use and customizable. Helps me keep track of symptoms correlating to food stress and sleep

reviews.t: Awesome app for tracking diet and symptoms
reviews.b: I don’t have IBS, but have have been tracking diet, BMs, and symptoms for other reasons. This has made it so much easier and more organized than just writing in a journal! I LOVE this app!
Easy way to keep track of BMs

This app has been very helpful to me! I have IBS, and the app lets me track my progress, and how diet and other interventions help me feel better. I think I am able to have more good days with fewer symptoms through using this app.
I started having stomach issues lately and this app has been such a big help.
Not much to this app... Kind of a joke really.  Much better apps out there...i am flushing this one

reviews.t: Simple & exactly what I was looking for
reviews.b: Needed a food journal to determine what is causing my headaches. Writing in a journal was cumbersome bc I didn’t always have it around. This app meets all my needs and it’s simple. Gives you the option to include time and add one additional concern (free option).

So I have ADHD.  So I’m spacey.   I got this to help me on my journey to healing my stomach/gut problems.  So far this is helpful and easy to use.  Haven’t used long enough to see patterns but next week I should. 
You track food, sleep and mood, stress and bowel movements with simple questions.
 Give it a try!

reviews.t: Really helps me with my crohns and my ptsd levels
reviews.b: This app was a game changer when my crohns  disease started becoming out of control and I started to exhibit mast, cell symptoms. I began tracking all of my food to note what I was eating and what I was reacting to. It also helps me realize when I’ve had too many bowel movements and then I need to make sure that I get some fluid and electrolyte in.

As someone who has fibromyalgia, once was IBS-D and am now severely IBS-C I gotta figure out what I’m eating, what is making things worse and what will help move things along. After vomiting because I was so constipated even after days of taking laxatives, Metamucil, prune juice and everything else I knew I had to really track what was going in and out of my body. This app does that and more. I love it

I have several chronic medical conditions and have used several apps to track different health issues, but none have been this simple to use. My GI doctor was so happy that I was able to answer all her questions with accurate information instead of my vague recollections. This is the only medical app that I have used consistently because it is simple and straightforward & only takes a few seconds to use.
I’ve only been using it for about a week, but I find the design and layout pretty simple to use; less complicated than other apps
Track everything that’s important for someone suffering from IBS

reviews.t: Great in tracking regularity and triggers
reviews.b: I suffer with constipation; this app has helped me figure out what my triggers are and how to get back on course. Thank you!!
Great filters. Easy to use.
I printed my report and took it with me to my doctor’s appt. She was very impressed with the info and was planning on recommending it to future patients.
Love the app, it’s perfect for logging info everyday.

reviews.t: Needs a notes field/premium sub is bad
reviews.b: Either allow notes or a lifetime premium purchase. Shouldn’t be sub based.
Latest version doesn’t display movements in portrait mode and in landscape mode reports them as steps! One can no longer add data for a previous day.
This app feels much simpler than other food trackers and the ability to see trends over time is great. If you want more specifics in your daily entries, there’s a notes option for more details.

I was having a lot of trouble remembering dates and information about my defecation history, because I’m having so many health problems this app provides the exact information to help my doctors care for me.
I really like this app when doing it’s really helpful for me to track what I’m eating. Also I have chronic kidney disease so keeping track of water intake is really helpful!

Where the app exceeds: 
The design is very intuitive and easy to start using immediately 

Standard categories are useful and well designed for tracking. 

The overlapping chart is helpful in comparing effects of categories with each other. 

The reports look really good when generated from the day to day data. 

The ability to create and add categories allows for some customization, and more detailed tracking. 

Where the app falls short:

Tracking how individual foods effect your gut - You can pick how you are feeling for the day, however you cannot pick after each meal or each item you ate. The meal section is in narrative form so you can write in how that meal affected you, but it won’t show as well on the report. 

Multiple Med doses - you can create a Med tab and select meds taken that day. However, if you have a Med you need to take multiple times a day, you will need to make it a narrative format instead of just a tag. Again this will not look as tidy on the report. 

Lack of time tracking - Some categories will track time. Such as time of BMs, but tracking how you feel through the day, or how long after a meal you start to feel worse or better is not easy to do in this app. 

Creating detailed categories - category names can only be 10 caricatures long. So if you are trying to solve the problem of tracking how you feel after each meal, you can’t title the category “after breakfast effects”. 

Conclusion:

All in all a beautifully designed app and easy to use, however if you are really trying to narrow down a specific food and how it affects your gut and how long it takes to affect your gut, and where in your gut it hurts and for how long etc. This app will leave you wanting for more. After using this app for an initial trial I found myself back in the App Store looking for a more detailed bowel tracking app. 

I really hope the developers keep working on this app to improve it, as i would love to continue to use it. I just need the ability to drill down a little deeper than this app is capable right now.

Everything about your health is related to the gut, and the gut microbiota.  You don’t have to be suffering from a diagnosed gut illness to benefit from keeping a record of your meals, snacks, beverages, mood, stress level, medications, supplements, and  bowel movements—their frequency, consistency, quantity, discomfort, and other characteristics.

Before discovering Bowelle I was going to journal all this information from a Pages template every day, but that’s a lot of typing!  Bowelle saves so much time, and organizes everything the way you want.  You can add things to track like exercise, alcohol, caffeine, or anything you can imagine.  You can view the history, see it as a graph, and create reports.

Response to customer service requests or feedback is fast and personal.  The paid version is well worth the small subscription price if you want to track more than the basic version does.  I am very happy with this app; studying my record has already given me insights into how I can improve my gut health, and so improve my general health. I’m in the process of getting a diagnosis and this helps me track my food intake and bowel activity. I’m hoping to see if there are food allergies or sensitivities I’ve been missing.
It is a great tool to have to help figure out what you do or eat affects you BM.  Like any tool, you have to use it!!  It’s eye opening.
This app has been so helpful to track my symptoms! I couldn’t recommend it enough!
The entries get erased periodically. Not sure why this is happening, but it’s frustrating to see that the data that entered a few hours earlier are gone, and I end up having to re-enter again.
Easy to use
We all know GI issues come with many different factors and being able to add my own items to track is GREAT. Also fantastic that adding updates is super easy, just a few taps. Love this app.
This app helps me to see what caused my stumic pain
I enjoy the app, very easy to use and tracks the things I need to track.

reviews.t: Can easily see trends based on food eaten the day before
reviews.b: I have been struggling with IBS and vitamin deficiency for years.  I have it 80% under control but I needed this app to get it to 95%.  I added a field to measure back pain each day and was able to correlate my pain to what I ate and when I took vitamins.  It also helped me validate my theories on what caused the IBS.  With the app, I would try and remember what those triggers were but I couldn’t trend it or remember things for more than a few days.  You could do this with a simple food diary, but this is much simpler.

reviews.t: Even the free version is great
reviews.b: This app is very helpful. I’m getting my digestive issues figured out after over 6 months of being uncomfortable.

This app does everything I need it to do.  You can add info, edit info (past days etcetera), and cleanly export it.  Also, VERY IMPORTANT, my info is private.  I don’t get unsolicited emails / pop ups / click baits.  It’s as if I don’t have the app installed, as it should be.

This app has been very easy to use and really helped me learned some of my patterns and manage symptoms. Minor tweak is that on the free version you get some tags you can use for certain entires. To add more you have to pay. It would be awesome to be able to edit those few free tags.
This app is really easy to use and well organized. It helps u track yr diet (including water) and how it affects your body. I’ve found it very helpful to keep track of what I eat.
Basic app & helpful for anyone wanting to be more mindful about their bathroom routine.
I like it. It’s easy to use and navigate. I wish some features were free but don’t we all :D
Has really helped me track systems and what foods bother me!!

I was looking for a free app in an attempt to find out what was bothering my digestive system.I got a quick diagnosis of possible IBS, though I only had a negative CT scan and never heard anything else.I have been religiously tracking everything  it asks for and it’s so easy because there’s nothing to look up, I don’t have to worry about calories or points, and I can either use a picture or write down what I eat. I’m still not sure what I have, but since I’ve started tracking, I am much more aware of what I’m eating, and I generally feel better. My symptoms have subsided a bit. And there’s also a premium version which I will definitely use if I need to get reports to a doctor at some point
I love it.
I started a gluten free diet bc of my stomach issues and this is perfect to keep track and show my dr!  Thanks!

I have been able to really track what’s working or not for my gut health using this app - but I haven’t made the commitment to upgrade
I have been using this app for several years and have seen it improved time after time.  It’s one of the best I’ve ever used!  Thank you for making it available…
great app

I have severe and complicated gastroparesis which is quickly getting worse. Using this app, especially the features where I’m able to add additional things to track like how nauseated I was, how often I got sick, and of course bowel movements because constipation is a symptom of gastroparesis, has been extremely helpful with keeping my team of doctors up to date on what’s happening with my symptoms so that we make informed decisions about next steps, also depending on my health and heart (meaning change in medicines or placement of a PEG-JET tube). Thank you so much for creating this app, and for making the possibility to add other things to track free. That’s rare on apps these days. Thank you!!!
This app has been great to track my symptoms so I can show my doctor. Highly recommend
Great for tracking and keeping up to date data.
This app has been really helpful for me to document my symptoms.  The app works well for me!

The only thing that could be great is if a form of graphics could be created in the reports for the categories that use tabs to see if the frequency of symptoms has a pattern for example
An easy to use app which does what it says on the tin.

This app has been nothing short of great at helping me keep track of… every part of my day, and it’s made it much easier to give my doctors accurate information. There’s very little I would change about it.

I have searched 17 other apps for a tracker that helped me track my moods, water intake, exercise, gut health, everything. The first time I used Bowelle I ended up deleted all my other ones, and purchased a year subscription. I’ve never purchased anything related to apps or in an app. I paid $12 for the year and have ended up using the app 6+ times per day, which is highly unlike me considering my screen time is less than an hour a day typically. It has given me in depth knowledge and customizable fields that are specific to my needs. I’m currently using it to help me track my moods and gut Health, as well as seeing the effect of foods on my mood. I’m working on tackling a lot of problems in my life holistically and this is giving me an incredible accurate view of everything and it has been the perfect place to start. Thank you all developers, finally an app that I’ve actually found useful and would actually recommend to others. Thank you.

I was finally diagnosed with Crohn’s after more than a decade trying to fix my symptoms with just diet alone. Part of my struggle with the diagnosis has been paying attention to my symptoms, and knowing how to answer my doctors questions. This app has made me so much more self aware of my body, and the reports are a great tool to bring to my doctor with my EXACT symptoms I’ve been experiencing. My doctor and I can go over the report together to see what has been happening over the last month, start identifying trigger foods, notice patterns in my flares… all of it. I paid to upgrade and added additional categories for tracking my medication, sleep, exercise habits, and energy levels. Now EVERYTHING I need to remember is in one place and I’m not just getting overwhelmed and forgetting everything the second I walk into the doctor’s office. Seriously, a really great tool for anyone dealing with any IBD symptoms.

I got this to help me track bowl activity when my gastroenterologist put me on a FODMAP diet after being diagnosed with possible Crohn’s or maybe ulcerative colitis - still waiting for test results. This app really helped with food “cause and effect”.
I’ve had IBS for years, and it’s always been a hassle to track food and bowel changes. On a whim, I wondered if there is an app for that. As a matter of fact, there is, and it’s very helpful!
