Great simple app! Extremely helpful to track food intake, and movements, so I can show my doctor exactly what is going on. My doctor actually suggested this app when we found out I had celiac disease. Love that I can create custom fields. Runs smooth without any issues.
I have diverticulitis and this is the best app I could find for my disease. It helps me to track my food and water intake. Thank you!!

reviews.t: Nice little chart keeper for IBS and other ppl
reviews.b: I do like the simplicity of this app. I’m an IBS pt since I’m 18. I’m now 50. This isn’t the only one out there, but I liked this one the most b/c it tracks what I need it to track. Like others, I wish there wouldn’t be a “premium “ version that you have to pay for. It would be nice to have all the options open to everyone. I use what I can from the app, and if I need to track anything else for my GI I just use pen and paper. Edit: Still loving this app more than a month after I started using it. I wish I could add some things to track or tag, but it is what it is. I just can’t afford to buy the premium version. That’s the only reason I rated it 4/5 stars. Otherwise it would be a 5. (5/8/21)
Having the Bowelle app has really helped me be aware of my body and have the data I need to start tracking progress towards a healthier me!
great app simple to use easy to track
I do like the app but since it is too track bowels why is there no option for tried but could not go?  Maybe as that in them it would be perfect
Very helpful for what I need
This has been helpful in tracking my food intake and how it influences my digestive system.

Bowelle is a simple app to help you track you your food intake and bowel movements. You can also add features like sleep and stress level tracking. Unfortunately the app is somewhat limited as free apps are. You can only add a few extra tracking points. 

Pros are it is easy to use, has a nice timeline on the top to show trends, allows notes for extra data entry, tracks sleep and water consumption. 

Cons are there are no stored food items you must make each entry yourself.
You are limited on tags you can use to describe your bowel movements. Limited to amount and consistency with a few other options like mucus or time. 
Notes are not easily accessible.
Trend line only shows your mood which if you have stomach aches or pains during the day may not be the same for the whole day. 

Overall it has been working for my uses. Hard to establish a cause of my own discomfort even when looking at this app after 2 weeks. Hopefully a doctor can make better use of the data than I can.
This app is exactly what I was looking for. It’s unfussy, easy to use and makes it easy to log my foods so that I know what caused any irregularities.
Awesome for tracking my stomach issues. Helps keep track of my symptoms.
Gr8
App is extremely user friendly and is very helpful.

reviews.t: Finally! An easy way to track food & stress triggers.
reviews.b:
I never thought I’d be leaving a review for an app that deals with diarrhea, but if you’re reading this then you know how IBS can interrupt your life. That’s how I ended up here; I was looking for something that would make some part of this easier.

I’ve been having stress related stomach/gut issues for a few years now. Plus a few obvious food sensitivities that I was able to figure out on my own (when you start having severe cramps and need a bathroom within 20 minutes of eating the same food more than twice it’s not a coincidence). When I began having bouts of diarrhea with no obvious connection to anything, I knew I needed to start keeping a food journal. No matter my good intentions I couldn’t remember to write down everything I ate, IF I remembered to do it at all.

I recently decided I would search for a food journaling app, not the diet/calorie type. When I searched, and added IBS in the parameters...bingo! I found Bowelle. I’ve only been using it about a week, but I’ve already found it so helpful. It is so easy to use. I always have my phone with me. I can easily record the time I ate or drank, or had a bowel movement. I can keep track of medications I take for dealing with symptoms. I know that the history and reports portion will be a big help to me in determining my triggers. I now have a way to be objective about my symptoms.

reviews.t: Excellent for reporting data to yourself
reviews.b: Daily stress levels, moods, bowel movements, and a record of everything that you eat are available with this app most of which can be entered By voice so you don’t even have to type and you can export your save data in a PDF.

I have been looking for a good way to track all the things you need to with IBS: meals, moods, symptoms, days when I need meds... this does all of that in a very organized and easy to use format. So grateful!
It’s a really simple and smooth app to use. These sign and flow really makes me want to keep doing it daily.
This extremely useful and well made. This is going to very helpful in hopefully isolating triggers for me.

reviews.t: I love this app!! Game changer!!
reviews.b: Over the past 6 months I’ve had some concerning stomach issues/ health problems and have been trying to pin down whether food, stress, or sleep is affecting this—then along comes this app! It helps keep track of absolutely EVERYTHING and has a beautiful and functional design! Thank you so much for making my life and health journey a bit easier!
Great for tracking of you’re the type that needs to. If you need to finally have a little more knowledge that can be relied on, this is the app for you.
I have celiac and this app is great!  I need to get data for my doctor and this is very helpful.  Trying to determine what else is impacting my digestive system so this has been so helpful!
The app keeps everything organized and ready at your fingertips. Has basically all of the food and beverages in the search bar. Excellent
This is an amazing app for tracking food allergies. So easy to use and track

I‘m using one in association with a health issue of mine to try to determine what is going on and another account to monitor my cat who has borderline Type II diabetes. 

I love that you can add new category of symptoms. Would like to see a function specifically to record weight, but in the meantime I record it under „Other“
Because of the tracking I can do on this app my son’s doctor was able to find a pattern that led us to diagnosis.

I was looking for something to track what I eat without worrying about calories and macros etc. It is super easy to use and you can track everything from food to mood and period etc. My only criticism is the lack of database for foods I eat. I wish it was connected to a bigger database so when you scan foods they are actually there. I would say 7/10 times I scan a food it’s not there. Especially since a lot of foods I’m eating are specialty gluten free or dairy items, however I would think a lot of the people using this app would be using the cleaner foods? It’s also a little annoying that when I scan something, add all the ingredients and save it, the next time I scan the food it doesn’t show up based on the barcode.
Super adaptable and helpful

I recommend this to most of my friends

This app played a crucial role in being heard by my doctor. It’s hard to ignore symptoms when they are detailed in a report. It eventually led me to be tested for a genetic disorder, which then explained why I was having the specific symptoms related to food. Highly recommend this app.

This app is exactly what I needed for tracking tricky food issues. I like how it allows customization of symptoms and includes so many factors as options that contribute to my reactions like environmental. This will be a 5-star review once more people start using it and I don’t have to enter as many of the foods I eat. It took a while to figure out how to enter ingredients of new foods but now it’s easy. I appreciate the transparency of the app to acknowledge that and I had no issue in paying for a subscription after just a few entries and seeing how beneficial this will be to me.

Love this app for tracking every single aspect of what is happening with my mood, health, sleep, medications, periods, meals, etc

reviews.t: Okay for tracking but not for analysis
reviews.b: I find app useful for tracking a range of moving pieces, meals, sleep, medications, supplements, some symptoms of interest. But the analysis reports are just about completely useless, I have to analyze by hand or manually entering in a statistical program to get at any important relationships, for example between diet and symptoms. It also can’t really track calories burned and consumed, even though it allows you to track what you eat. You’ll need a separate app for that. That was what I’d wanted to avoid.

I’m trying to determine what’s causing an allergic reaction on my face, but it’s so difficult due to the delayed reaction and volume of food and chemicals I have contact with!  This app makes it so much easier and less frustrating to look for correlations!
I can print my meals and symptoms and review with my doctor. It’s convenient to access and record everything. Love having this on an app.
I purchased this app so I could email my symptoms to my nutritionist, but this app function doesn’t work.  I’ve asked for a refund, and we’ll see if that works.

I am not the most disappointed person. I was keeping records on any paper I could access when needed. I missed so much record keeping until zi found this app. It was easy to customized to my needs and very accessible. When I went to the doctor, I printed my records and felt prepared for the first time. I would recommend this app for anyone needing to follow day to day info about themselves. It excellent.
This is not a free app. You only get a 2 week trial of the app and then have to pay if you want to continue.

It helped me figure out what exactly was causing my headaches. The only problem was to remember entering every snack I had several days in the row. Ideally it should be several weeks in the row, then you for sure will know what’s causing your gut to be unhappy.
This app has been super helpful in my food journaling. It’s very responsive and comprehensive. Never had any bugs. Love that I can download my entries to share with a health coach.
This app is helping me figure out which foods my stomach can tolerate and which make me sick and how badly. The symptoms tracker is the most helpful.

reviews.b: The app is very useful for tracking foods and noticing which foods could be influencing dietary issues.  I did the one week trial and was sold. I’ve already recommended it to friends and family.

It was just stuck on “choose a subscription”. The description should tell uses that a subscription is required to use it. I simply uninstalled.

I do wish they had a category for weight and BMI.

I have various food intolerances with a wide variety of symptoms that can be difficult to track and monitor. I think this app has great potential in helping with these issues and I plan on continuing my subscription once my free trial ends in a couple days.
So helpful and so easy to use and free! Can’t beat it!

I’ve spent a long time looking for an app that allows me to track food intake, GI symptoms, and other health indicators like mood, sleep, and energy—and this app delivers on all fronts. It’s highly customizable, which I really appreciate.

However, my main concern is the large number of duplicate ingredients in the food database. It’s unclear whether selecting one version of a food over another affects the analysis. For example, I often see the same ingredient listed multiple times, with one version labeled with additional descriptors (e.g., “kind of X (nightshade)”) and others not. I’m not sure if these distinctions influence how regressions are run or how the app identifies potential triggers for symptoms.

I tried reaching out to the app’s support team, but my message was marked as spam, and I couldn’t find an alternative way to get in touch.

I really like this app but without options for tracking blood and mucus in stool that is a major hindrance for me to track these primary symptoms of ulcerative colitis. UC isn’t even presented as an option in setup for what digestive ailment we are seeking to track. I may look into other apps that better support UC-tracking.

Also recommend that image uploading be added as a feature so users can include images as needed.
I have tested a few apps to track my eating habits. This app has be great, very simple and straightforward

Highly customizable, easy to use and helps me communicate with my healthcare providers. Helps me have an accurate picture of symptoms, meds, foods, supplements and activities. Hoping to get an accurate diagnosis by using this app. Thanks!!

I love this app.  I can keep track of my symptoms as well as noticing a pattern between my symptoms and the meals I eat, or the movements I  make. However, a reminder notifications setting would make the app easier to use.  I think this would be great as I sometimes forget and then stop using the app for long periods of time.
Free 2 week period then you are forced to pay for it. Description said you pay only for analysis but the whole app becomes pay based.

This app is handy to have. We are trying to determine a food sensitivity/intolerance and it’s definitely helpful to go back and look and see what the averages are for different food symptoms, etc. I can also see what the culprits may be for her. It’s easy to add things for the most part. 

I will say there are a few things that could be better. Some of her food items I’ve been unable to locate that exact item to add to the diary so I had to find the closest thing. The barcode doesn’t always work like expected. I had a gluten free item and when I used the barcode, it just came up as the regular item, not stating it was the gluten free kind. Since I’m planning to show this to a doctor, I’d like them to be able to see that it’s gluten free. 

Also, it’s kind of difficult to see what the top suspects are because there are so many ingredients and they don’t seem to appear in order of how likely a suspect it is.its difficult to navigate the suspects page and to figure out the analysis page. All in all, I believe it gets the job done for the most part, but it could be more user friendly.
There was a whole tutorial and everything that I found really helpful. I was impressed with the custom graphics drawn over the UI. 🙂

reviews.t: Make sure you cancel on time
reviews.b: I did the trial period and then tried to cancel the subscription after being charged their premium fee nearly 50.00 and Apple would NOT refund me even when I sent in a refund request.  I even received a email from My symptoms saying they approve the refund! Still APPLE denied extremely disappointing and frustrating. The app was not helpful for me.

Did see it was an app with purchases available, did not see anywhere until I had it downloaded already that it was only a trial then you must purchase. It may be a great app, but I wasn’t buying it to find out.  Not a problem, just be aware.

I know it’s something small, but it asks you to request a username. I requested one that did not identify myself, met the length requirements, was not in any way vulgar, and the app indicated was available. When I entered it and any variation, the app repeatedly suggested something else, remnant of a dreamy teen girl’s blog eg “whispering willow”. I guess when you’re sick and in pain the small things begin to really make you mad. So, eff this app. It may even be the answer I’m looking for. But the  fact that I met all the username requirements and still get denied p*sses me off so badly, I willing to cut my nose to spite my face.

Great app, would appreciate a dark mode

This is such a practical and handy app for tracking food, symptoms, and I personally also use it to track my bowel movements! I really appreciate it, helps keep me
honest.
I don’t know if there’s even a comparable app on the market. This app combines different categories to track and analyze and it has given me great insights.
This app is working very good for me. The learning curve is fast. I've only been using it for a couple of days and I'm hopeful that I can figure out if something in my diet is causing me problems.

The description in the App Store says that the app if free for logging diet and symptoms and you only need to pay if you want analysis. This is not true. Once they have all your info they tell you it is a two week trial. I planned to see if I liked the lot and then would have subscribed, but no tolerance for these tricks.
This is my go to app. It really helps me track all my symptoms and I can also track diet as well if I feel a symptom may be related to food. I have been using this app for years and I use it daily.

Great app! Helped me learn to avoid certain foods that were giving me a tough time - would be perfect if we could just add ingredients via pasting one list and having the app separate everything via commas (or similar) instead of having the user type individual ingredients, since iOS now allows for text selection in images.

reviews.t: Low confidence even after using it diligently for months
reviews.b:
I was optimistic when I started using this app because it’s a lot more granular and you can track more things than other IBS symptom tracking apps I’ve tried. But alas, ultimately it still hasn’t been able to tell me anything I don’t already know, even after using it every day to track everything I eat for months. The analysis is the most important part of the app. It’s supposed to use algorithms to predict which foods you're eating, meds you’re taking, exercise you’re doing, etc that are most closely correlated with your symptoms. My problem is that even after using the app for so long and having symptoms almost every day, all of the app’s predictions are labeled “very low confidence”. I have no idea why that is or if there’s anything I could do on my end to allow the app to make more confident predictions. Ultimately the app is useless if it can’t predict what’s causing my symptoms any better than I can. The whole reason I’m using a food diary at all is because my symptoms seem unpredictable. 

I tried reaching out to their support about the low confidence issue but never got a response.

reviews.t: Wow! This is a powerful and well thought out tool!
reviews.b:
I have long standing autoimmune issues that have (so far) defied medical treatment. A huge issue has been in understanding cause & effect. MY SYMPTOMS has given me a way to: 
1) track the what/when/how of lifestyle choices (diet, sleep, exercise, supplements, medications, etc) and health indicators (mood, BMs, aches & pains, etc) …whatever I believe is pertinent,
2) perform STATISTICAL ANALYSIS of the data to highlight potential cause vs effect. Of course, this analysis is only as good as the quality of the data (garbage in/garbage out!) but I’m responsible for that quality. The potential value of the correlation is oh-so-much better than just “I notice ‘this’ when I do ‘that’”, 
3) share this information in a clear format (customizable PDF to print or email) with my health care team,
4) download details of food products, supplements, etc, by scanning barcodes (time saver!!!), define recipes, automatically create favorites, and many more ways to reduce the effort of capturing good data (quality!),
5) record the data easily and accurately. Because it’s easy, I’m much more likely to capture most, if not all, of the data (quality!)
6) and CUSTOMIZE almost anything I choose, to fit my unique situation.

For me, tracking this level of detail, WITHOUT this app, was overwhelming, frustrating and ultimately a failure. WITH this app, I am successfully creating a picture of my complex lifestyle choices and state of health, in real time, with the ability to “do the math”. I believe that this tool will reveal insights more quickly and more accurately than any other app out there. I’m stoked!!! Try MY SYMPTOMS yourself and join me in using one of the best tools available on our journey to health!!!

I need to wait for a few months to see how valuable the analysis function is, but after a week of use, I can give a 5 star. I’m able to track everything I need plus add symptoms to my needs. Easy to use! Works consistently after one week.

It is taking a little longer to figure out how to optimally use than a less customizable ap but I greatly appreciate having this flexibility.  
 So, e.g., if I want to list only 2 items for a day, such as “coffee” and “heartburn” I could do that.  Or if I want to list detailed ingredients and quantities and exact times with free text comments in multiple categories, I can also do that. If you are like me, you are taking some of the same meds and supplements and eating many of the same foods each day.  I don’t have enough data yet for extensive analysis yet but look forward to exploring these features more as well. reviews.t: Overall good but could use some polish
reviews.b:
This is a solid diary app for digestive health.  The diary functionality itself is quite smooth, and it already knows the names and ingredients of a wide variety of foods because it pulls from a database generated by all its users.  This includes a highly useful barcode scanning function, which I’ve contributed several foods to.  It’s easier to use than the other app I tried, has more foods, and (according to the developer) doesn’t invade your privacy. 

There is one major downside to the user-generated database: it has many different copies of the same food, which are included as ingredients in other foods as well. So perhaps hamburgers contain “beef which is a kind of red meat”, but beef stew contains “beef which is a kind of meat” and another recipe includes simply “beef”.  All of these display the same, but they’re different internally. As a result, there will be several instances of “beef” in the diary, which count as completely separate foods for analysis purposes.  This is true for almost every ingredient I’ve eaten, and it makes the analysis functionality less accurate and less useful.  It may be worth combing the database to merge common ingredients.

I haven’t found the analysis function to be particularly helpful, and I’m considering pulling the raw data (neat feature!) to write my own analysis.  The built-in one may be better at finding allergies than chronic issues, because it focuses on foods that I ate only a few times. If I’ve had 100 stomach aches over the years I’ve used the app, it doesn’t help to point out that one of them was after the only time I ate something seasoned with caraway. Statistically, that’s probably just luck, and even if not, it doesn’t help me much. Searching for foods with the best predictive power would be more useful.  It might also be useful to point out foods that anti-correlate with symptoms.

Overall, I recommend this app but could use some improvement.

Thank you developers, great job!!

So much less toxic than covering up your symptoms with meds, and much more accurate than food sensitivity tests... this is the most effective AND HEALTHIEST way I’m figuring out what my body can tolerate !!
Confusing at first but gets better the more u use it. I like that I can add my unusual symptoms that aren’t typical to most people and track them.
A majority of the barcodes I scan cannot be found in the database. Not at all convenient. Not worth the purchase.

reviews.t: Once you start customizing the ingredients of your meals, app crashes
reviews.b: The app has become useless after using it for just a few days. The issues started once I started customizing the ingredients of my meals. Now it crashes every time I open it and I can’t even use the support link embedded in the app as the app crashes immediately. I’ve wasted many hours setting this app and logging my daily activities for this!! I want my money back.

This app has made my life of food tracking so much easier. I used to print diary pages that often didn’t have room for everything. This is so much easier, and my food diary is always with me, so I don’t forget to report anything.
I think a YouTube explanation would help me get beyond merely entering data. It would be appreciated.

It does a decent job of providing database of foods but entering details is still a pain. As the inventory is uncontrolled, you end up with 20 versions of everything. Too early to say anything about the analysis function. Also, I don’t understand what does it mean to specify “duration” of bowel movement.

So I love, love, love the features of this app and how it works! But I’m giving it three stars because of the unexpected costs. So when I downloaded the app, it was free but said “in app purchases” which typically means you can use the app in a limited function or for a sample time period. The app never asked for my card info or for an upgrade to premium or warned me about a trial period that I would be charged after. I found a charge to my apple account about a week after downloading the app! I’m not very happy with the producers of the app because of the sneaky charge. If I’d known or had been warned, I would be ok with it, but I wasn’t. So, the app itself is wonderful and it’s functions and adaptability is amazing, but I really wished I’d been told about the charge up front.

reviews.t: Perfect! I never pay but took the chance
reviews.b:
So happy I decided to spend the money and buy this app. It tracks your symptoms your food your fluid intake whatever you wanna put in there exercise medication vitamins.
One thing I would really like to see is an area where you can create a list of foods -symptoms of foods that you have a bad reaction to and able to share with doctor.
I wish there was a way to add photos of the distention of my stomach. This is crucial when buying your app for medical assessment & diagnostic purposes.

reviews.t: Helped me at the lowest times
reviews.b:
I absolutely love this app. I’ve been using it for just about three years now, and I can’t foresee a time that I won’t use it. It helped my doctor diagnose a stomach ulcer, and thanks to the ability to export diary entries to my dietitian, has kept me on track with my FODMAP diet. 

PLEASE integrate with MyFitnessPal and Fitbit! That’s the only way you could improve this beauty of an app. Thank you so much 🙏🏻

reviews.t: Best app for figuring out reactions
reviews.b: This is the best app ever for tracking your food, supplements, environmental triggers, exercise, and even the date your start your period to see what may be causing symptoms
I use it daily to track food tolerances related to IBS and Gerd. You can add your medications, foods, symptoms very easily that suit your own personal needs. Great app!
This app has helped me keep track of my chronic illnesses for years.  I wish they’d connect with MyFitnessPal but maybe one day!

The biggest thing I have an issue with is a lack of a place to input quantity. For me there are several foods I tolerate in small portions only so in addition to tracking reactions as I introduce new foods, the portions are super important to track as well in order to find my threshold with some things.

reviews.t: If you’re willing to put in the time and effort it’s worth it.
reviews.b:
This is one of those apps (any food tracking app) where you aren’t going to get immediate satisfaction. 

I’ve been using this app for 2-3 months now, and I still don’t have enough data to really determine what’s been upsetting my stomach. However, if you think about it, you’re not going to know that soon unless you’re eating something on an almost daily basis. Your diet changes week to week, and you don’t eat the same things over and over again. 

In the couple months I’ve been using this app, I have figured out that the string cheese I rely on as a snack makes me gassy. Not all cheese, just the string cheese. It has also helped to point out that chicken broth upsets my stomach rather quickly. Upon some research, chicken broth shouldn’t do that unless I have a histamine deficiency. Which, upon a little more research, makes sense when you add how much tea I drink on top of the once a day energy drink. 

This app helps point out the common foods/ingredients in your diet to your symptoms. As long as you’re remembering to track it, and you’re willing to do a little research, this app will help. 

The features of this app are really simple, but really nice as well. You can add a food that’s not already in the database really easily. You can also update something you already keyed in (if you’re keying it in late, or you forgot to add an ingredient, etc). When you click on your symptoms, it will show you the most likely culprits (and it’s lists them all from most likely to least likely), and when you click on a culprit it will show you a graph of how often that culprit coincided with your symptom. 

One thing I don’t like is medication. Obviously, if you’re having stomach issues, you’re likely to take something like Pepto Bismol or Tums to try to relieve the symptoms. However, these medications become a culprit for your symptoms, even though you’re taking them after the symptoms started and they’re meant to make things better. On the flip side, if you are taking a daily vitamin and it’s giving you loose stool, you’d fine out. So it’s almost like the app needs to split the medication tab into two— Medicine Aids and Medicine Prescriptions or something like that.

At the end of the day, if you are patient, remember to log everything, and you’re willing to do a little research, this app will go a long way for you.
The longer I’ve used this app the more I like it and discover another cool thing that it does.  Thank you.

I’m trying to determine if my daughter has a soy allergy. Guess what ingredient this app doesn’t allow you to add. Soy! 

I tried scanning the barcode for three different common items. (A cake mix, frosting, and a coffee creamer) None were listed in the database. Forgivable, except that I can’t even enter the ingredients in the database because it won’t even let me add soy as an ingredient.

Waste of money. I’d like a refund.
Finally a functional app for recording diet, environmental factors, allergies and more! Plus analytics! Very pleased. It's easy to use and well designed.

Completely impressed with this app and how easy it is to use with both iPhone and iPad access. My big wish is to see weight added as a choice instead of putting it in other. 5stars and my first review ever - that’s how much I love it.
Just wish there was an option for voiding and bladder discomfort and option for amount of stool. Small med large would be nice.

This App is really great for tracking everything going on so you can better understand your body. I have been struggling with many symptoms for years and finally found this app to help me record it all. You can get a pdf copy of the items you’ve tracked to take to your doctor. Highly recommend!

reviews.t: You may not want to UPDATE YOUR APP
reviews.b:
This app worked fine until I did the most recent update that has a cloud backup. I could not back up successfully to the cloud because it currently only allows up to 64 characters for an item. I had to modify my item name to something shorter than what I originally input so that I could sync. The developer discovered this after I contacted them for help when my sync failed every time. I got quick and helpful assistance by emailing the company. 

The cloud backup is only to allow syncing between devices. You can’t sign in to the cloud data in a PC to review or edit. 
It is still possible to email yourself the data  as a safety mechanism to ensure data isn’t lost from the app once you’ve signed up for cloud syncing, but it’s not obvious and there are currently not directions for how to do so in the User Manual or in the FAQ.
the app won’t work for me- every time i try to add a new medication, food, etc the app closes down. when i try to report an error it won’t let me sync my email. not what i expected at all.

I have a chronic illness and type one diabetes so being able to track all my symptoms both physical and mental is extremely helpful for myself and my doctors. I do wish you could view your diary and the first thing on top be the most recent item you posted not the first thing you posted from the day. It also asks for a lot of detail when you log anything which is time consuming and not something you can do super quick compared to other apps. But overall I’m pleased with it and would recommend it to others.

This app is very well developed, wide range of foods, symptoms and easy to add more..
Reports and information wonderful
It’s the complete package 
And the price 👍
Too many entries - same meds every day. - too difficult when entering after the time. - should have button “same as yesterday”

reviews.t: Stores lots of info! No adds!
reviews.b:
Only wish I could input pictures.
That would help me see if my eczema has improved or has worsened.

I have a chronic illness and this app has helped me gain some clarity about my trigger foods and activities. 

I also have more clarity about the medications and activities that help. 

I recommend it to friends who are feeling generally crappy and don’t know why.
I love this app for a food/symptom diary.  This was invaluable when figuring out my son’s food allergies!  It works great to recurs food and symptoms.

I love the May option and flexibility of the app although wondering if there is a tool for calculating calories?

Thanks!
Leeza
This app is great, but I am giving four stars because they need a way to consolidate the ingredients.  There are duplicates and misspellings in every category.

Although I can see some usefulness in this I found free apps that are better. It doesn’t have a log for weight or calories. Doesn’t synch with bowflex or my iwatch or my sleep app.  Doesn’t have a place to track menstrual cycle. Directly relate any symptoms to that how can it advise on symptom causes without that?  Just not there yet.

I’ve only been using the app for a week now but it has everything I needed. I can track food and medication intake and sleep and mood and other health symptoms all in one place. The initial set up takes a little bit of time the first time I enter something new but after that it’s super easy. This will be a really good self advocacy tool the next time I’m at the doctor trying to explain a complicated and not well understood condition. Cause and effect will be laid out right on paper.

I have this app on 2 devices but the information doesn’t transfer from one to the other. So I can’t enter item in my iPad and see them later on my iPhone. All of my other FREE apps work and communicate with each other, not sure why this one doesn’t. I stopped using it because of this and feel it was a waste of money for something I never use but need.
This is a great way to track what I’m eating and the meds, supplements and symptoms. Best app I’ve used to do this.

reviews.t: Really great with room from improvement
reviews.b: The app has been easy to use for logging food.  I only wish you could also do a daily long of symptoms, especially if you could add photos of symptoms to the daily log. That way improvements and regressions of symptoms could be tracked more easily.  Thanks for this app, though.  It is a helpful tool for us in figuring out food sensitivities for our daughter.

Downloaded this two days ago. Have been trying to figure out the hang out it but hard to do. The symptom section makes no sense-and doesn’t allow you to input your symptoms. Very confusing. Hardly any barcodes are in the system.would not recommend.
I haven’t used it long enough to really get the benefit of the symptoms attached each food. I do wish it had all my favorites already listed, but it makes it easy to add them. So far so good!

I don’t think my problems are related to diet, but I find this app really useful for tracking how I’m feeling and what kind of symptoms I’m having and then later cross referencing that data with a variety of other data points such as weather, pollen count, medications and supplements taken, etc. Overall a great app and the devs are very responsive.

the app faithfully tracks everything you eat, but its inability to recognize and consolidate basic ingredient names into the same statistic makes it ultimately worthless. example: after months of use, i discovered the app was tracking about twelve different entries for the same ingredient, “cheese”. by being too dumb to put all the “cheese” entries under the same banner (and giving the user no ability to manually do so), the app inadvertantly waters down all its own analysis and makes your results totally useless.
How do you sync with apple health for exercise and data?

I find this app useful for logging my food intake and symptoms.  I have celiac disease and it helps me determine how different foods affect me. Especially when trying new restaurants that claim to have “gluten free” options.
Awesome way to keep track. Super user friendly. Has options for all categories and add ons.

The first time I tried to rate this fantastic app it submitted before I finished and “only” sent 4 stars. (Hopefully that won’t skew the ratings.) But this app is worth every single star, as it’s absolutely terrific, does everything it supposed to, is easy -almost fun to use and extraordinarily helpful if you’re dealing with food sensitivities.

Very helpful tool for locating my problem foods and medications. Also understanding how stress effects food and medication needs so I can locate specific issues instead of “banning everything”. 

Love the variety of “triggers”. 

A lot of help!

If you are looking for a journal for a general correlation of food intake to symptoms then this will fit your needs. But I have learned that not every grilled chicken breast or hamburger is the same. Many foods have added fillers or gluten that affect me. Some foods are high in histamine or lectins that affect me. I’m not seeing any in-depth algorithm here. Maybe I expected too much or didn’t give it enough of a sample size.

reviews.t: No Search functions, no good for me
reviews.b: I bought this and used it for a couple months but quickly learned I needed an ability to Search on just basic stuff like “when did I eat <this or that> last or to search on a specific entry word. If it had Search I would try it again.

reviews.t: Like it but wish it had period info too
reviews.b: So I have a lot of digestive issues and other health problems so this is super helpful. But I wish I could put info about my menstrual cycle in so I would be able to see easier if any of my problems are hormone based.

This app is wonderful- easy to use- I love that you can customize symptoms. Makes explaining multiple health concerns.  Food diary and medication list is up to date including THC Vaping . Just wish would sync to iPhone

This app is great. The only problem I have is that every time I try to email myself the diary report it doesn’t show up in my email until after I contact support. I think there’s a bug. The report doesn’t go to my spam. I’ve tried to request both the PDF and CSV report, and I receive neither. What’s the deal?
Many supplements and OTC meds are missing and it takes time to input.

reviews.t: Great but I hope they add 1 feature.
reviews.b:
I would give this 5 stars if they had a way to memorize meals with portion size. I have some meals that I eat very frequently, especially during the work week and wish I could just have them memorized instead of adding each part of it in with portions each time. 

If they I add this I will give it 5 stars!

I’ve struggled for years when doctors ask me to track my migraines and associated symptoms, sleep habits, food etc. now it’s so easy with this app. This time I can print it out and take it to my office visits!!
This app has everything a person who is tracking their diet to determine the source of symptoms would like to include, and it is very easy to use.
This is exactly what I needed! Works great and easy to use.

I suffer from migraines and it’s important for me to track my sleeping, eating and symptoms to figure out how things relate and cause my migraines. This app seems perfect to help with that. My only complaint is that instead of putting an end time for something, you put how many hours it happened. When I have a headache, the last thing I want to do is do time math to figure out how long it has been going on. It’d be much easier to just go on the app and say that it ended at that time and have the app determine the length of time.

reviews.t: Ability to attach photo to food
reviews.b: I love this app, but I wish there is a feature that allow my simply attach a photo for the foods I recorded. Visual image can say more than words.

this app is exactly what i needed to track my symptoms and food correlation. i didn't expect to find one so specifically for this need! it's functional, intuitive and more than insightful. i am so grateful for mySymptoms; please keep it up.

reviews.t: Great, great app for anyone dealing with various health problems.
reviews.b:
Track not just digestive matters but anything like fatigue, sleep, exercise, and manually created categories.   DIetary tracker UPC scans food labels too!  Makes PDF and CVS exports for backup and printouts for your records or doctor. 

Available android or iPhone.
Best purchase I could have made on an app. It helps me track my daily life when Health is a huge factor. Recommend.

After loosing a lot of time entering data_ Everything was fine_ suddenly , I remembered that I have some back up from previous application which I bought by the way for second time through my new phone . I opened my email and opened  the file by this application mySymptoms The file was empty, Not only that it kicked me out and created accounts locked with a password which I never used on this application. Now I have an empty account which is open but the new one which I have put my data today was locked.

This app is great! I use it for myself with great results. Unfortunately, the app is rated for 17+. That mean my teenage daughter, who really needs to use the app cannot. Her devise set to an appropriate age for her to protect her for the not so nice things out there. The rating on this app makes no sense and it dilutes its usefulness. I wish they would change the rating so teens who are struggling with food sensitivities could benefit.

The mySymptoms app is very effective at identifying food triggers that cause IBS/D. And the creator(s) are helpful in answering questions about the app in a timely manor.  I find it a valuable tool as I try to assess foods the trigger painful and uncomfortable consequences from food that I consume. I also use this app to share information with my physician.
All my info from my android account is unable to sync to my new iPhone. They said theyve been working on it since beginning of year
Great app.  Would give it 5 stars if it would sync across iOS devices.
The majority of foods I’ve tried to scan or enter are not recognized, and it’s been more of a hassle than anything. Very disappointed.

This is an extremely helpful app. You get out of it what you put into it. My only need is for a dedicated specific place to record my weight and the ability to see it on the day’s log to reduce key strokes. If you all could do that I’d be happy.
Would have been 5 stars but I’m not really seeing how it is fodmap friendly.

Recently purchased to track my food symptoms for a variety of reasons. So far it seems pretty good, but there a few things I wish it had. I also tried out the Cara app and prefer the food entry here- but found Cara to be superior in tracking symptoms and providing options for each of the symptoms (such as mood (detailed things), sleep- how you feel when wake up etc). Also would like mensural cycles to be an option with detailed symptoms as this can play a huge role - even more so than food.

Best app I have ever used to track food for food allergies.  I have severe Anaphylaxis and have had trouble finding the triggers for my allergies.  This app is very intuitive and the analytics and tracking tools are very simple to use.
I love this app ... it’s easy to use and helps me keep track of food, medicines, bathroom habits and how I feel ... love it

I tried a bunch of these types of apps before settling on this one. It works great. It’s quick and easy to use. The developer is very responsive (and rumor has it that HomeKit connections are coming).
This is a great app for tracking daily activities and health. Working great for managing my IBS condition.

Basically decent app but frustrating to use. There are many redundant listings for single food items and if I happen to choose a different example from the list than I did the last time they get counted as two separate items which messes up the analysis. I tried to just make my very own list to control the choices so I only ever see the exemplar I used before but it was almost impossible. I don’t care if it takes a while to create my own library of items if I could do it and never see the list of every entry other users have used. Otherwise the developers need to curate the list so if I choose a basic item from the list it is always the same thing. I turned out to have “flax seed” as well as “Flax seeds” as two separate items. I couldn’t remember which one I had used 2 weeks earlier. That’s incredibly frustrating. I get so aggravated that I’ve stopped using the app. Also it would be better to be able to look for correlations between symptoms as well. It should be possible to look for correlations between any category of data and any other.
Perfect way to track everything the body does daily. Nice and easy to use.

This is the best tracking app out there. I am often checking to see what’s available and if there’s another app that would have more of what I need/want. There never is. This is the most complete tracking app. All in one- for symptoms, food, mood, energy, sleep, bowel, stress, exercise, environment, meds & supplements. 

FEATURES: 

Multiple Profiles: 
This is the only tracking app I’ve found that allows separate data input for 2 people/profiles. This is very important for us as my daughter and I both have chronic Lyme disease & coinfections, mold illness, and more, and our illness and treatments are complicated. 

Fully Customizable: 
The symptoms fields are fully customizable. I can add or delete and organize any symptom. 

Time Stamp; Multiple Entries: 
There’s a time stamp for every entry and no limit to number of entries in a day. 

Notes: 
I can add notes to every entry and the first part of the note can be read from the day view. 

Visual Cues: 
I like the visual cues for each of the categories- the color & icon makes it so much easier to read. This is crucial for people with brain damage & cognitive dysfunction (from Lyme disease & mold illness).

Barcode Scanner: 
I like that barcodes can be scanned for foods, meds, supplements. This is so very helpful. 
— — — 

IMPROVEMENTS: 

• Search Feature: 
To be able to search for a specific type of entry, or a keyword would be so very helpful. 

• Copy / Paste:  
It would be great to be able to copy an entry and paste it to the other user (esp for meals!)

• Amounts/Doses: 
Currently I can only see the dose/amount I took if I open up the medication/entry. It would be very helpful to be able to see this from the day-view. 

• Cloud Option: 
This should be backed up to the cloud regularly rather than manual backup thru email.

I like the app and will continue to use it, but it really needs iCloud sync. Maybe I’m not a typical user, but I literally use five different iOS devices throughout the day. It’s a pain to drop the device I’m using to find my phone. There are gaps in my data because I don’t always have the device with mySymptoms on it.
Love it! I use it every day!

I downloaded the app because it was rated as a top allergy diary. I realized it’s just a list for you to add. Not only that, how are you suppose to enter chicken soup made from scratch with a barcode?? I have doubts about their perfect 5 star reviews.

reviews.t: Like how I can add custom tags but export option needs work
reviews.b: Like how I can add custom tags and export option!  Only gripe is the csv export adds multiple columns when you have more than one item per type. Such as adding multiple symptoms at once.  It should add new rows, not columns.  Makes the csv unusable and spent long time cleaning up the data.

reviews.t: Would Be a Great App if it Synched
reviews.b: After spending tedious time inputting diurnal food and dietary supplements that I take on my iPad I learned that this application does not such with my other devices. The Company processed synching over a year ago. Without synching, it is worthless.
Great App.  Wish I could keep up logging my info and not do it intermittently. But that’s my problem, not the app’s.
This is easy to use and has lots of things to document. Really gives the whole view of lifestyle.
Very easy to use. Love the charts for correlation, though I have not yet found one unfortunately

reviews.t: Lacking a moderately extensive library of food & missing ethnic foods
reviews.b: I purchased this app to help track my diet for possible food intolerance because I really liked the idea of the ease of scanning a barcode to automatically add what I ate. (I usually don't pay for apps, I thought the convince was worth ~$3.) The issue though is that the amount of foods logged and connected to a barcode is not that impressive. Almost every food I've scanned, I've had to create my own instance of... On top of that there are not many "ethnic" foods already existing in the food library which is a real bummer. I am not sure I will continue using the app b/c it's ended up really time consuming to log every food.

I like that the symptoms can be rated 1-10, and you can create, edit and sort your own symptoms. I love that in addition to tracking food, water intake, sleep and symptoms you have the ability to track energy levels, sleep, water, bowel movements, stressors and environment, and others. The bar code reader is amazing and the database learns them if they weren’t identified before. I still haven’t found whatever is affecting me but I think the App deserves 9/10.

I just started using this up two days ago and so far I am extremely impressed. Still learning my way around it, but it is very user-friendly and incredibly well put together.
Thank you!

I never have been able to get myself to do this kind of tracking before and the app is making the difference. And when I thought the app was missing something and reviewed it here, saying so, the dev got back to me with help right away. Turns out the app had what I needed all along. Great app, great support. Thanks!

I love this app. My only complaint is that it doesn’t sync with my fitness pal. My dream app would do both-track micros and symptoms so I wouldn’t have to track twice -I know-I’m so needy! that is a feature i would pay for :) Otherwise it’s a great app!
So far looks promising, but I was surprised to see many symptoms missing. Gas regular/foul/excessive, GI cramp (separate from stomachache) , Reflux

I’ve been using this app for over a year and it’s been great! I’ve tried many other similar type apps and this one is by far the easiest and most useful. If you have health issues I highly recommend this app.

Excellent way to keep track of what I eat instead of just trying to memorize everything I did.
I wish they would add a line for weight as I weigh myself each morning to also track that.
Other than that, it works fine. It’s cumbersome at times to type in the food - but no-mater what app you use you would still have to do that.
Since my phone is with me all the time it’s way easier than carrying a notebook and writing everything down. I love the way it orders events when you adjust the time.

reviews.t: I am not convinced it works
reviews.b: I was drinking a protein shake every morning with 3 or so ingredients in it and like clockwork, I’d have an upset stomach 30 minutes later. Obviously, it was something in my protein shake, yet the app missed it or claims those ingredients had a low chance of being the culprit.  Aside from that, it claims “fruit” is my number one culprit for every single symptom that’s logged with “high confidence” but I’ve never logged “fruit.” I have logged frozen cherries, avocado, and banana- but all of those specific ingredients, while being “fruit,” show only medium to low probability. So I’m not even sure how it is coming up with that? The concept it great though and I hope over time, the algorithm gets better.

reviews.t: Really wanted to love this app!
reviews.b:
***updated*** Giving this app another try after learning how to add new items. Will update my review when I see how it works. I have high hopes!
I am so disappointed. I was really hoping this app would help me but it doesn’t allow you to add ingredients and since it is missing even common ingredients such as green onions (not listed under scallions either).  I have to follow the Autoimmune Protocol diet and it very restricted. I am forced to eat and cook with lots of ingredients not in the app. This wouldn’t be problem if I could add ingredients but there isn’t any way to do so.

I downloaded three apps to manage IBS and this is the least bendable in adding foods throughout day, the options of including other aspects of IBS (BMs, stress, anatomical) not part of this app or is easy to access. And I have a masters degree in information.
It’s packed with features that you’ll discover after you’ve tracked your food and symptoms for a while. The analysis it does is awesome.
Am I charged every month for this app or is it a one time charge?
This app has been extremely helpful for tracking my food and symptoms to help me make connections. It's easy to use also.

This app makes it easy to record everything I eat. The bar code scanning brings  up most brands I buy. It predicts the foods as I begin to type based on the time of day and frequently eaten foods. When I forget to record something, it’s easy to modify previous days entries. The analysis tools seem helpful, although I have only recorded a week of data so far, so there aren’t strong trends...which is what I’d expect. Great app!

I wanted an app to help me with FODMAP elimination and trigger identification. I have used My Fitness Pal in the past to help keep a general food diary. When that app was new, it was free as users helped create its database, now arguably the most comprehensive. 
This app’s food database is lacking and the method for entering foods or a recipe is frustrating. I cannot understand why you have to manually enter every item that is in thirds of the unit of measure. You cannot repeat medications or meals simply. Frankly, this app would not be a bargain even if it was free.

Great app! Very useful for someone like me with IBS who needs to pay attention to what I eat, and the reaction to my body. Also useful for weight loss and just being mindful of what’s going on in your body for overall health.

This is the best app. I have in’s and I use this to track my foods. It does such a great job. I love how you can track symptoms, medications, and bowel movement. It is great for everyone. It is not just an app for staying fit and losing weight, it is for everyone!

I don’t think I have ever reviewed an app but I’m so pleasantly surprised with this that I actually wanted to. First of all, the app is very easy to use in my opinion and I love that it allows you to add ingredients to a food. I don’t think I have ever found an app that I LOVE without having to pay extra to unlock some service or having ads pop up every 30 seconds. This app doesn’t have that at all! All of the features are fully accessible and that’s what I appreciate the most, otherwise I wouldn’t be writing this review. I also love that it does not track calories. The app is overall a great means of finding out what makes your body happy and what does not ☺️
Works Great and Very helpful for Daily Journal!!

First time I have reviewed an app because this one is so necessary for anyone with chronic health issues. It is the most robust, flexible and sophisticated option for tracking symptoms and getting analytics to help you find correlations. As with anything like this, the data is only as good as what you enter, e.g. to get really good data, you have to keep religiously entering information when you’re not having symptoms. 

I really hope they continue to improve the app and add more automation. I would especially like to see options to import data from Apple Health, Watch and other apps, e.g. automatic logging of environment events based on location and weather data. Nonetheless, it’s a phenomenal app and very helpful if you are diligent about data entry.

I love this app because I can track just about anything. With IBS-C, it can be very difficult to pin down what causes flare-ups, and while I JUST started using it, I can already see some interesting correlations in just a few days of tracking. The “Other” category is really important, too, because I can use it to track things like where I am in my cycle, or when I ride public transit (which can give me motion sickness as times). I’d ask the developers to include a way for women to track the very basics of their cycles because of how much it can relate to digestive symptoms, but I understand you can’t add everything to one app, and again, I can just use the “Other” category. Looking forward to the day that more foods are added to the database, but I’m happy to be contributing as I go!
Such a helpful app.  Thank you for listening & updating to be able to customize the PDF reports.  This App keeps getting better & better

reviews.t: Communication with doc so much better
reviews.b: I was going to try to make a spreadsheet that would do all this. Thank goodness I didn’t have to! I am using the ap to manage Crohn’s symptoms and food intake to share with my doc as we adjust meds. This is such an important and helpful tool. I am so grateful and appreciate the reasonable price.

Maybe I’m just dense, but the first 3 or 4 items I looked for weren’t in the database.    I was looking for generic terms like roast beef, French roll, etc.   I had the app on my phone for all of 3 minutes before I deleted it.

It has been a real struggle for me to properly keep track of my symptoms and what I've eaten plus when I take my medications. I couldn't be more impressed with this app, my favorite feature is the unlimited amount of symptoms you can track. I've purchased other apps where they give you a maximum amount of symptoms, such as 5. Then they require you to pay more to upgrade. It's ridiculous. 
Thank you for making my life so much easier, and for helping me and my doctor keep track of my life.

If you are trying to manage a lot of symptoms (or even a few) this is the best app I’ve found for helping to figure out and identify the causes of common digestive and stress related problems. 

The database of food items is quick and easy to use/add and they have a barcode scanner to quickly log things.
This is perfect! I’ve already discovered another possible food sensitivity, which means everything to me! Thank you!

App looks to have great features.  Two issues in first 5 minutes prevented input of daily data.
Submitted issues report.

There are problems though.  Their food database is very limited.  I admit I haven’t used it religiously and would probably like it more, if I did, but the food database is so limited that I find it easier to log food and notes into the MyFitnessPal app.  Obviously the problem there is the whole or main purpose for this app, which is to find out what’s making you sick.  I will use it more frequently when they upgrade the database.

reviews.t: I was recently diagnosed with IBS and this is a life saver.
reviews.b:
This app is so easy to use and well worth the money. The attention to detail, speed and fluidity of the app is excellent, and it is sooo easy to personalize. And the fact that it spits out a beautiful PDF  is amazing!!! I had to wait to see the dietician for a while after my diagnosis but she was very impressed with the PDF.  It has most every food, but can’t find a couple things when I enter them. 

Not to be too cheesy..... this app helped me feel less alone and less embarrassed to talk about poop because clearly other people have to deal with digestive issues too. Great app! Thank you for making it!!
Absolutely love using this app! It’s a must get!
This app is just what I needed! I am 60 yo woman who is not computer savvy so it took a few days of entry to figure it all out. Exceeded my expectations.

This app is perfect for tracking my sons symptoms.My naturalpath loves to see view it to know how to adjust his supplements and where to go next with his treatment  thank you for this app it’s made life for this special needs momma easier
I have tried several. This one is the best.

U have to include more items on the menu
I have had to add my own items but I’m not sure what to put forball the entry areas when it shows that page?

I don't ever review apps, so that should say something about how great this one is! It's very easy to use and the reports are great for showing a doctor your symptoms! I wish there were more things in the database but that will come once more people use the app. I highly recommend for anyone needing to keep a food journal. I have tried COUNTLESS apps and notebooks but this is the only one that I actually kept up.

Please add snap a photo option, it will help a lot. Also the email myself a PDF function is great. I bring my weekly report to my dr to adjust my diet and food allergy. It will much better if it also print out the ingredients of the food, otherwise there is no point to record the ingredients if it can't be printed out.

I’m A private chef for a woman who has severe food allergies that change on a regular basis. I’ve been trying to figure out a good way to log food and keep track of reactions.  There is a little learning curve to learning this app.  I did feel the instructions weren’t completely understandable.  Is there there away to sync 2 users of iPhones to the same diary without using iTunes?
Easy to use!

reviews.t: Easy way to track patterns between food and illness
reviews.b: Great app, easy to track food and symptoms. Wish it could pair with Fitbit or MyFitnessPal because they show a lot more info about tracking food but not as easy of a way to track your symptoms.
This app is very flexible to track the symptoms that I want to track!  The best app available for troubleshooting dietary sensitivities!
I am deleting this app as I can’t seem to actually enter anything in spite of reading the quick start and the user guide

Love this app to track foods and symptoms. The pdf report is an awesome feature. Have not used it long enough (only a few days) to get reliable information correlating foods with symptoms but fully expect that feature to be useful based on what I’ve seen so far.

Only holding back 5 stars because there isn’t an easy way to trend symptoms ie graphical representation over time of number or features of bowel movements/ symptoms. This would be very useful in tracking IBD flares.

reviews.t: Perfect app for what I need it for!
reviews.b: I was recently diagnosed with gastroparesis, a chronic and awful condition where your stomach doesn’t work the way it’s supposed to and food is delayed from Emptying into your intestines due to lack of motility. Was told to write down the foods I eat and symptoms they cause. To keep a journal. So I went searching for an app so I could do it on my phone as that is much easier than lugging around a notebook. I was delighted when I found this app. I thought maybe I would find an app that came a little close but that I would have to repurpose it for my need. But this app is exactly what I needed. It’s wonderful. And I love that I can track medications as well since we are having to try different ones. And then the PDF that I can send to my doctor or print out is just the bees knees. Thank you a million times for making this app. It’s awesome. I may recommend it to my fellow friends in an online support group I’m a part of. 10K Strong. I bet they will love this app as much as I do. 💜💜💜🤗🙏🙌👾👽😻

I appreciate the amount of work that has gone into this app. Have only been using a few weeks but have been religiously logging my events and outcomes. Love how you can adjust the parameters and see correlations. That would be great if there were an online app and all instances of the app would sync across platforms. Otherwise, hats off top the developers - it beats having to enter all the information in a spread sheet - this is a timesaver!

reviews.t: Need more measurement options when adding recipes
reviews.b: I like the app overall, but there needs to be more options when adding recipes to the database.

reviews.t: None of my food is in your database
reviews.b: Glad to add my wholesome choices to the database to support the app. Easy to add items. Hope you continue to develop the product as it has great potential.

Nice to keep track of food and symptoms but not the easiest way to go about it. Developers don’t want to figure out a way to make searching easier despite everyone complaining about the same issue. 

Analytics is lacking substance.

Can’t actually SEND an email PDF of diary because the word “send” is grayed out. This is the same for sending an email to request help.  

I wasted sooo much time getting this set up for my symptoms and foods. With no ability to share with my doc, this is useless.

So happy I found this app!  5 stars all the way!  Previously I was keeping track of my food intake on a google doc to figure out some health issues.  This app actually makes it fun to keep track of your symptoms and general mood all day long.  It’s brought a lot of awareness around my food choices and subsequent mood shifts.  I love that this app doesn’t count calories.  It’s so much more interesting to remove the concept of high or low calories and just focus on how a certain food makes you feel!  Way more intuitive than tedious calorie counting.  I think using this app will lead to weight loss although it’s not the primary intent of the app.

I really like this app because I’ve been trying to figure out a good way to monitor some stomach issues and my migraines.
I love that with a few clicks, I can have my symptoms, intensity and so much else right there, timestamped for review.
I use this along with a photo journal where I track my food, and between the two I’m covered so I can be healthier and feel better.
My wish list is only to have a photo food log here, too. Aside from that I’m glad I got this.

With multiple food allergies causing a wide range of symptoms it is been hard for me to track which food is affecting me and which symptom is linked to which food. This app helps a lot. It was difficult at first to record and track foods and symptoms and to interpret the analysis. Eventually it becomes easier but at first it is a steep learning curve. Is this app perfect? No but it does steer me in the right direction and it’s easier than recording all this info by hand on reams of paper.

Great app. Easy to add foods, and a wide selection are already included. 

Should add “gas” as a symptom. Need to add spell check/auto correct on food options. Adding food isn’t super intuitive, but it wasn’t too difficult. 

This would be fantastic if it added the nutritional values and could track that too. (like a My Fitness Pal). Combine the two so the user isn’t entering what they eat into two different apps.

I'm writing a review in the hope that the maker will notice and fix this one problem. When you go to enter notes on any entry in the diary section, you cannot see the note you are typing. It is only visible after you click done. PLEASE find a way to fix this annoying error in an otherwise very nice program!

This is the first time I’ve EVER reviewed an app, because it’s the first
time I’ve ever been so impressed!  The functionality is amazing— so much more than you’d expect for an inexpensive little app.  The ability to toggle on/off certain configurations / ways the algorithm works / analysis period to find top suspects— is evidence of the care and pride into this app.  I could not believe when I went on vacation, the times of each entry changed for that day, so I didn’t have to do any more work (ie, pretending to be on a different timezone that day) so my “X hours after” ingestion values weren’t wrecked— it just worked, without any human adjustment needed!  Clearly someone has thought long and hard about every scenario, and taken steps to address it in the app.  I think the ability to either create a new recipe or replace all previous instances of the recipe with your new entry is essential, and without it, I doubt the results would ever be accurate.  Basically I’m blown away by this app!!!!  I should note that I find technology intuitive in general.  If you want a more beginner’s app, and you’re willing to trade functionality for ease of learning the app, maybe you’d want to choose a different one.  Personally I’m so glad I didn’t.  This app rocks!!!

It’s a great app, I️ like that you can track bowel movements and other symptoms, such as headaches, which are a huge problem for me. 

The reason that I’m not going to keep using this app is that when I scan an item 95% of the time it comes up as not in the system and I don’t have the time to type in all of the ingredients on every item that I scan because there are so many freaking ingredients in everything. Unfortunately it just takes all the convenience out of this app, unlike an app like MyFitnessPal, which will scan 99% of everything. I’m going to keep the app for now and then come back in a couple months to see if this has been fixed.

I like the app and initially thought it would be limited, but have been pleasantly surprised by how much is covered as far as the ability to track. You do have to input a lot, but that doesn’t bother me..I was already doing that, but a lot of what I’ve input is now available data. 

My biggest complaint is the lack of sync between devices. I have the app on more than one, but data only appears on one. Not going to input twice and doing backups constantly is a pain that only allows for one way transfers.

This app is helping me track food sensitivities, and it does seem to be helping. I’m still learning how to read the analysis portion (can be a little confusing, but there’s some solid info it provides), and I’m definitely starting to see patterns and what foods have been causing symptoms. No definite answers yet, but it has led me to a couple paths to try following! Support was quick to answer when I had a suggestion, I’m guessing they’d be be questions as well...

reviews.t: Unable to synchronize data between devices
reviews.b:
I just started using the app, and I like it.  It's a bit clumsy to input some of the data needed, but a lot of info is in their database.  The stuff that's not takes a bit of a learning curve to create, and its done ONE STEP AT A TIME.  But I'm betting that once the majority of info is inputted, it will be much easier for me.
My biggest grip, at this time, is that i can't synchronize my data between my iphone and ipad. I just (maybe stupid on my part) assumed that I would be able to use whichever device is handy to input my data.  And I DEFINITELY TO NOT WANT TO INPUT NEW DATA TWICE!!.
I emailed the company about this issue and will get back to this review to update it when I get their response.
Besides that, I believe it to be (while initially clumsy to get data into the database that is not presently there) a good app that will help me figure out the foods and symptoms correlation.

I have Crohn’s disease and am now adjusting to living with about 3ft fewer intestines than I’m used to. I’ve had to make some major diet and lifestyle changes and this app has helped me keep track of it all.

It can be tedious to enter in every little thing, but eventually, it starts to remember things you do regularly so it gets faster as you continue to use it. Helps me figure out what is causing my symptoms. Thanks for making it!

reviews.t: Exactly what I was looking for
reviews.b: I bought this app a few years ago and at the time thought it was merely ok and subsequently forgot about it. But rediscovered it when I needed to start a food/symptom/sleep/&c diary for a doctor and was delighted to find that it had evolved into exactly the app I wanted when I originally purchased it. Simple interface but comprehensive tracking capabilities without calorie counting or other nonsense. Well done.

I really wish that I had read more of the reviews and just not looked at the overall rating. I downloaded this anticipating that it would be somewhat like my fitness pal or the like. Unfortunately the database food seems to be so meager that just for my breakfast alone I spent several minutes trying to type in various ingredients. Breakfast wasn’t anything crazy! It was a Starbucks coffee and a turkey bacon sandwich. The diary supposed to make this tracking of food and symptoms easy. Instead I’m spending a majority of the time entering ingredients. Very disappointed. Would not recommend unless the makers of the app are able to substantially increase the database of available food and ingredients. You’d probably be better served by making your own Excel spreadsheet and analyzing from there for now.
Has been so helpful! Just wish you could upload pics

reviews.t: A little tough to figure out at first; but it became easier
reviews.b: Now that I’m using it it’s okay There are some things that are hard to figure out!!

I was diagnosed with celiac disease two years ago. Even though I maintain a strict gluten-free diet, I am still having issues and sensitivities. After two weeks of tracking all of my food, medication, symptoms, and other details with this app, I have identified a couple of foods that are causing me issues, even though they’re labeled gluten free. I have not use the analytics yet, but just using the app and paying attention has made it much easier for me to identify what is going on and my reactions. Although it took me a couple days to understand the easiest process to add food, now that I’ve gotten the hang of it I think it’s quite easy compared to writing it all by hand (which I’ve tried to do several times in the past always given up due to the time it took). Some foods to need to be added to the database but obviously the more people do so, the better the database gets, the easier it is to use. I really like that you can scan barcodes to add package foods quickly; and, that the ingredients can be listed. It’s great that they’ve added things like mood and exercise as well, since I easily forget how much my mood and energy levels can be affected by my diet. I was informed when I inquired that the developers are working on apple health integration. I’m looking forward to being able to print out the PDF of all of the information I’ve been tracking and bringing it to my G.I. specialist and being able to get a nutritionist now that I have information for them to work with. And, curious to see how the analytics work. Overall, a great app for those in need of one to help them figure out their diet and what is causing issues in their health. -celiacceline
I love this app.  It has all the features we needed to identify a food intolerance for my son. I highly recommend this app for anyone starting to explore food allergies or intolerance.

Everything more or less manageable. However, this thing doesn’t send reports as promised. The button “send” doesn’t work. So I can’t even report and issue. Tried everything, still doesn’t work. That’s the only reason I spent money on this app :(

Some standard foods (like vermicili noodles) aren't in their database, but they have some others that are unusual (like hake, a type of fish).  I would actually pay for this app if it allowed me to scan barcodes and it auto-populated all of the ingredients.  It can be time consuming to do so.

I got this app so I could keep a diary of food, symptoms, and mood. It's just right and will help my nutritionist and I use some real data to make sense of things. The only thing I might change is the ability to track fat, calories, etc. Really though, it's been a great tool.

reviews.t: Not integrated with Health data - nuff said
reviews.b: I find the app to be a bit cumbersome- especially in the area of entering foods. Can I suggest the app be simplified by just having it share data with other Apple Health apps?  Enter a food in some other app, enter other detail in mySymptoms and both show up in Apple Health!  Guess I’ll go back to looking for an app that does this and regret the loss of $2.99.

I like this app a lot! It has a lot of different factors you can add like, food, supplements, sleep, and a lot more. I have tried to keep food diaries in the past but having to hand write everything is very annoying. I started using it not too long ago so I'm not sure how the actual graph and everything will work but so far I'm super happy with it!

reviews.t: Wish I didn't get this app
reviews.b: Tried to find a food diary and symptom diary to keep track during my FODMAPs diet. This was the first one I found so I got it. DON'T PURCHASE THIS APP. The UI is VERY confusing, and took me time to figure out how to use. I had to manually enter every single one of my foods and supplements, because somehow their database didn't have basic items like Oolong Tea and Probiotics. I lost my progress a bunch of times because of the confusing UI (it slows you to enter another food at the same time as you're filling out fields to enter a different food. Totally unnecessary and just makes it confusing). The design on the check items makes no sense (you're only allowed to press the literal check, and not the entire line or the name of the food). The tutorial was useless an didn't help me get a first grasp on the usability of the app. SAVE YOUR TIMR AND MONEY and download Cara instead. I found it after not believing this **** is the best thing out there and was so surprised to find a good app for free to do the exact same thing. If the app developers want to get it together they should run a user group and hire a real UI/UX designer instead of trying to build an app without paying attention to the inbox and user. Boooooo.
I love this app. It's great for easily tracking food, medications, exercises and symptoms.

There's a few other good options out there, but if you want comprehensive body tracking – everything from symptoms to what you eat – this app is for you. 

It's not the prettiest to look at, and doesn't have any Apple Health integration as of yet, but I'm hoping it will be updated soon. 

All in all, it's still a 5-star app in my book. Excellent work devs!
Helps manage my IBS.  Analysis tools help me determine what foods cause the most issues.

I have severe Ulcerative Colitis and struggle with flares and keeping my diet strictly in line.  My doctors have been advising me to keep a food and symptom journal for years.  This is so much easier to just plug in the details and not have to re-write everything down or try to remember.  It has helped me be more detailed in what I record and figure out patterns based on what I am eating and the results.  It has also been very helpful when seeing my doctors or staying in the hospital to be able to give exact info.
