Clicking on the "review report" crashes the app. Totally and utterly useless and a COMPLETE waste of time, energy, and money. I can't even go back to look at what I entered.  DO NOT spend the money on this worthless app.

I wanted an app that would let me easily look up the FODMAP status of ingredients. I tried 9 different apps, everything I could find in the App Store that seemed relevant, mostly paid apps.

This app provides ingredient lookups through its Guide section. The information is excellent, with not only a simple "thumbs up or down" rating but details on specific triggers and portion sizes. 

I go to this app first. I trust the information. It's authoritative. It covers as many ingredients as most other apps, and the information is well structured and easy to understand.

Previous versions of this app had a disappointing and frustrating search experience. But that's been corrected now -- searching for ingredients in the Guide works as it should. Thanks to the developer(s) for fixing that.

There are still some irksome search issues. As noted in another review, if you search for Coffee (for example) you won't find it. Coffee is a category, and within it you'll find entries like "Instant". The problem here isn't with the search function, but with the data. If "Instant" just included its category name -- "Coffee, Instant" -- I assume all would work as it should. Alternatively, a search for "Coffee" could show everything within that category, as well as every food item with "Coffee" in its name.

But overall, this is definitely an important resource for anyone cooking with FODMAP restrictions.

reviews.t: No fruits and vegetables in my app
reviews.b: What do I do? Not helpful if I can't get the most out of this expensive app

It's a university; I get it. They are researchers, not app developers; I get it. But this is an EXPENSIVE app with an almost useless search function. Try searching for coffee. Nothing? Exactly. That's because "Coffee" is a category, and the actual entry is "Instant," etc. 

Also, there are so many more food items than are included. Plantain? Nope. Yogurt?Nope. (Oh, wait . . . it's only under "yoghurt." They'll gladly take your 9 bucks, but don't account for alternative spellings.)  

This app is minimally handy, and everything here can be found on the internet.

reviews.t: Yes, it really IS worth it.
reviews.b: I've been using this all week. If you need it, you would pay at least 100 times the price for the amount of help it gives. It contains a wealth of information and it is easy to find and understand. Go for it!

This app is completely worth the money if you legitimately need to follow a low fodmap diet. Monash University tests foods in their lab to assess their fodmap contents and levels. The app is constantly updated with accurate info as they test new foods, UNLIKE faulty info posted on the internet. I tried to follow the diet based on website info but most is outdated and contradicts other info posted online. The app gives you accurate food serving amounts and peace of mind! It came highly recommended by my registered dietician and all proceeds from the app go directly back to funding more food testing. You will not regret this purchase.

The app jams up every time I use the food search. The cancel button in the search section does not work forcing you to close out of the app and restart it. Also foods show up in recipes that are not part of food search, bacon for example.

App contains information easily found on the internet for free. For $7 I'd expect it to at least sync between devices but it doesn't even do that, if I add data to the app on my phone it doesn't show on my iPad. No vegetarian, gluten free or vegan recipes, in fact the recipe section is extremely small with some recipes missing instructions. No barcode scanner, no syncing, poor recipe selection, just a few features that a $7 app should have.

reviews.t: APP is poorly built, diet is bogus
reviews.b: I have never been so sick in my life as when I try to use the recipes from this app. In addition, many of the recipes are missing instructions. It's also quite confusing to figure out what you need because everything is in metric units only. They use strange words to refer to some simple foods like green peppers. Also, there is no meal plan. You might actually eat too much of a FODMAP in a day by combining recipes. Many of the recipes are very complicated, and take a lot of time to make. I would recommend following another diet and using another app to achieve it

This is the only app I've ever bought and it was worth the $7-8. For the first time in over a year I feel normal thanks to the guidance on this app. IBS is frustrating and the internet has a lot of weak or wrong information. This app isn't perfect but provides the information I need to make proper meal decisions. 

It helps that the app differentiates between the different fodmaps thus allowing me to determine which areas I'm most sensitive to. 

The only con is that they have limited references to American foods but I can figure it out by reading labels on the food items. 

Thanks to the creators of this app!  I was really frustrated for a long time and now I have control of my symptoms. Keep the updated info coming!

Highly recommend this to any IBS sufferers.

reviews.t: Would love a bar code scanner
reviews.b: I just started using this and it looks very helpful. It would be an amazing if it could incorporate a bar code scanner for prepared food. FYI, I'm from the U.S. Thanks
I am so sorry that I purchased this. There are definitely better and more complete resources available. It has very limited info on many foods and is not helpful for cooking, shopping or eating out.

I love this app immensely! 

Please correct the spelling of plantain though - it's spelled "plaintain" on the app. 

Many thanks!!!

My son and I are glucose intolerant and this app helps a lot. 
I wish they would update the list more often and add more food (like papaya...).
Also the search does not work. 
There is conflicting info in this app and the basic sheet I got from the dr. (Like broccoli and eggplant) which is confusing.

reviews.t: Good app but should be more affordable
reviews.b: There are many ingredient and recipes which are not from US, the app should be more convenient for the country you are using for! The price is high in relation to the product. There are many ideas and suggestions we can find just looking in internet Instead of using this app! I recommend not pay for this app $8 us, is better just looking information for free in internet! Hopefully the developer considers this and  change the price!

The concept of FODMAPs is new to me as of the last month; my doctor informed me of them and the elimination diet, and she strongly recommended I download this app. I'm so glad I did! I wouldn't be able to do this diet without it.

The low FODMAP Diet can feel overwhelming... but this app makes it much less so! Is it worth the price? Heck yes! I rarely buy apps, but this was a great purchase. I use it nearly every grocery store trip I go on, as well as frequently at home. 
This app is designed by people who are actually doing the testing on foods regarding FODMAP content... there's a lot of contradicting info out there but that's why it's good to have this app, because it's from the people actually doing the research, so you can always go here to get the actual, factual, accurate info. 
I'm very much looking forward to the next update :-)

This app is well done, the rating system is very intuitive.  It has help me tremendously to identify foods and has improved my symptoms very much.  Wish that it was adapted better to US market.  Thanks very good app.

reviews.t: My favorite and best app for all things FODMAP
reviews.b: Thank you to the researchers and designers who built this useful tool. It deserves much higher ratings. I appreciate the updates. I use this app all the time and it has improved my health.

Concept of the app is brilliant but it’s not well executed when it comes to the recipes. I understand it’s still in the beta phase at this point. I will save a recipe that has a green positive rating in accordance with my dietary restrictions, then save another recipe with almost the exact same ingredients and get a red mark meaning it doesn’t fit my restrictions. Then there is no explanation as to why certain ingredients are fine, but put in another dish suddenly aren’t. A few aspects of the app are frustrating but overall I hope to see it improve.

I’ve really enjoyed using the Fig app! 💜 It has truly helped me become more intentional about the foods I purchase and put into my body. I especially love being able to scan products and quickly see whether they fit my personal food preferences without having to spend so much time researching every ingredient.

Fig has introduced me to so many products and has made grocery shopping a lot less stressful. I appreciate having that extra guidance right at my fingertips, and I’ve learned so much along the way. 💜

Overall, I’m very thankful for Fig and the help it has provided me. It’s a great tool for anyone who wants to be more mindful and informed about the foods they’re choosing. 💜

The information is not accurate. There are foods listed incorrectly as either high/low FODMAP when they are the opposite. It’s giving Wikipedia/AI with half truths based on data it’s pulling from the internet vs with trained FODMAP dietitians. 
Lists highly-processed foods as low FODMAP whilst organic options with much fewer ingredients are listed as high FODMAP.
Fig makes shopping with multiple food allergies and dietary restrictions so much easier. I love being able to quickly scan a product and see if it works for my family.

I’ve been using this app for a couple of years now, no problems. Then all of a sudden the app is completely reset, requiring me to start over from the beginning. None of my previous preferences are saved. Not cool.

reviews.t: Great app!  Hard to get a hold of devs.
reviews.b:
I have tried contacting Fig 3 times about features that would help with UI and help with not automatically opening the scanner and having a option to make another tab the home where the app opens.  Dark mode with black background and white text would help immensively as I have eye strain from my eye disease.

The contact section seems to not work as intended as I do receive a email saying that it was received but the first time I did it I waited weeks to resend my feedback.

Otherwise this app does well with its functions and I love the additions and all the updated database for diets and health conditions.  I am looking forward to more updates and possibly those features being added and fixed.  🍊
I downloaded Fig after learning I had several food sensitivities. This app has helped me tremendously with find foods I can eat in grocery stores and at restaurants.

I’m pleased to say that I finally found a scanner app that actually works! Going grocery shopping is no longer a hassle because I have Fig in my pocket always reliably there to keep me in check. Try fig out, you won’t regret it.
This app has not only  helped me find packaged foods I can eat but has amazing recipes as well.
This app has been so helpful with my change in diet. Cutting out things you can’t eat anymore for health reasons is already tough, but Fig makes it so much easier.
This app is not helpful or nor does it have a deep database. They want YOU to build the database for them.

I got this app because I was put on milk and soy restrictions when nursing with infant. This app helped me quickly identify foods that I couldn’t have which was a huge time saver when learning how to read labels.

I recently needed to contact customer service and they responded in less than 24 hours and were able to resolve my issue.

Highly recommend!

reviews.t: Will charge you $69.99 even when canceled DO NOT GET THIS APP!!!!!
reviews.b: I’m on the phone with my bank right now as a type this. My subscription was canceled on September 10th why they have tried to pull $69.99 out of my accounts 5 times since then!!! So much so that my banks fraud department contacted me on the 11th stating that they try to pull out another payment and the description of the charge say trial end! My bank assured me that it wouldn’t happen again considering they thought it was a glitch and then that’s why it probably is not going through! Flash forward now this morning September 18th they pulled the money out of my account and the payment description says the same thing trial end!  So now I’m disputing fraud charges because my subscription was canceled and the bank let me know that this is not the second or third time they tried to pull this from your account. It happened a total of five times so five times they have been in the background, trying to pull this money from my account! DON’T GET THIS APP GUYS. YOU GUYS JUST READ AND EDUCATE YOURSELF ON NUTRITIONAL VALUE. IT SEEMS LIKE A GOOD THING AT FIRST UNTIL YOU’RE TRYING TO CANCEL IT AND IT’S TRYING TO PULL THAT MUCH MONEY OUT OF YOUR ACCOUNT.

Just recently got diagnosed with celiac disease and struggled to find good foods that fit within my diet. This app genuinely changed everything I feel safer at the grocery store the scanning makes it so much easier to shop!

I developed and allergy to certain foods and with this app I now can eat certain foods without second guessing myself. I absolutely love it and recommend it to everyone. You can even get recipes and find restaurants that accommodate your dietary needs.
I’ve noticed after scanning foods and double checking ingredients, the app actively displays ingredients that are not listed.
It helps me to easier understand what I should be eating and the easily read and marked warnings help

Having dietary needs, means many struggles with trying to find out what’s safe to eat and where is safe to eat. But Fig makes it so much easier to read ingredient labels that I may not catch or words that I may not recognize but still may be bad for me.
I love Fig+ as someone who has severe food allergies it’s wonderful to have a tool to help determine what’s safe to eat! Thank you fig!

I was diagnosed with a gluten sensitivity this year and this app has been so helpful in navigating my dietary changes. Being able to scan or look up items to double check if a food is safe has been a game changer! I’m so grateful for this app.
This helps so much with grocery shopping and knowing what I can eat.
This app may save me from having severe reactions
Love this app very good

reviews.t: Fig app is good until you go to pay for it, very shady and a scam
reviews.b: I had the Fig app for several years with very few complaints until this month of 2026. I received a special offer to renew for $29.99 -5 dollars off if you set it up with a bank card. I thought,  I’m saving money so why not. I started the process and when I clicked to renew it said it’s charging me $34.99 with no mention of the $5 off I was to get. They charged me $10 more than what the renewal special was listed for. I tried to contact them by email, three times over the course of two weeks with no replies. There is no phone number to call them so you’re only means of communication is email but they don’t answer your emails so what is a customer to do? They left me no choice, but to get a hold of the bank and report them for fraud. They need to get their act together if they want to keep loyal customers. Cannot recommend!!!
Not very effective. Charges $60 and puts you in the auto subscribe that is impossible to get out of. Support is none existent. Always says they’re sorry but never do anything.

Had trouble with somethings in the app and the team was absolutely incredible! Responsive, kind, considerate, and willing to help. They genuinely care about their customers which is so refreshing to see and of course the app is very helpful for people struggling with dietary restrictions!

This app is probably the most helpful I’ve found when it comes to navigating alpha gal syndrome. They understand that it’s more than just a meat allergy and that is truly appreciated!! I can’t say enough good things about this app and the online support that is being put out there for this fairly new syndrome (new to my state and new to me). It makes shopping a lot easier and less stressful, I’ve also been able to save some cash in the store :) Thank you Fig!!!

reviews.t: Just don’t agree to the free trial…that you have to agree to.
reviews.b: Ok, the actual app is fine. The frustration is how they force you into the free trial. I know, you’re like “you mean like every other site and app ever?” Nope. So, you go through the onboarding process, enter all the allergies, etc. Then at the end of the onboarding, they want you to sign up for their seven day free trial. Fine. But to avoid Apple taking a cut of the fees, they take you into the browser and have you complete it via Apple Pay. It brings you into the app and you start using it, tada! You don’t realize the fatal error that’s just occurred. They now have you locked into a free trial and you don’t have an account. So, you come back an hour later, the session on the app has ended….and nothing has saved and you can’t access your free trial. You also can’t cancel it through Apple subscriptions because they took you out of the app. You eventually can cancel the subscription by using the email used on your Apple Pay on their stripe portal, but you might be so frustrated by the end that you’ll write a review
i love this app! i have been trying to eat healthier and this app has helped me so much in knowing where to start !
Time saving tool!
I would pay $3.99/month but $70 is too much

This app really helps you depict what foods you can use to substitute for a healthier life. Tracking is made easier, and you can figure out what ingredients are within the food you own by just taking a picture. Plus restaurants and recipe features. Whether you’re a pescatarian, vegan, or just going on a diet. Ordering and eating are made to be simple.

Very very difficult to cancel subscription. You can’t cancel it through the settings on your phone and it doesn’t seem like you can cancel it through the app either. It seems like the only way you can cancel is by emailing their support. Definitely will not be utilizing any of their services again if they are going to essentially hold their customers hostage

I am very new to having Alpha gal and was recommended this app by a friend who also has it! Not knowing what was safe to eat could have been detrimental to my health, however this app has been absolutely amazing in helping me to learn what is safe or not. Thank you for developing this so that myself and others can learn more!
This is the. Best app ever it helps me keep my daughter safe as a newly diagnosed celiac.
I did the free trail. Only works in store. Can’t check things online. AND WHEN THE TRAIL ENDED CHARGED ME $75!!!!!!
To much $ for little improvements

Fig has helped me on my new diet journey and weaves out all the stuff I should avoid! I love the feature where it allows you to add a product that’s not listed. Great app and encouraging to continue on a healthy journey!

I’ve had this app for several months with the free version. I rarely used it and planned to delete it eventually. I was just charged a subscription fee with no notice that I did not authorize. The app will not allow me to manage the subscription or cancel it in any way, and the only way to contact support is through email with a reply “we will get back to you in a few days.”

It basically redirects you to restaurant websites, what I was already doing before anyway. I’m better off bringing readers to the grocery store and checking myself. When it can’t find a product, it wants me to add it for them. No thanks. Wish I never downloaded it and did the year. Save yourself the $50.
I love this app and this company! 100% ❤️

I have alpha gal and downloaded this because a friend had recommended it to me. Biggest mistake of my month…they charged me $70 for a subscription that I never agreed to through my Apple Pay. I never wanted the subscription nor can I get my money back in any way. I wish I could give a zero star rating but I’m sure they would charge me for that.

My wife was recently diagnosed with Alpha Gal, found this app, and paid for a yearly subscription. It’s great that she can scan the bar code on foods to see if there are unknown allergens. I downloaded it so that when I shop, I can make sure the foods are safe. Apparently I also have to pay a yearly fee to use the app from my phone. I understand paying a yearly fee for the app and I’m fine with it. Not being able to share it across two phones is just straight greed.
Every single item I’ve ever scanned is gone. Now, anytime I scan any item it says not found. Huge scam!

I’ve had stomach sensitivities for as long as I can remember. The Fig app has guided me through a full elimination diet, avoiding new trigger ingredients, and currently LowFODMAP. It’s so customizable, and makes finding food (and more importantly, snacks!) in the store a lot easier. I feel a lot less in the dark on finding what’s safe to eat, and feel a lot more hopeful about navigating new restrictive diets.
This app has been amazing for helping find foods that fit into my diet - so thankful for tools like this!

I am new to food intolerances after getting some specialty bloodwork done, and Fig has made it so easy to identify products that I can/cannot eat. This has saved me so much time searching the shelves for things I can tolerate!

Fig has been a game changer since my endometriosis diagnosis in May, and now needing to stay away from inflammatory foods, Fig makes it so so much easier to find out what is safe for me! I couldn’t be more appreciative of this app have all the features and education it does!
This app makes it super easy to eat if you have restrictions.

This app failed at the one thing it's supposed to do. It repeatedly marked products as safe even though they contained my listed allergen. I wasted money  on products I couldn't use. Thankfully, I have enough common sense to read the ingredient label myself before consuming anything. If I had trusted this app, the outcome could have been much worse.
Paying for a service that can't reliably perform its core function is absurd. From what it looks like, the information relies heavily on user submissions with little meaningful verification. That's not good enough when people's health is involved.
At this point, taking a picture of an ingredient label and asking AI tools to analyze it is more reliable than paying for this app. That's embarrassing.
The app feels less like a legitimate safety tool and more like a passive income stream for “wannabe influencers” who wanted to monetize an idea without putting in the work to make it dependable.
If the developers don't start taking accuracy seriously, then what is the app even useful for ? An app that gives users false reassurance (on several occasions) about allergens isn't just a bad product—it has the potential to lead to serious legal consequences if someone is harmed. Do better.

I would absolutely recommend this app to anyone. I have used it a bunch in the past, it makes grocery shopping so much easier when you’re shopping with a goal in mind. I am not currently in that stage of my life anymore, so I thought I had canceled my Fig+ but hadn’t. I contacted customer service thinking it would be a long shot but they replied and refunded me right away!

We have kids with different allergies, some of them severe. This app has been a lifesaver—sometimes literally! A quick scan tells us if an item off the shelf is likely to cause problems. We love the fact that you can set up different profiles for different people/allergies. 

Just remember: even if the item scans green, double check the ingredients list yourself, especially if your allergy is severe. The app is pretty accurate, but it always pays to double check.

Just a heads up, don’t sign up for the free trial because even if you cancel it before the seven days they will continue to try and swipe the 70$ from your bank account!

I was thankfully able to block the daily attempts from this company trying to swindle 70$ from me but unfortunately even with EMAILING said company, I have NOT found a solution to end the constant harassment of their app trying to charge me daily. 

Normally you would assume if a FREE trial has been prompted to end, that it would end that day and no charges to be made. 
That was not the case here, and in fact it said that it wouldn’t “officially” end until next year.

I refuse to pay and don’t appreciate that canceling doesn’t cancel it. 

I’d love to hear back from my email and have a solution presented, I’m tired of the daily attempted charges.
Writing this review was my last resort.
This app is AMAZING for finding safe foods for my dietary restrictions! This makes grocery shopping so much easier by being able to quickly scan an item and see all the ingredients! 10/10 worth it!!
I am not paying $69.99 a year for information I can get online for free!
Finding this app is a true life saver when dealing with a complicated allergy !!!!! Easy to use and do up to date. Thank you for creating this incredible tool ❤️
There is a completely free version of the same app called yuka

This company is a scam, they make it super hard to cancel so they can charge that 69.99 subscription fee. I cancelled and they still billed me and it says my subscription cancels a year later so now I’m having to wait for a response from their support team through email. Imagine taking someone’s money then not having any other contact information and tell people you’ll get back to them in a few days. You all took $70 out of my account! I want my refund ASAP!!!!!!
Looked like a free app but it costs money. Only offers 7 day trial.
I was having an issue with my subscription and they helped resolve it in 2 days!
The app never lets you properly use the trial period to see if it works. It’s constantly blocks you until you sign up or pay.  Just let us use it. The people that need this will buy it.

I signed up for a trial period, but found that the app was nothing I couldn’t easily do for myself. I was just charged over $60 for a renewal fee and have tried to cancel through my Apple apps but there is no record of it and now have no way to cancel.

reviews.t: No dark mode is an accessibility issue
reviews.b: The lack of dark mode is unacceptable. Otherwise it’s good at what it does.
Great Ap, easy to use! Helped me through an allergy scare and made life more doable!

This app has been great helping me navigate my food restrictions. Super easy to use and has a large amount of products already catalogued. Definitely recommend for those that have dietary restrictions or just want to know more about the products we are using!
They charged me for the annual fee of $70 instead of $3.99 a month. Will not refund.

reviews.t: Would love options for CSID/dissacharidase deficiencies
reviews.b: I really like the app conceptually and functionally.  It helped me figure out that gluten free, low-fodmap, and low-histamine diets didn't help me, which triggered me to get diagnosed with what really have (a pan-dissacharidase deficiency, so it's a combined lactose, sucrose, and maltose intolerance).  I was kind of surprised that the app didn't have any options for this, though, as they have a lot of different niche options.  They have an option for lactose intolerance but I don't even need to follow that if I take lactaid pills so it was a bit of a bummer.  Would love to see low-sucrose and low-maltose options on the app in the future.
