I’m sure this app has some good info but being bombarded by pop ups on my first time opening the app as well as already being asked to rate the thing before scanning anything is too much. The user experience is littered with annoying annotations.

Fig has been a life saver amidst navigating new diets. I follow low fodmap due to having sibo, and fig allows me to check ingredients so quickly. I wish there were more foods available within their app, but I’m sure with time it will grow!
I’m newly on weight loss medication and this app has been very helpful in helping me choose food that’s going to support me. It took a second to get the hang of it but now I love it!
This app is a lifesaver in the grocery, restaurants and when I’m traveling! I have Celiac and need to know what’s in the food I eat.  The fig app takes all the guess work out!
Amazing app, I rely on it to make sure everything I’m eating fits in my dietary restrictions!
Truly the best app i’ve come across to help with my celiac disease!

This app is worthless it only tells you if the food is junk if you input all thinking not to mention it takes you to their webpage to signup and make it impossible to cancel the he membership don’t say you weren’t warned

reviews.t: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Life-Changing for Anyone with Dietary Restrictions
reviews.b:
This app is truly a game changer. As someone who follows an anti-inflammatory diet, FIG has taken so much pressure and anxiety out of eating and grocery shopping. Whether I’m at a restaurant or in the store, all it takes is a quick scan and the app does the work for me, no more second-guessing labels or worrying about hidden ingredients.

There have been multiple times where I thought a product was “safe,” only for FIG to catch something I would have completely missed. That alone has made this app invaluable to me. It’s incredibly helpful for anyone with dietary restrictions, food sensitivities, or allergies, especially when ingredients aren’t always obvious.
Thank you Fig!

After signing up for the app I realized this was not going to be helpful for me. On the same day and hour I cancelled my subscription (the so called free trial) yet I was still charged the full amount.

Will not let you cancel keeps tryna charge me even though I canceled before the free trial. It’s not worth it and they don’t have options where you can hit cancel subscription just a bung of buttons that’s say renew subscription
I can’t research products without an add from Fig keeping me from a possible meal or snack.

Cant use this app without subscribing and makes it harder than it needs to be just to cancel. All my other subscriptions can be canceled through the subscription section of my apple account so why cant this one do it? I want my refund!!! This app doesnt do anything new and is basically useless

reviews.t: Do not download unless you’re ok losing $59.99
reviews.b: I signed up for the trial and I can’t login to view or cancel because my Apple ID email was t used. They used their own random email and now I was charged $59.99 and I haven’t gotten any response from them via email…they have no phone number. Very shady way of sorting people to pay for something they don’t use

Fig+ has been an absolute game changer for me. Due to multiple chronic illnesses and allergies, I am on an anti-inflammatory diet and allergic to dairy, gluten, and several other ingredients. It can feel beyond overwhelming to go to the store and find options that fit into all of those categories, but fig makes it so easy! I've been able to find new fun snacks stress free for the first time since my diagnoses. Thank you fig!

The FIG app has helped me tremendously with my diet. You don’t realize how many additional (unnecessary) ingredients are in foods that are labeled “clean”, “organic”, “low carb”, etc. 10 out of 10 app.
This app makes it nearly impossible to cancel this membership. They are eager to collect money but are unable to give clear instructions to terminate the collection.
Can’t do much with it unless you buy the in app purchases.

This is listed as a free app with in-app purchases but then you get through all the questions to get you started and it’s a 7 day free trial and then find out there is a monthly fee billed as 59.99/annually after the 7 day free trial. Sorry. Not paying $60 a year for an app to tell me what I can and can’t eat.  At least be honest from the get go that it’s not free.

Fig has helped me choose better food options and opened my eyes when it comes to what is in our food. App is easy to use! I like that I can save foods that align with my diet in a folder to try or to remember what to buy. Scanning makes it quick and easy when shopping too! I’m so grateful that Fig gifted me 6 months of Fig+ to help manage my new diets!
Fig has been doing me wonders and helping with my restrictions and I have never used a better app than this one!
This app has been so helpful navigating my new dietary restrictions. I no longer have to worry or spend hours grocery shopping!
I am so grateful to have Fig to keep me safe on my AGS journey. Their kindness made it possible for me to live a fuller life because I don’t have to guess which foods to eat. Thanks Fig!
I love it so much so far

I feel some sort of way about already being on a restricted diet and purified water and ice cubes are padding the very short list of foods I’m likely to tolerate. Restaurants I guess only works in urban/metro areas
5 scans a month?? Are you serious. You’re playing with people’s lives! We shouldn’t have to pay to get help avoiding foods that are harmful to our dietary needs! Selfish and evil.
Makes shopping with food sensitivities so much easier when starting out. So helpful and loving so far.
this app charged me $60 when I said I don’t want to pay for a membership. Then why I try to get it resolved I can’t. Literally stole my money. Don’t download this idk how it even got my card info.

This app gets you to do the work for them. Every item I scanned at several grocery stores were not on the app, but asked me to put the item in for them. I quickly realized I was paying them and doing their work for them. You’re going to have to figure out how to navigate a grocery store and a restaurant in order to meet your dietary needs, so what’s the point of having this app? No doubt, you’ll be looking at the back of every box, and every package, and you’re going be asking a server what’s in the food at every restaurant you go to anyway, so you don’t need this app and you definitely don’t need to be paying for it. This app still tried to charge my account even though I canceled.
This app has helped me track the foods I’ve eaten and what the ingredients and if it falls in the categories that I need, definitely 10/10 imma keep loyal to this app

This app is best used as a guide if you have Alpha Gal. It is not always accurate if there are “Natural Flavors”. Their default is unsafe. I have had it tell me there is gelatin in a product when the front of the box clearly stated gelatin free. I have had numerous products come up with gelatin and carrageenan when it does not contain them. I have seen it indicate that name brand soda is unsafe at a restaurant  but safe other places.
Honestly it sucks that I can’t eat most of the stuff listed due to the diet choices I picked but it be like that

I downloaded this app several months ago and deleted the app same day. I did it through iOS not stripe. It is not on my subscriptions. I was charged anyway. I have tried to cancel several times with no way to do so.  Apparently a bad review is the only way to get someone to respond. I have never used the app and I want it cancelled before you charge me another $60 I don’t have. It is ridiculous you can not cancel through the app.

I’ve downloaded and tried a couple of other apps similar to this as I am trying to keep away from more bad ingredients. I just set them as my allergies and boom! Easily can scan and see when there are bad ingredients in food I have or want without having to remember them all or go searching through the ingredients list!

reviews.t: Awful. Zero stars if I could
reviews.b: Absolutely awful. I’ve been emailing for 9 months about a refund after getting charged after cancelling the trial. Probably the worst customer service I’ve ever experienced. Haven’t heard a word back

Thought this was a free app. It is not. Seven days of a free trial, and monthly charges after that. None of that is mentioned prior to going through all of the diets/ingredients and personalization process. Deleting the app in disappointment.
This app has helped me so much as I navigate the gluten free life.
The app is accurate, informative, and helpful when looking at dietary restrictions like celiac disease. Love it!

Mainly got for restaurant info/suggestions, but I can’t see any in my area until I review one. I’m pretty new to this so I can’t really review any restaurants yet. Kind of defeats the purpose of the app. Also, I feel like the search feature doesn’t match what’s really out there.
Did not verify before taking 60 dollars out of my account.
Thanks to Fig my daughter can now eat what is right for her body, without the worry of it making her sick. Such a great app.
Awesome!

Do NOT believe those 1 star reviews. This app is such a good resource for anyone who has allergies or certain diets. Right off the bat you can tell someone put in WORK to this app, the interface is friendly, the scanning is easy and if something isn’t in the app and you submit it to them they are quick to get it on there. 
I found this app through TikTok from a wonderful creator Nina who follows an anti inflammatory diet! She’s always boasting about this app and I can see why. 
Thanks Fig!!!
Fig has been such a game changer for my dietary restrictions and helping me shop! I love this app so much! I recommend it to all of my friends and family.
Their billing and subscription portion is a mess. Charged me and keeps kicking me out and wanting me to pay again.

This is a HUGE HELP for someone like me who is deathly allergic to TN's. Anything to make our daily lives more manageable and safer is a win for me. App is also super easy to use. 5 stars. 
Keep up the great work!
Newly diagnosed with an autoimmune condition this app is helping me learn to choose foods that are beneficial for my body’s needs. So thankful I heard about this app!
This app will make finding compliant food so much easier!  I’ve already recommended to a friend. Thank you Fig!
This helped me so much when it came to my anti-inflammatory diet it helped me to be knowledgeable of the foods i was eating and what was good and bad i love this app

So, it doesn’t seem to be very accurate, and even though I paid for a year, it keeps telling me I don’t have paid features.   

An example of accuracy:  told me asparagus is ok, but when I consulted a print out from my GI doc, it was actually High Fodmaps.  No wonder I didn’t tolerate it! I guess I can’t really rely on this app. 

At first I was excited that it ask so many comprehensive questions, but perhaps that was all just for data collection.  Now I feel like I wasted $60.
So grateful to have found an app like this. I recently started my anti inflammatory diet and having an app help me make great choices has made this diet a lot easier.

Just like everyone else in the reviews has said, I tried the free trial and got charged the $65. I’ve already tried emailing and haven’t heard anything so I don’t even think they actually look at them, hence why they only have an email and not a number that you can call. The app was beneficial at first but now I wish I would’ve never fell for the free trial.
I love that the fig app takes the stress of healthy eating away! It breaks down everything and makes it easy to understand.
Seems to be just what I needed
This app is amazing! I have celiac and it helps incredibly to be able to scan products!
It’s not a substitute for reading every label EVERY TIME, but I’ll tell you it’s like have a second set of helpful eyes and I can’t tell you how much I’ve learned. Thank you!!!!!!!!!!!!

reviews.t: I Can Now Eat Without Fear!
reviews.b: Thank you FIG! I found the app during a recent IBS flare, and it is a game-changer. I can quickly check foods at the grocery store and know immediately whether I should buy it or not. I also appreciate how customizable it is to each individual user. Excellent app!
I use this app especially when I have an IBS flare up, and it helps my progress in getting normal again significantly. Brilliant!
This is the first app that has allowed me to flag two of my rarer allergens! Happy I tried downloading to my iPad when my Samsung phone failed

While out, I can’t even search restaurants because it wants me to rate restaurants first.  Literally can not search anything!  Completely useless.  I got this app to help me find safe food to eat.  I can’t see any restaurants until I rate them?!

Loving this app so far!! It’s so nice to see what foods actually align with my dietary restrictions. This has also made it so much easier to go grocery shopping. This is such an amazing resource to have and it is worth it!
App itself is good, PLEASE BE ADVISED on using Apple Pay to activate free trial, as they create a private email for you and this can cause problems to shut off Fig+ Subscription
Awesome

reviews.t: The best for knowing how to eat safe!
reviews.b: I absolutely love this app! It makes it so easy to check whether I can eat something or not — even when I’m unsure about certain ingredients. The best part is how clearly it lists every ingredient, including hidden ones that most other apps overlook. It helps me fully understand what’s in my food, make healthier choices, and avoid anything that might cause a reaction. I haven’t found another app like this — it’s truly one of a kind and has become an essential part of my daily life!

The Fig app has been super helpful. I recently was diagnosed with several autoimmune disorders and this app has been a lifesaver in making dietary changes! I don’t understand half of the ingredients but it helps me know what is anti-inflammatory, gluten-free and so much more!

As a new chronic illness patient this app has helped ease one of the many areas I need to worry about food triggers! I had to start the AIP diet and Fig has made it so easy to transition to healthier foods and items that wouldn’t give me a flare. Looking forward to the advancement of the app in the restaurant development. Thank you Fig for easing my mind as my brain fog and memory loss is real.

As a recovering anorexic with SIBO and IBS I found trying to check labels to see if they would fit into low FODMAP triggering. Fig gave me a tool to not only understand Low FODMAP but not have labels and numbers staring me in the face each time I needed to check if something was a food that would cause a flare.

While attempting to cancel my trial, I was repetitively glitched out of the “cancel subscription” page, and then was charged the $60. I still can’t cancel the account and have emailed customer support with a screen recording of my issues. I don’t have my refund and I am still tied to this unfortunate app. I can’t delete my account either until the billing issues are resolved.

They offer a free 7 day trial so I tried the app and cancelled the next day since I realized I wouldn’t use it. They charged my credit card $59 and when I tried to locate my account to verify the cancellation the account can not be found and neither the phone number and email provided to the credit card company as a contact were  real contacts. Watch your credit card if you tried this service!
I signed up for the 7 day free trial. The next 3 days I cancelled the free trial. Now they’re trying to charge me even though I cancelled 4 days before it expired

Beware that if you sign up for the free trial you will not get any notifications about when you trial is expiring so your card will automatically be charged after the trial period ends. Unfortunately I didn’t know when my trial ended so I got charged an insane amount of money for a subscription. A total rip off. Do not recommend!
Recently diagnosed with Alpha Gal. Wondering where do I go from here? The FIG app has really helped me figure out what I can eat. The scanning feature is a lifesaver!

Impossible to cancel. Says you’ll get notified 2 days prior to free trial ending. Never get it. When you go into cancel it won’t let you unless you jump through every possible hoop, and even then it does not work and they try to charge SIXTY dollars for subscription. Horrible company and practices.

reviews.t: Great for the low histamine diet
reviews.b: This app has been extremely helpful in navigating my many dietary restrictions! I recently had to start a low histamine diet in addition to my other dietary restrictions. Fig has been such a great tool and has made it easier to discover new foods I can eat. I highly recommend this app for anyone transitioning to a low histamine diet, or any kind of specialized diet.

I love the Fig app! I recently started an anti-inflammatory diet and felt so overwhelmed trying to read labels and figure out what was safe. Fig makes it so much easier by scanning and explaining which ingredients to avoid and why. It takes all the guesswork out and makes shopping easier. Highly recommend!
it’s all about money. greedy companies wanting people to pay subscriptions fees instead of a one time purchase.

I’m allergic to a couple different foods but particularly corn. It is so difficult to find out if it is truly in foods. It is used so many different ways along the ingredient chain so this app has been phenomenal for helping me really find out what foods I can actually have!
I have tried to cancel this several times and have been charged $15 every month. I have also not received a response on the contact form.
it doesn’t allow nickel allergy to be tracked

I just want to say how much I love this app. I was referred to it by a content creator friend. Ever since I’ve been diagnosed with my autoimmune disease and started the anti inflammatory diet, I use this app almost any time I go to a store with questions about certain products. I even use it to scan vitamins. It’s been a game changer for sure. It can stahl sometimes where I have to force close the app but that is the thing that can be a tad a small tad bit of frustrating lol other than that, I refer everyone to this app. Love it!
I love the Fig app! It helps me keep track of what’s safe to eat with my dietary restrictions! Easy to use & affordable!
FIG has been a huge help since I was diagnosed with an autoimmune condition and have to be gluten free and anti inflammatory. The company itself from what I know seem amazing- I love FIG!
Such a great app to help for those with allergies from both buying food at a store and restaurants. I highly recommend it!

reviews.t: Found useless, canceled trial, still got charged
reviews.b: I downloaded this app, set up the free trial, found it pretty much useless without a subscription (couldn’t tell me ANY ingredients for some super common fast food chain items), and uninstalled the app. All within a day. Went to my subscriptions and didn’t see it, so I figured I didn’t have to manage the trial. I mean, I COULDN’T manage the free trial if I tried, since it wasn’t on my iPhone subscriptions. Saw that I was charged $60. Went to my apple invoice and it’s not even on there that I purchased this app. I emailed support because I need a refund; I am not paying $60 for an app that I used for 5 minutes because they don’t use the usual route for a cancelation.
They keep your money no refunds

This app has literally saved me from the hassles of reading every nutritional label on the back of boxes! I’ve had to go on the anti inflammatory diet which in itself is a big change but because of Fig+ I no longer have to guess if I can eat certain foods. Bonus points for now being able to see if restaurants have options!

I heard about this app on tik tok, I have to be on an anti inflammatory diet because I have hasimotos hypothyroidism and need to watch what I eat. This app makes it so easy to figure out what to eat. Plus it’s honestly fun scanning the different products. You never really pay attention to ingredients in like raisins but I found out only certain raisins I can eat. Wow!! Thank you fig!

Signed up for the trial, tried cancelling through their system, didt received the email link til after it was expired 30 mins, I emailed several times and they just reply with copy and paste directions I was following already from their website. NOT HELPFUL at all and I am still trying to cancel the subscription before they charge me $60 - not worth it at all!!!
Very easy to navigate love all the selectable options.
I started eating dairy free about 6 months ago and kept accidentally giving dairy to myself without knowing…Fig has given me the ability to eat safe food and not have to worry
Help me to recognize a lot of the food I was consuming was very toxic to me
My 4 year old just got diagnose with celiac and this app is a life saver
So grateful for this app, my husband and I both have alpha gal and this is the only app we trust.
This app has been game changing for grocery shopping. I recently found out I can’t have dairy or gluten and FIG makes it so much easier to shop.

This app is amazing if you have any dietary restrictions. You are able to select all of your restrictions and see what products contain them. You are also able to scan products which is my favorite feature, it saves me time from having to read ingredients while grocery shopping!

reviews.t: Scam wont let you cancel membership
reviews.b: This app will not let me cancel my membership because i logged in through a third party app. I clicked for it to send me an email and it never sends so i go to change my email so maybe it’ll work for a different one. Too bad it wont let me do that either because i made an account through a third party app. I logged in through instagram using my apple ID to create an account and now i’m stuck with and cant cancel my free trial.

I was asked to leave a review during the account setup, so sure, here you go. I think it’s incredibly greedy and cheap to market an app towards a population that struggles to find food and neglect to mention that it’s subscription-based until you finally try to access the app. I downloaded the app while waiting in an aisle at the grocery store because I wasn’t sure if a product would be suitable to my allergies or not, only to find out that my free trial would only be for seven days and I would have to pay to find out if I can eat certain foods beyond that. People without dietary restrictions or food allergies have the luxury of knowing what they’ll be able to eat, and putting a service like this behind a paywall is gross and exploitative. I will be deleting the app without paying for a subscription.
Not very up front with subscription requirements before downloading and doing their survey.

this app is honestly super helpful i used it for a while but then i wasn’t capable of paying for the plan and it still had charged me, when i reached out to customer support they were so kind and helpful and refunded me no questions asked and i was honestly very happy with their help!

I have tried endlessly to log in to cancel. I am not using a private relay email (which they blame as a common iPhone problem). I have confirmed my email is correct, the one on my profile, and weirdly I get EVERY SINGLE EMAIL they send except when I request to cancel. There is NOWHERE to log in to your customer portal unless they privately send you a link that “expires in 30 minutes”, and apparently they won’t do it til after your trial ends and you’ve been charged for a full year (convenient that the charge is for a full year instead of monthly right?). It should be illegal to withhold links for customers to cancel when it is based on a TIME FRAME. Customer service has yet to email me back. 

**update** I did manage to cancel - not because of customer service, which only responded after I left a negative review - but because I found a glitch and was able to request a desktop website and change my email on file and only then did I receive the cancellation email - so its not a broken link, there MUST be some coding in effect to block the cancellation link being sent to the email that you signed up with originally. After reading some other customer reviews here, I’m shocked and even more annoyed that this is a known problem - and that erases any doubt that it is INTENTIONAL. 

An absolutely shameful company.

I understand that the app developers want to make money for their hard work and I don’t fault them for that. However, I am doing an elimination diet as directed by my doctor for a short period of time (3 months max likely) and I am not paying $60 for an entire year just for temporary access. Unfortunately with no monthly option I am unable to use the app unless I want access for the full year. Please consider a monthly option for those who only need to monitor food intolerances for a short period of time. Thank you.

Thank you so much for this app! I am newly diagnosed with Celiac Disease and only 2 weeks into a gluten free diet. This app is helping me at the store when shopping so I know what is safe and what is not. There’s so much to learn and having the tools to do so are very helpful.

Do not download this app. You can simply cancel during trial. They have it set up where you have to go through all these steps to cancel subscription during trial and then you receive an email trying to contact them about canceling and they say “it will take a couple days to get back to you because we are small” and you’re left unable to cancel. It’s insane. I’ve never had an app do this. It’s not in the subscription area under settings. You’ve been warned. Do NOT download this app. I can’t believe this app is such a thing. I’ve copied my attorney on an email to them.
Doesn’t specify that the app isn’t free until you download and waste your time

This app is a great starting place to help release the mental load of food restrictions, especially for a family with multiple different things going on. 

In our household we have autoimmune, other food allergies, diabetes and now alpha gal syndrome. 

Trying to keep it all straight was exhausting, who could have what. Now it’s just a quick scan and I have a good idea who can have what and what we all can eat together. 

It like a metal detector for food treasures.
Amazing app that has truly helped me buy foods that won’t make me feel sick and nasty

It’s so irritating when you have to go thorough setting everything up and a quiz before they tell you a subscription is required. If I didn’t have to cancel I’d try the 7 days.

I don’t eat out often enough for $60 year subscription. I’ve managed to navigate grocery stores for decades on my own. Don’t need help there. I’d probably only need this a few times a year. Definitely not worth the cost for me. 

I do appreciate the thoroughness of the allergen and food lists and that there is a food preference list in addition to the avoid list.

reviews.t: This app is a must have!
reviews.b: I’ve been able to be more intentional with the food that I eat without becoming overwhelming thanks to Fig. My body is healing from the inside out, I have a better understanding of what I’m putting in my body, and I feel way more empowered!
Having this app has made it so easy to take the guesswork out of figuring out what I can consume on a daily basis! You NEED this if you are following  a FODMAP diet, and want an easier life.

This app has turned a very overwhelming diagnosis for our daughter into a huge weight lifted off. I was given a list of foods she is allowed to eat with her intolerances and didn’t know where to begin with finding foods that fit the bill. I was very overwhelmed. 

With a fructose intolerance and a potential wheat intolerance, there was a ton of food that didn’t fit the bill and for a picky eater and a growing kid, it was scary as a mother to be faced with this, and also concern that she still gets the nutrients she needs. This app has taken away so much of the fear and overwhelm from finding a suitable diet for her that won’t cause her pain. 

That being said, It is always good to double check the ingredients against your recommended diet list and what is in the store because in some instances there can be inconsistencies, just due to the fact that each doctor’s recommendation for a particular diet may vary a bit, but I haven’t noticed many of these. 

For the weight it has taken off of me, it is so worth it!! It can pin down the foods that are okay, then I just double check it. 9 times out of 10 it’s accurate with what she needs. I highly recommend!

reviews.t: This is the app we needed
reviews.b: My sister is celiac and has an egg allergy, so it can be challenging planning an outing with her. Plus, I’m terrified of the thought of cooking for her. Now that I’ve found this app, I have a tool to help me check to make sure she will be safe!

I cancelled my subscriptions before my free trial ended to avoid any charges I was able to get through and hit cancel when I thought I was good I received a 64 dollar payment even tho I cancelled. I’m not to sure if this is legel I will be taking further action because this is not okay!! I’ve never had any issue with cancelling subscription with an app so this app is sketchy and just steals your money!!!!

i did a free trial, then forgot about it, so they took $60 out of my account for a years worth. but they won’t let me cancel my subscription. they said i signed into my account on a third party thing, and they won’t let me change my email to actually get the link to cancel my subscription. i’ve emailed them twice, and they’ve said the same thing that they will reach out to me in a few days, but they never do!! this app is a scam, and i have no idea how to stop $60 from coming out again in a year!!!

reviews.t: Charged me even though I submitted to cancel during free trial
reviews.b: I went into the app and logged into my account to cancel before my trial was over- it showed my subscription would end 8/21 but then I got charged anyway. Beware. Edit: they did refund me after I reached out but definitely watch your account if you try to cancel.

I have had trouble learning all of my triggers for alpha gal syndrome and Interstitial cystitis and fig has made it very easy to learn what they are so I can avoid them and avoiding flares! Thank you!
What a scam. Info says free to use, but “may” require purchase. Reality is you only get 7 days free use then you are automatically billed for a year! Be honest in your description of this app.

My wife was charged twice in four days for renewal but still can’t use it anymore. Emails asking for help have been ignored. I see responses from the developer to reviews so maybe they will respond. The app had been very helpful since her alpha-gal and mast cell are severe. Shame support is not available but still pocketed the money.

I created an account to test the 7 day trial. I ended up not wanting to continue with the app and wanted to cancel my subscription. When I went to the account information to manage my subscription it would not send me the link to the customer portal. I tried 3 different emails and still nothing. I emailed their customer service and they never responded. Disappointed as this cost me $60 and solidified not wanting to continue with this company but no way to cancel this.

reviews.t: Stop asking me to share with my family
reviews.b: App is 0 star for throwing up a screen nearly every time I use it to share it with my family, but otherwise a 5 star app. I doubt I’ll renew my subscription unless they stop that marketing nonsense and get back to a better user experience. Very frustrating.

reviews.t: The app is good when it dosent lag
reviews.b: I bought the app to use to track what’s good and what’s bad for me to use. When it works it works fine, but when it DOSENT….. it lags SO BAD. There’s some days where I’m in a store and waiting for a minutes for it to just load from the screen that says fig, just for it to get stuck on the scanner. I can even be at home with good wifi and I have tried it out and it does the same thing which is frustrating. If the lagging could be fixed this would be an amazing app bc it good, it’s just not great.
The title:)

I purchased a years worth of the Fig app not long after being diagnosed celiac. At first I was enchanted with it. Then it began to seem like everything was a “yellow” because of “natural flavors”. Rather than providing definitive answers, I’d then look up the product on the manufacturer’s website or another food warning website. Not so convenient when at the store or a family gathering.
Thank you for all your help with the app. It’s so helpful for all my health needs!!!
No part of this app is free. All aspects are paid only
I will never understand why this app isn’t free and I don’t even get unlimited scans. What?! Thank you for making it harder for people who just want to be healthy!

reviews.t: I like this app, but I have one note
reviews.b:
I wish this app put more consideration into what you may need to be replacing. Like, I put in my restrictions and I go to the dairy/eggs section….and they show me a bunch of eggs….. if I can’t eat dairy, I want dairy free yogurt or dairy free ice cream suggestions at the forefront…. Not eggs. Cause, that one I kind of figured out on my own.
Same with the snack area, I go to look at the snacks, and it’s all nuts. I know I can eat nuts. If I was happy eating just nuts I wouldn’t have downloaded an app. I’m looking for granola bars and crackers I can have. Something a little more interesting. you have to put a filter on to get to the good stuff. I select the cracker filter, then I get chips, potato chips, rice crisps. But y’all should’ve been LEADING with that!

The restaurant feature is incredible though. I know it’s in Beta, but it’s just great. I’m gonna be leaving reviews for every restaurant I go to. Like the yelp, but for people with allergies.
Wish I could my 3.99 back. Hard to manage app confusing not that much info
They make it so hard to cancel subscription the “link” email never comes and there is no way to cancel
Contacted support via email 3 times and no response. Completely worthless, no money back guarantee either if you’re not satisfied

I didn’t finish setting this up because you get to the very end to find out it is only free for 7- days. After that the charge is minimal but if I had known up front it was subscription only after that, I wouldn’t have downloaded it. I did not use the app so I cannot comment on the actual service.

Great for starting whatever kind of diet you’re wanting to get into. Very detailed information on countless products and brands, giving you the chance to explore different options. Highly recommend plus a friendly UI never fails to help either.

reviews.t: Love this and only surface level deep into the app!
reviews.b: I am already impressed with this app and all of the ingredients they have listed and how it allows you to indicate severity of your ingredient avoidance
And now my body can be happy while eating food
Extremely difficult to cancel
I’m so grateful to have an app that does all the hard work for me while keeping me healthy. Thank you🩷
As someone with a chronic illness, I have multiple dietary restrictions. I love using the scanning portion of Fig because it allows me to easily see what ingredients are in something.

reviews.t: Yet another “free” app disguised as a subscription.
reviews.b: Sick of every app nowadays requiring a subscription and only exposing you to the subscription after you’ve taken 10 minutes to “fill out a profile”.  Not worth it and very misleading.

The Fig app is exactly what I need for managing PCOS and following an anti-inflammatory diet. Unfortunately, after just two days, it began crashing, glitching, and overheating my phone. It’s currently unusable, which is disappointing given its unique and helpful purpose. I hope future updates resolve these issues.
Made it impossible to cancel!! Did not see it on Apple subscriptions. It signed me out of my account from the app I forgot I even had a trial on there!! Don’t like the transparency
I didn’t end of trying it because it required a credit card

I was recently diagnosed with Celiac and wanted to try this app since food is scary for me right now. When I downloaded it, there was no free option for me or “x” in the corner to bypass the subscription mode. When you go to cancel there is no way of doing so as others have stated. Then they try to blame the App Store and say you have to contact them. However! The subscription does not show up in the list and says free when I go to downloaded apps, despite being charged $65.10 from fig DIRECTLY! It is not charged through the App Store like they claim and there is no way to cancel it. I’m out this money and have no way of saving myself from being charged again in a year. Absolutely horrible to run a company that’s supposed to help people with disabilities and just scam money out of them. Absolutely disgusting and they deserve the worst for lying to us and robbing us while blaming someone else. Shame on you!!!! They also conveniently do not have a phone number, just a “support” email that I have tried to contact and get zero response. Pathetic way to run a business.

This app is a great idea but at least in my location, there are no reviews yet for the local restaurants. I cannot justify paying for something until it actually holds the information it promises. Therefore, it should be free until then.
I love to be able to scan items while grocery shopping but the app crashes non stop and lags to the point it becomes frustrating and I just have to give up.

This app is my first one to help with my gluten free and dairy free lifestyle I now have to partake in. I swear I use this app daily especially in the grocery stores. I’m so grateful for this team and this app because otherwise I would be lost trying to figure out what I can and can’t eat this takes the pain, stress and time it takes to research foods.
My daughter has IC. This app is so helpful and saves me so much time when shopping for options to make for her.

reviews.t: really useful but crashes too much
reviews.b: this app is so useful when it works. it takes such a long time to load and crashes every other scan :(

reviews.t: L O V E this app!
reviews.b: Helps me stay on track when I go grocery shopping & check for diet restrictions :)
THEY KEEP TRYING TO CHARGE ME FOR A SUBSCRIPTION THAT I DONT HAVE

Sneaky very sneaky. They   Sign you up and then don’t give you a way to cancel. Once you figure out how to cancel by doing a google search it’s to late and they tell you to use the email associated with the app and they will send you a cancel request but they don’t. So then I send them my other email and they send me the link and then confirm the cancellation but it’s too late to get my money back. AND BIG RED FLAG… the app doesn’t show up in your purchases or  your subscriptions. Sneaky very sneaky. Do not get this app. I’m out $65

This is ridiculous! I never used the app and thought I canceled it! Every week for 6 weeks you all have been trying to take money for subscription when I’ve tried every way possible to cancel! What a scam!!

reviews.t: Be very careful with the trial
reviews.b: I did a free trial of the app and was charged $59.99 twice. Wound up not keeping the app because it just wasn’t for me, but that’s a lot of money I wasn’t planning to spend.

So I tried this out, I selected the alert me before renew and I just got charged $59.99 without warning. Not cool. All apps should have a screen that pops up after the trial is over and says “to continue pay X” but no, yet another app that just charges without warning. I’ll be posting about this on Reddit and all the gluten free tik tok accounts.

I signed up for the free trial. At the time, they said they’d send a reminder email before charging me anything. They never did. I’ve been trying to cancel the trial for days but you can’t just sign in, you have to wait for an email with a login link that never seems to arrive. So I’ve been completely unable to cancel their stupid trial and now they’ve just charged me against my will. Twice! I got double charged!

reviews.t: Amazing customer service and seamless app interface
reviews.b: I can’t say enough great things about the app or the customer service. They went above and beyond to answer my questions and help me navigate my nutrition journey! Highly recommend.

reviews.t: Great idea, but not reliable enough
reviews.b:
I really wanted to love this app because the concept is amazing, but it just doesn’t work as well as it should. A lot of the product info seems outdated or inaccurate, and I’ve had multiple instances where it said something was safe for my dietary needs when it actually wasn’t. That’s a pretty big issue for an app that people with allergies are relying on.

The scanning feature is hit or miss and sometimes doesn’t recognize products at all. It also crashes more often than I expected. It feels like they focus more on promoting how many features it has instead of making the ones they already offer actually work.

If you’re using this to help with serious food sensitivities or medical issues, I’d be really careful and always double-check labels. This app can be helpful, but it’s not something I fully trust yet.

This app does not let you cancel whatsoever. It keeps telling you to cancel through the App Store, which you can’t cause it doesn’t give you an option. And then when you try to manage your subscription, it doesn’t let you do anything. Also, if you delete your account, it still doesn’t cancel it.
I read through the steps very carefully because I hate when companies bait you with a free trial and then make it hard to cancel. This company was very sneaky and walked off with my $60. Not ethical.

Beware, do not continue with this app. If it doesn’t work out for you and you try canceling your membership the app does not show in the App Store to fully cancel and this app takes $60 from you and your left with trying to get a hold of support to get your money not a good way to have a business. If there is a way to do a half star I would’ve put it.

reviews.t: $3.99 for the first month but they almost instantly tried to charge me $59.99
reviews.b: I got diagnosed with Alpha gal and thought this would be a great app to try to navigate with my new dietary restrictions. I had issues getting the free trial to work so I thought I would try out the $3.99 for the first month deal and if it didn’t work for me, I could cancel. The first day I was charged $3.99. Then the next day they tried to charge me $59.99. I instantly cancelled my subscription because of the false advertising. My subscription still says valid until August 12th because I did pay for the first month, but they are still constantly trying to charge my bank the $59.99. I literally used this app once and I’m getting charged almost $64…

I was really excited about this app when I saw it advertised on Instagram. It’s a really great idea for those living with so many food allergies. Unfortunately it’s not as far along as advertised and still has a long way to go. The restaurant feature is in Beta so there are no restaurants in my area. Many of the grocery store items are incorrectly categorized (canned goods in the frozen section). Seems they are talking a communal approach which I understand but may consider using additional technology to improve the app. I’ll check back in another year and hopefully they would have developed it a bit more.
I tried to cancel my membership twice but I still got charged the 60 bucks. Is there any way I could get a refund?
I cancelled my free trial and they still charged me I didn’t even use the app. I would like my $60 back I have emails stating when I cancelled 🤬
The link to cancel the trial didn’t go anywhere.

I like the app but I don’t have an extra $59.99 to pay for an app. I had to do the free trial to even test out the app and it’s the biggest pain trying to cancel. I can’t just do it through the app and I still haven’t figured it out. I’ve emailed them and requested a link to cancel multiple times and I haven’t hear anything back. I’m trying to cancel before they charge me because I can’t get a refund once it’s billed. Don’t do the free trial.

This app has been so helpful in directing me to foods that meet my special dietary needs.  The barcode scanner helps me at the grocery store and the app helps me meal plan by suggesting foods that meet my dietary requirements.  It’s helped me find more foods that I am able to eat!
I have so many dietary restrictions. This app takes away the stress of trying to figure out what I can and cannot eat. 10/10!

I wish I had looked closely at the poor reviews. There is a clear pattern. This company will charge you even if you cancel the subscription. There is no easy way to contact any kind of customer service. I canceled two days before my “free trial”ended and was charged for a full year! So ridiculous.

Like others have posted, I signed up for the free trial and I also do not see the subscription listed on my phone or my computer to cancel. I reached via email and hope this will be resolved in 7 days, before I am charged. According to the others here, I am  doubtful. This app could be good if they were more transparent and less scammy about how they take payment/cancel subscriptions. How is this an issue for this app when it is not an issue for other apps I’ve tried and been able to cancel easily?! This app would also benefit with more food options (such as modify health meals, megafit meals, hungry root options, etc). Very disappointed.

I cancelled my whole account before the trial ended and they still charged me 60$. I ended up disputing it on my card because they apparently don’t do refunds. How convenient. Highly recommend not downloading. I would give 0 stars if I could
Love this app when dealing with a gluten allergy.

I forgot to cancel my trial membership before it expired. Thankfully, I used a card without funds on it. I can’t cancel the subscription. It’s not appearing in the App Store with my other subscriptions, and the app only allows to “renew payment”, not cancel. They keep trying to charge the card $50 and there’s no way to stop it. I don’t love the app, so I don’t want a year of it.
As someone who is following the anti-inflammatory diet, this app is great at helping me define what I should and shouldn’t be eating

I love this app to track what’s in the food I am eating. I pay for the yearly subscription through Apple so I am surprised other comments have said they have had issues cancelling. I could cancel easily if I wanted to. It’s a lot easier to use this app than have to remember every known ingredient that I am trying to avoid.

reviews.t: This app is a life saver!
reviews.b:
I am so grateful to the app creators, Fig is a game changer for me. I have multiple food allergies, including corn, which can be a dangerous hidden ingredient in food, medication etc. Corn can “hide” as dextrose, citric acid, vitamins, maltodextrin….. the list goes on, unfortunately. It is very difficult to have to read every ingredient list on a label while shopping, and I would often miss things until I got home.
Fig has simplified my life tremendously. I can literally scan a product and a few seconds later, know if it is safe for me to eat. The app even suggests possible safe alternatives if a food comes up as containing allergens for me. 
It’s still frustrating to be so limited now in my diet, but Fig is making life so much easier to navigate!

reviews.t: I liked it until I didn’t…
reviews.b: The app was really nice at first because i was able to x out of any free trial ads. I was very disappointed with the very low limit of free scans you get per month. It almost makes it not worth using. I just got diagnosed with celiac and I’m still exploring what I can and can’t eat. It’s hard to shop in a grocery store when you can scan 5 items or so and you have to look up the rest.

reviews.t: So easy to find the foods we can eat!
reviews.b: This wonderful app has taken the guess work out of choosing foods to serve my daughter in laws both who have food allergies and dietary restrictions. And now I am traveling with a friend who has celiac disease and this app has made it so easy to find foods that will work for both of us.

My son was really sick with Alpha Gal. No one knows much about it. You guys had a button for it. 4 years he really left his room even finished up high school online. Within 6 months of using your app we had it under control and gave him his life back. I THANK YOU so much for that.
This app is super user friendly and helpful when at a restaurant or grocery store! Easy way to save me a tummy ache. Thank you Fig!!

I did the week or two for a few dollars subscription and then they charged me for a whole year subscription. I did not sign up for that or give any type of okay for such a transaction. I only did the week or two subscription to try the app longer since you have limited scans on the free version. Trying to reach customer service but that is a hassle. I don’t recommend at all! I doubt I’ll even get my money back. What a scam!
I was diagnosed with Alpha Gal this year and have been struggling to find things to eat. This app makes it possible to shop again! Highly recommend!

They will charge you $60 even if you sign up for the monthly.  Also, my account was charged when I had two days left on my trial. If you email them you get NO help and they ignore anything about giving your money back.

Once you sign up it is impossible to cancel the subscription, don’t fall for the 7 day free trial, that how they get you and charge you before you even get the chance to hear back from them. I don’t understand why they make it difficult to cancel a subscription.

I genuinely used to love this app until everything I clicked on I would get a pop-up ad for their own upgraded paid version and it was becoming so annoying that the app was not at all usable anymore. Constantly bombarding me with a pop-up ad for your own paid services is just going to make me not want to use the app at all

I love how the app is set up. You choose the diet or restrictions and it gives you a list of foods that fit your requirements. You can also choose the grocery store to shop from. This is exactly what I needed for my current dietary needs. I love how quick and efficient customer service is if you have a problem, I had a slight hiccup in the beginning but great customer service always wins me over! ☺️

It’s imposing to cancel, just wanted to try for free to see if it was something that I could actually commit to pay since it’s a lot of money! And surprise! There is no way out! I have sent several e mails and there’s no response at all!! Total scam!

Love that this app’s scanner has pictures so I can know exactly which product I am getting.  Color coding is useful for making informed decisions on those maybe items. Will be even better as the restaurants get more built out!

Never reminded me about the free trial ending. I have been trying to cancel the subscription for days now and it still isn’t showing up in my email or in the App Store or on apple. I need this cancelled as soon as possible - how can I do that?!
Will force you to start a free trial and then will continue to charge your card after you’ve already cancelled

Nice app! I love how it can help track foods with allergies or certain medical conditions. I have a problem though.. Would you be able to add more medical condition options? I have a condition called gastritis (gastroenteritis), and I've been trying to find foods that are safe for my gastritis diet. But instead I just went with "Gut friendly" and "anti- inflammatory". Not just this though, maybe you can put other more certain medical conditions as options if you haven't putted more for people. :)) thank you. ❤
The app has helped improve my quality of life tenfold. Thank you

There is no easy way to cancel the app and they don’t have a phone number to call so the response is slow. Apple doesn’t show I have a subscription but I signed up through Apple so I can’t get the cancellation email.

I have now attempted to unsubscribe on four different days. The “do this to be emailed your portal link to unsubscribe” does not work. I receive every email EXCEPT for that one.

Customer service also directs me to that page, to submit for another “customer portal” email, and it does not send. Why can’t they directly link me to my portal? Why can’t I log in on their website? Why can’t I unsubscribe on their app or website without being given a special link they won’t send?

I’ve gone back and forth with customer service who, for some reason, cannot find my account. I screenshot my account information on the app and they’ve stopped replying. 

This predatory tactic has really surprised me from such a health-focused app.

Unsubscribing should never be this difficult. I have still not been successful. This has been an absolutely infuriating waste of my time, energy, and probably my money when the free trial ends. This shouldn’t be legal.

reviews.t: Wonderful App and easy to use!
reviews.b: Great app for anyone with dietary restrictions. I really am impressed that you can select more than one dietary need!  You can select what you need to make looking at food so much easier!  I enjoy seeing why the for is tagged as it is showing you what ingredients may pose an issue for you. Simple to use. I’m even further impressed that Fig offers the app for people who may not be able to afford Fig+ through sponsorship. Thank you Fig!!!!

I like I see many others have now experienced - downloaded the app and agreed to the free trial. 

Fig indicated that they would notify me before the trial was up, but this didn’t happen. So here we are $60 later and the only email I received wasn’t for the notification and was under a different alias. 

Fig avoids allowing you to subscribe through Apple (likely to stop you from tracking your subscription as you would expect to be able to).

This just screams bad business and I feel scammed. I will be reaching out to the BBB because this is intentional deception.

reviews.t: They will charge you even if you cancel
reviews.b: I downloaded this stupid app to see if it would help I really didn’t think it did. I canceled my subscription before the 7 days and they still took the money.  I did not give them the approval
Great for those on Fodmap Diet.   Instead of reading every label now I can just scan it on the big app. Perfect, perfect, love it!!!

I just downloaded your app. It didn’t initially indicate a charge in Apple apps. Upon opening it  states I get a 7 day free trial  but no indication of future charge.  

I hesitate registering until I know up front what the cost will be.  Please let me know.

Turned on an alert so it would let me know when the free trial was over, never alerted me, DO NOT need a year subscription. Apple refuses to refund the subscription fee. Figs website says they won’t refund it. Spent an hour on the phone with Apple, card, everything no one will help. This app is not worth $70 yearly subscription. I regret ever downloading it.
When you’re told you have a food sensitivity, your mind may go to the worst case scenario. This app provides hope that shopping and life with a food sensitivity is really not that terrible.

Get this app as soon as possible if you or a loved one suffers from food allergies. It helped my shopping experience so much! I love whoever created FIG. It’s even better with the paid version,FIG+. Please download this!

Hi! If you’re reading this get fig+. I cannot say how much this has changed my life. Being diagnosed with many health issues this makes it easy to shop and go out. I reccomend this to all my friends and show them how easy it is to use! I love this app !!

I had to change my diet, removing dairy, soy, gluten, and oats while I finish breastfeeding my baby.  I was extremely overwhelmed at first, but had to switch quickly in order to help her.  I found fig and was so relieved!  It has been very simple to use an extremely informative. It took an overwhelming situation and made it much easier to manage.

This app has too much going on and gives you erratic messages. It did not give me a reminder that the billing cycle was due either so clearly they are not interested in giving the consumer the best and most informed options available. Why would I trust them with my data and health then?

I was charged $59.99 even though I had a free account, I even checked my account before I was charged and there was no way to “cancel” because it was a free account. I’ve emailed twice and reached out on social media and no one will answer me or refund me
Just downloaded this again but first time seemed very overwhelming

I’m disabled and have been using the app for nearly a year. I struggle with food sensitivities due to my interstitial cystitis and IBS. This app made it possible for me to cut down on my time spent reading through ingredients and anxiety over what I am able to eat. I’ve gone from feeling like I can’t eat anything to feeling empowered knowing there are options available that work for me. I’m eternally grateful for their gift membership through their financial assistance program. It is not something that fit into my budget prior to using it, but I now know it’s a necessity for me and something worth finding room in the budget for. I hope one day they’ll be able to award more needs-based memberships, but I’m grateful to have received a gift membership to begin with. Awesome app.

I can’t express enough how transformative this app has been for me. I was struggling with a variety of stomach issues that seemed overwhelming, but with the resources available here, I've been able to find relief and significantly reduce my symptoms. If you're facing similar challenges, I wholeheartedly recommend giving it a try. It could really make a difference for you too. 10/10!
I was charged twice for this app once 59.99 through my bank account then 34.99 through apple when I disputed one of the charges they cancelled my subscription buyer beware

reviews.t: Changed my confidence in eating out
reviews.b: I loooove fig! It makes it soooo easy to find food and not stress about finding something to eat!
Use it alot. Easy look up of items. No guessing on ingredients. I get consistent updates on ingredient changes on the products I buy. Worth I try to check out.

I have alpha gal syndrome. it limits just about every single thing in my life. when i heard about the fig app i was so excited. it works so well in helping me find food, toiletries etc that fit all of my restrictive allergies. i love this app and i will forever recommend it to anyone and everyone!
Not free. It’s so rude they advertise this way.
Love that I can put in so many different ingredients and just scan! This is a no brainer!
I’m new to the gluten free anti inflammatory lifestyle. I know the basics, but there are so many nuances that I would not be able to catch without Fig. Thank you Fig for keeping me healthy and safe!

reviews.t: No support. Family Sharing gets turned off by Apple.
reviews.b:
Updated:

One of your listed support email bounces.

Family sharing gets hosed by Apple in an “update”. Have to turn it all back on.

If you use “Sign In With Apple” before getting Family Sharing to work, the only work around is to turn off that “feature” then redo your entire My Fig & then sign in to the app with your new sign in credentials. You also have to restore the purchase as the old My Fig is hosed.

Updating My Fig was a very long process. Finding things to fix is helped if you can find the categories to search for…

Finally, I got it all working but it was very frustrating. Now that it works, I really like it, except when I have to change the My Fig profile. Make sure that it either has you save the profile or that you get a change save message or it isn’t saved. Rating changed from 2 stars to 4 stars.

Previous contact that bounced & the previous review.

I tried to use family sharing while I was in the trial period. It didn't work. I deleted it and tried to redownload from my purchased apps (something I never had to do before as the apps just worked on both our family accounts). I have paid for Fit+ & it shows up in my subscriptions.

I love the app & as I am disabled, my spouse shops more often than I do. She has no dietary restrictions. Fit makes it so easy to follow my dietary restrictions but the redownload process keeps erring out with a weird message about having deleted the app or canceled the subscription. I can download it for her to sign up individually but she has no need of it. I used sign in with apple so I can’t login to my account from her iPhone.

I can’t send you a screen shot when my spouse gets home from work because your support email bounces. The only app that ever gave me difficulty with Family Sharing before was Paprika which had to be solved by the app creators rather than Apple as stated in your help documentation. Please help!

Thanks in advance for your time & consideration.
This app has been so helpful for all of my food restrictions!

I was just diagnosed with pcos and I am on the journey to heal myself with food. Fig has been such a game changer on what I can and cant eat. It is super easy to use and very beneficial. Love it so much!!

They claimed after your free trial you would receive a notice for taking a payment out. Okay that’s fine with me! They never notified me and decided to take not a one month payment, BUT a ONE YEAR payment of $60! I have tried multiple times to reach out to customer service to make them aware I would like to receive my money back due to false claims. I have yet to get an email back. There is also no phone number to call. I hate that such companies take advantage of someone who has a disease that only a diet could help.

reviews.t: Love the app… but the subscription is broken
reviews.b:
App keeps randomly telling me I am out of free scans for the month.  I paid for a year … with many months left on the subscription.  Beware.. check your subscription before you click RENEW!!!   Is the app broken?  Are unsuspecting subscribers needlessly paying AGAIN for something they’ve already subscribed to because the sub breaks 3 months in- and in the middle of grocery shopping - no one remembers exactly whether they paid for a year or not? 

Potentially very shady.

i love this app! it really makes eating low fodmap so much easier and less stressful. i do wish you could have more free scans each month, but the grocery search function helps mitigate that. I received Fig+ free for 6 months with their assistance program though, so i highly recommend applying for that if you can’t afford to pay for fig+

Instead of scanning you can search manually. However,  they purposefully brick up their database making searching and loading take an absurd amount of time. It’s not that hard to have a searchable database. They slow it down so you want to use the scan feature, which in turn makes you want to pay their monthly fee. Terrible and slimy business/coding practices. Just stick with good and save your $8/mo.

I don’t know how I could get by without this app. I have chronic GERD. To have this app as a resource makes it so much easier to find foods I can eat.. I used to spend hours at the store having to scour nutrition labels myself and researching the ingredients and I would often leave the store overwhelmed and exhausted. This app has helped take away the overwhelming feeling of shopping on a strict diet. The bonus of it showing restaurant options that fit my diet have made it possible to go out and eat with friends again. I love that it shows grocery items as well, it makes compiling a grocery list before going to the store so much easier. This app has been life changing for me. I am so incredibly grateful for it and don’t think I could ever get by without it.
Fig has alleviated so many worries from picking and choosing what snacks for with my family. As a family of six, 3 of which have various allergies, Fig has made grocery shopping so much easier.

reviews.t: Life changing support for complex conditions
reviews.b: Recently learned I have histamine intolerance which is driving my increasing seemingly random anaphylactic reactions. Trying to figure out what I can that’s low histamine felt really daunting but this app makes it so easy to quickly scan and see from the color system whether it’s safe to eat or not. Since I also have food allergies and other conditions these can all be added in as well on top of the low histamine so the app provides results that will satisfy all my conditions which is amazing.

I didn’t get a reminder the trial ran out and to pay the subscription and now lost $63.00 for a year’s subscription I didn’t want. Not only that, theres options for smaller subscriptions that I wasn’t given until I cancelled the subscription.
I always had to go shopping and read so much to find if it was vegan this is a lifesaver love it

reviews.t: This app has helped me IMMENSELY. So glad I discovered this
reviews.b: When I found out that I had multiple dietary restrictions, I was devastated - I wasn’t sure what I can or cannot eat! Now that i’ve had FIG for about four months, i feel way more reassured that the foods I put in my body work with my diet changes. The barcode feature is SUPER helpful to have. You can input all of your dietary restrictions and it will tell you plain and simple if it works with your diet and why it does or does not. It’s my must-have on grocery shopping days
This App has been a life saver for my family. Dealing with so many food allergies has been tough and this makes the process of finding the right foods easy. 10/10 recommend.
This app has been so helpful while grocery shopping as a recently diagnosed celiac. Giving me peace of mind about what I’m eating!

reviews.t: I got charged even when I wasn’t supposed to
reviews.b: There was no way for me to end the subscription before the trial ended. They make it impossible and now it looks like they won’t give me a refund. Be careful doing the free trial!!
After having GI issues, this app has been extremely helpful in helping me know what products are going to be best for me for a range of reasons. So happy to have found it!
Loving using Fig to help us navigate our son’s food allergy. Helps take some of the worry out of feeding him things.
This makes shopping for food with my dietary restrictions so much easier! I love it

It can be overwhelming when you have all these stomach symptoms but don’t know what’s causing it, by using fig i was able to narrow down all the things that I thought might be upsetting my stomach and cut them out one by one. I love the scam feature and how detailed you can get with your restrictions. We are in the future of health now!

reviews.t: Down to three safe foods before Fig
reviews.b: Rice, eggs, and oats. I couldn’t even tolerate protein shakes. After months of tests and doctors, I landed on a low-histamine diet. Completely new to such an intensive food plan, and in addition to not tolerating most dairy, Fig has been instrumental in keeping me alive. The scan feature brings up the exact list of color-coded ingredients for what I’m holding with a simple explanation as to why that ingredient may be a problem. No more standing forever Googling and reading blogs. By having a moderate interaction designation, I have the confidence to try more foods. Searching a food also brings up multiple brands so I can see at a glance by the use of color-coded check marks whether or not it’s even worth exploring that next brand’s offerings. The bonus for me is having searchable spices. Safe foods only work when you don’t flavor them with overlooked counterintuitive ingredients. I’ve never reviewed an app before and can’t recommend this one enough.

second, this app is absolutely useless. 

the app cannot handle common medical dietary restrictions- such as low oxalate for certain common kidney stones. or to consider suitability for things like diabetes. 

of the very limited options they do have built in, such as low histamine, a diet i previously had to follow-it’s absurd how most of the “safe” products they list are just random chemicals or compounds in processed foods that you’ve never heard of, not an actual food item you could eat on its own.

in my local grocery store they claim people can only eat a hand full of things from the entire full grocery store which is not accurate.  and those items are inaccurately categorized. for example it suggested the only bakery or dessert item i could eat was wild salmon fillets???

i have life threatening food allergies, which i common with people who need a low histamine diet. insanely they don’t let you just list the things you’re allergic to so it can avoid those. even common ingredients, like jalapeño, almond, mint, pineapple, or sage you can’t select.

for the few options it does let you select it does not do so accurately. for example you can indicate you can’t eat onion and be told it’s safe to eat chives by themselves.

or you can say you can’t eat capsicum and then get told to eat a variety
of raw bell pepper.

also, they don’t have the largest grocery chain in my state. and when i was scanning items at home from national stores like whole foods or trader joe’s or target or walmart it didn’t have many many common items.

the concept here is good a good future goal but right now the advertising, app store description, and free/trial/subscription all intentionally midlead you and are also predatory toward low income people specifically.

I’m not the kind of person to leave reviews, but I just can’t not recognize the amazing people at Fig. I’m writing this as someone from southern California after receiving an email about the support they’re providing for those struggling following the numerous fires we’ve been having. These people are genuinely so good. They’re seriously out here doing such amazing work, and they care so much about the people their app is helping. They are also constantly improving upon what is already a fantastic foundation, and every update makes the app even better and makes life so much easier. The communication and support has also been out of this world. I’ve had a lot of questions that I’ve gotten such better answers to from the folks at Fig than some of my doctors. I’ve also recommended this app to a friend of mine who has food sensitivities after they mentioned using a whole spreadsheet to track what foods they can or can’t have. I’m so happy to feel like I have more control over what I eat because all that information is in one place that’s so easy to use and navigate. Navigating low FODMAP elimination/reintroduction (especially while living on a college campus where I can’t always choose what ingredients are in my food) has felt incredibly daunting, tedious, and depressing at times, but Fig has truly been a light in the dark making things so much easier. I would absolutely love a feature to help me track FODMAP intake to make sure I’m not having too much of one trigger, but I’m so happy that this app just exists at all. Thank you so much for all you do and for how much you truly care.

reviews.t: Misleading and only suitable for food allergies not intolerances
reviews.b:
First off the app costs $60 which is pretty steep for something that’s so poorly designed.  It’s pretty much useless if you’re navigating food intolerances and not food allergies.  My Dr has me doing an elimination diet which involves avoiding legumes (including soybeans) and some other things.  I have no food allergies and have not marked anything as an allergy.   However ingredients listed in allergen statements still flag products as being unsafe for me.  Even if the allergen statement is specifically saying that a product was processed in a facility free of soy and other common allergens.  This causes hundreds of products to be incorrectly marked as unsafe and prevents me from being able to filter out red light items.  

So I paid $60 to still have to check the ingredients on every product my stores sell without being able to reliably filter anything out.  I have tried working with their support.  They did fix at least a couple products that were flagging for stating that they produced in an allergen free facility, so that’s something.  However their solution for the other allergen flags was for me to manually change soy to flag as green or yellow light.  Except that would cause it to flag incorrectly safe when it’s actually an ingredient.  Their next suggestion was for me to set it up exactly how it’s already set and doesn’t work.  They said they’re changing the system The so uses to be less confusing, so they know their app is functioning poorly.  But they still see fit to mislead people into paying to use it.
Easy & quick onboarding

If you are suffering from SIBO and not IBS, this is not the app for you. The app says it has a SIBO mode, but it will flag many food items as being negative for you when in fact, they’re OK. It genuinely just creates more frustration than it is worth.

On top of that, you can’t even really try it out without paying $40 for the year. On the free app, you get three scans or three meal entries a day. If you try and make an edit to one of those meals, it takes away one of your meals “scans” for the day.

IMHO if the publisher of this app really wants to gain more subscribers, it needs to give you an opportunity to try all of the features of the app for a full week before it forces an annual subscription down your throat.

reviews.t: Won’t let me past the log-in
reviews.b: I was super excited for this, but when I go to finish making the account, I’m hit with “check your internet connection and try again” but it’s not my internet. I have celiac and was wanting to log my symptoms.
This app is excellent for tracking personal health data!

I like the relative ease at which I can log my food, bowel movements, and other things (meds, symptoms), but the symptom score makes no sense and there is not even a FAQ to explain how the symptom score is calculated. My “best days” seem to be days where I had numerous bouts of diarrhea, but I didn’t log things like stress or headaches. So maybe the symptom score is lower? But the main issue I’m trying to address with this app is chronic diarrhea. The foods that I know I ate the day on or before my *actual* worst diarrhea days often seem to show up on my “best days” list. Also, it’s very difficult to share several weeks of data with my doctor unless I send them a link and have them scroll day by day through a user interface with tons of white space and useless charts. I wish I could export the data to excel or to a PDF report that takes all the logged info but makes it a smaller text with less white space so it’s easily skimmable for a busy doctor.
Best app so far

This app is incredible. It’s easy to use. I started using this app when I was first diagnosed with Crohn’s disease. At the time, I was barely able to keep food down. I had no idea what to eat or what my sensitivities were - I also had a really hard time tracking all of my symptoms in a notepad.

I’ve also recommended this app to family and friends of mine - even though they may not have abdominal issues, knowing your body and learning how it speaks to you is really important. 

10/10 recommend 😊

It’s a good app. Better than many I’ve tried. A few things I would suggest: include a way to see analytics of what medications or supplements might be triggering symptoms. I think consolidating pain/stress/bad moods in analytics so that we can get a quick snapshot of what happened that day (what was eaten, meds taken, etc) would be helpful instead of having to click through each daily mood or pain. It would be nice to also click on meal or symptom tags and it show every single entry that was made with it. I wish i could note specifically how many hours of sleep I am getting or be able to input when I fell asleep and when I woke up. Also, there is a glitch where an entry is considered that same day only after 4:00am… an entry made at 3:59am will show up on the previous day…
Used to be a great app. Now, however, there does not appear to be any way to download one’s data, and no one seems to be watching the chat for support.

I really like this app and it’s been helpful for tracking my symptoms, but I feel like there is a major issue with the how the symptom score is calculated. I have IBS-C and there are days that I feel okay, but constipated that flag as red on the tracking, but other days where I indicated severe bloating, constipation, and pain and the symptom score only reads as yellow??? Wish this would be fixed so I can look at the data more easily.
Just downloaded and started entering my info into this app. When it didn’t recognize the #1 gastroenterologist prescribed IBS medication out there that I take, Dicyclomine, I deleted it.
It’s been of great use for me.

reviews.t: GREAT APP for IBS & Gut issues
reviews.b:
I really like this app. I’ve tried others but this one has helped me figure out which foods, etc are contributing to my IBS & GERD issues.  The details about the foods led me to FODMAP food issues which has helped me so much. No doctor has been able to give me this info nor guide me to finding out what’s going on with my body & gut.  After a few weeks, the program starts connecting your foods, etc to your elimination which is very insightful when you get into the food details & what the foods have in them and how your body tolerates them. 

There are a few things that are a little difficult to figure out, but once I figured these out, it’s gotten easier and easier to use. Adding foods to your favorites makes it easy for repeat meals. 

The daily log lists all you intake with the most current at the top of the list so it’s easy to see your progress.

Once you add your medications in the medication area, they are stored there for daily entry. The only thing I find irritating is that you cannot delete a medication after you have logged it for the day. EG… I take more meds than most and I have to take them in a certain order. If I log a medication and then realize I’ve added it in error, it will not delete from the daily recap. So I make a note but of course that doesn’t fix the daily intake. 

The app will connect to the Apple health so it also tracks exercise among other things or you can add exercise data manually. 

It has sections to categorize how your gut feels, your pain issues, stress, how much liquid you consume and more. Even a place to discuss your feelings.

This app has truly helped me.

I now have been diagnosed with severe osteoporosis & I have to figure out how to add more foods to help my bones. I do wish this app could help me figure out the amounts of nutrients I’m taking in when I eat. EG protein, calcium, mag, other vitamins etc.  If it did that, it would do everything I need!
I just want to be able to download my data onto an excel sheet & after using the app for a whole months there’s no way to do that. It really should be that hard. I’m disappointed.
I’d be even better if it could sync with apps like Fitbit and MyFitnessPal. Then I wouldn’t have to put the same information in multiple apps.
I will adjust if needed, but the app is very easy and simple to use.
