A diary app should not require a login just so that the app provider can harvest data and share it with anyone they deem a “partner” and want to share it with. The FAQ link in the app takes you to a Not Found error. The app raises too many questions, and missing info doesn’t instill confidence that they intend to only use your data in ways you would be ok with.
Your most recent update introduced some control lag to the app, which iOS updates haven't resolved.

The best app I have found for tracking symptoms, foods and adapting for other factors e.g. sleep, activities, stress etc.
Easy to adapt to your preferences.

I feel like this app would be a lot better If it were more similar to the weight loss app lose it. It needs to have different sections that are in different colors so people can differentiate the sections a little bit better. Also, it doesn’t have a very good database of foods or medications so you pretty much have to enter everything manually. It’s confusing to use because you don’t realize that everything (what you ate, how you feel, etc.) is listed in reverse chronological order. It’s hard to differentiate. The categories is visually by listing everything day by day. This app is lacking in the details that would make it very useful to a user.

I got a new phone, and Cara Care gave a message that I couldn’t load data because it said my data was on another phone. Fine. No problem, I thought, I’ll just log in again. I did that, and then it said it was sending a “restoration email.”  I never got the email. Probably just going to have to delete it and give up.

I have alpha gal syndrome and long thoracic nerve palsy. I have tried so many other apps but none are like this. My issues are never listed in the categories so it was hard to track. My symptoms were not all listed. This app is perfect! I can add you issues not listed as a category! Both of them! Thanks for such an amazing app! It will help me get control of my alpha gal syndrome!

This app has been super helpful in trying to figure out what foods trigger symptoms. My one wish would be a way to be able to export the data to some sort of printout summary. But other than that, it’s a great app!

1. Make the sleep tag choices vertical instead of horizontal. 2. Make it easier to add longer lists of ingredients. 3. Add an “outside time” or “sun exposure” feature. 4. Make it available to synchronize from one device to another. (When switching to a new phone I lost photos attached to favorite meals and the meals without photos were no longer usable.) 5. Have faster customer service.

Update: Oct. 15, 2024
I had this app at 4 stars but now changed it to 3. I have been using this app for years now. There are a lot of glitches that have not been improved. There hasn’t been an update of the app for I think 3 or more years and customer service used to be better, but now it’s been almost 3 months since I messaged them and they have not even checked their messages. I’m now here in the App Store looking for a better app.

reviews.t: The generated web link does not contain the latest bowel movements data
reviews.b: Not sure if that happens to others, but for my account, the generated web link does not contain the latest bowel movements data since Aug 2024. The data before that still shows
It does just about everything you need it to do. Wish you could make custom categories to make it even easier. My biggest complaint is that the app slows down the more you add in a day.
I am struggling to keep track of my “flare up foods” this app is easy to understand and manage. Allows me to keep track of food I can or stay away from.
please make it stop

reviews.t: Easy to use. I’m excited to get tracking.
reviews.b: Easy to use and seem simple enough.

This app is a game changer. Helps me track frequency of BMs and quality. Also great for tracking medication and food and makes the connection to your trigger foods. Allows you to save favorites and makes regular entry quick. Graph over the weeks and months is helpful. Would love the ability to track weight more easily. As well as more photos. Photos of progress or lack of progress with all of it. Sleep tracking could be a little more detailed.
Detailed, descriptive, captures big picture
Please please please add more recipes
Excellent app. Easy to keep logs. It walks you right through the instructions.

Wow. I just started using this app and while I was setting it up, I was just waiting for the “now enter your credit card information because your free trial is over.”
It’s simple, straightforward, AND does the algorithm for me. 
I think for the first time I’ll actually stick to this. 
I have celiac and my symptoms haven’t improved with a GF diet. Either I’m missing some gluten or I have Crohn’s. This app is great to save meals with ingredients and track stool all at once. I normally wouldn’t track mental health and other things, but because they’re sooo easy to add, I’ve been doing that too!

Thank you CaraCare.
Have tried downloading a couple times, and always get stuck at a white screen with a Next button that I can’t click.

reviews.t: Analysis falls short. Can’t access your raw data.
reviews.b: I would like to be able to export the raw data to spreadsheets. The simple graphs via the share link you provide fall short of some of the granular analysis I need. I should have checked the share feature before wasting so much time adding details assuming I’d be able to download and analyze according to my own parameters. Furthermore, there’s no transparency about the algorithm that determines the “Symptom Score.” The ability to have multidimensional tracking of BM, stress, sleep, and more is great. And the ability to add your own custom tags is fantastic! But what’s the point if you can’t analyze based on this specific data you’ve tracked!

Very very helpful for anyone with digestion problems who has to tell a medical professional what the problem is.  It helps you understand the connection between food and bowel movements.   So very helpful. A great tool.

reviews.t: Interesting, but won’t sync w health app
reviews.b: It only wants to sync steps, so if you log water, food or other things in another app, you’d have to do that twice

reviews.t: Almost there, just a simple tweak…
reviews.b: I’ve seen this in the reviews a few times and agree wholeheartedly. It would be so much better if you could add multiple food items to one entry. Instead, you have to make a new addition for each thing you consume. It makes it incredibly cumbersome and time consuming, ultimately driving down how often I’m able to take the time to use it, which impacts how good the data is.
I can’t find the FODMAP good rating list in this app.
App allows for a variety of tracking measures including food, digestion, elimination, mood, exercise, stress, breakouts, menstruation, etc
Many areas not working just grey areas in the screen
Easy to log!

My RND recommended I check out this app for food journaling purposes. I like the concept and can see how it’d be useful, but a huge flaw after one day of using it is that I can’t seem to add more than one food/drink item at a time? So if I want to separately add what I ate and what I drank, I have to go in and enter multiple times. It’s cumbersome and annoying.

reviews.t: Poor customer service and tech issues
reviews.b: I had been using this app for health purposes. Out of nowhere all of my information stopped showing up and i got an error code. I can’t use any of the information i have entered anymore. I used the customer support but they just send automated messages. it’s been two weeks since i reached out and their customer service has read my message and not responded. If you’re using for a health condition like I am I would look for a different app.

I’ve only been using it for a few days but so far I really like the amount of detail you can add about your symptoms and other factors beyond food. One small thing that would be a huge improvement for me would be having a wider range of hours available in the “how much sleep did you get” section, since I suffer from fatigue related to my symptoms I regularly sleep 10+ hours a night and the sleep tracker only goes up to 8+, which make it hard to see if sleeping only 8 or 9 hours has an effect on my symptoms vs 10 or 11 hours. The sleep tracker also has pretty wide chunks of 2 whole hours, which I would think also makes this harder to track. That’s my only comment, otherwise great app!

edit 2023: can’t really complain about a free app and in general cara care is amazing, but I wanted to report a small bug/UI issue that is very frustrating, which is that swiping down cancels a report before you’ve saved it. I’m not sure why this feature exists, since there is a very obvious cancel button, and the amount of times that I’ve wanted to delete an entire report I’ve written before saving it is far surpassed by the number of times I’ve accidentally slightly swiped down while trying to press the Save All button, thus deleting my carefully registered meal, symptoms, etc. and having to start over from zero due to a careless motion. Please please please if you can eliminate this gesture it would be a time saver!!!

This app is great for anyone with food intolerance. I have POTS (postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome) and it works great for me! There’s no ads, it’s free, and it’s easy to navigate. I’m so thankful I found this app.
The app designer seems to have stopped supporting this : years ago. Email correspondence doesn’t work, can’t login, no one replies to anything.
It helps me track so I can tell what not to eat and whether I’m on the right regimen. Pretty easy to enter items.

Well , there is not much to say ! I just want to let people know this is a safe and healthy and great app ! And even if this app is already having great views (  it should  ) I want to help ! So this is easily my favorite app for health so far !
BEAUTIFUL APP! i got stuck on a page that made me think i had to pay a crazy subscription fee so i left a bad review but im a liar!! this app is amazing!!!!!!!

this app is wonderful! I don’t have ibs but I’ve been trying to improve my digestive health and get some intel on what makes me feel better. I started out with myfitnesspal but couldn’t stand its obsession with weight loss. after two weeks I am in a nice routine of using it daily and I’ve learned a lot! the photo option for meal tracking is also a lot of fun. I wish ingredients were a bit easier to add and distinguish— for example, some veggies raw vs cooked would be helpful. and I wish I could add my own ingredients that stick consistently, like adding my favorite meals. otherwise, huge fan and planning to keep using this !

Tap targets for back and exit, in the learning modules, do not work. Tapping the category you want to add, then +, requires the user to go back and scroll to the desired category because it auto loads on the food category. Several bugs with selecting a different date, not saving, exiting when unintended. The graphs look tappable and it's confusing how to show data from a previous day. 

Overall the intention of the app is great, it's just not very intuitive.
This app freezes up after I enter my age. I’ve reinstalled it several times and still get the same thing. Seems like a good app, wish I was able to use it.

reviews.t: Great for what I’ve been needing!
reviews.b:
It doesn’t exactly track FODMAP like I expected. However the food that is programmed in the app, as well as the recipes are mostly LOW FODMAP! 
I’ve been using it to track me food, moods, and bowel movements. It’s really been helping with my ibs!
Plus it’s free and that’s a plus! :)

Not only one of the best apps out there; it is truly a game changer for those without medical guidance. I have Crohn’s and seeing a doctor extremely frustrating. In the meantime this app is helping me keep track of my symptoms, my mood, my diet, everything else I can’t think off. Having this efficient organized way of keeping track of my health is beyond relieving. This app gives me peace of mind that I can manage and track my own health.

I had to delete it in the first day because it was too hard to get the level of ingredient tracking I need in this app. The foods to select from are too general, and sometimes doesn’t let you add an ingredient (for instance, I can’t enter “cumin”, it makes you pick “Herbs”). I have a lot of sensitivities, and some are to herbs, additives, and other items that are very specific. It also doesn’t have scrolling down the ingredients results, so after I’d added many ingredients to my meal item, I could only see a couple results and couldn’t pick the one I needed. Has good possibilities for the rest of the tracking bits, but food is a major concern for my symptoms, so not workable for me.
This app makes it so easy to track every aspect of my gut health so I can see interactions.

I just found and started using this app a few days ago.  It’s the best tool I’ve found for tracking my GI issues, and I’m hoping it will help to better identify my triggers.  I don’t know if I’ll be able to edit my review in a few weeks to add my updated experience with the app, but for now, it looks really promising, and I’m grateful for it.
So far so good, no complaints!
Great way to track your daily routines. Helps you figure out what foods agree and disagree with your tummy too! 😝

This app was recommended in an article I was reading. I will never really know how good it is because setting up my account has proved impossible. Buttons are in the wrong places. There are not enough options or slots for answers for some of the questions. The beginning is not user-friendly and did not provide me with an account that I could use in the app. Too bad because it sounded like just what I needed.

I’ve used this app before and my doctor wants me to track what I’m eating so I downloaded it again because it’s so easy to track what you eat with how you feel. Plus it tracks your mood and stress levels too. Tracking your food and bowels is hard enough but this app makes it easy!

I am just getting started and have only used for a week.  Right now I am building up practice to keep the log up to date.  I love all the options and the ease of use.  The analysis of food eaten on my best three days has been really helpful.

Ok, I’ve only been using it for around a week, but I genuinely think it’s wonderful. I’m currently trying to figure out many different food sensitivities and a generally wacky digestive system and I think this app is going to make a difference for me. The app has a way to log your: food, discomfort/bloating, exercise, water, stool, period, medications, sleep, stress, emotions, skin plus just an option to put notes. (If that’s overwhelming don’t worry none of it’s mandatory to log the rest) Then it graphs out your information in each of the categories. There’s also a feature where it shows some of the food on your best and worst days but like I said I’ve only been using it for about a week so that’s not really helpful yet. Anyways to sum up, I think it’s a well organized app with a way to track pretty much anything you could want. It’s free (obviously) and I haven’t even seen any ads. THANK YOU to the creators for putting this up for free
We’ll constructed app with great features. Encourages listening to your body over a calorie number.

Update: I deleted and the-added the app and it works again, however it deleted some of my saved meals. That’s a minor inconvenience. 

I enjoy the app but the food on the worst and best days features stopped working randomly.

Idk what it is about this app, but its been the easiest one for me to keep up with and actually log everything i need. 
I took one star off because I would like a bit more customization, but overall I recommend this app for sure.
App doesn’t show foods on best days and worst days. There’s no support for app to get this fixed either.
Loving the possibility of figuring out what is hurting me
Great App!!

I finally went out of my way to find an app to help me track what I eat, track my medications, etc, and Cara Care has been so helpful. The app is free and works incredibly well. You can personalize your daily trackers to fit your needs best, and it shows you your worst/best foods based off of your tracked symptoms, etc. When I go back to the doctor, I will be more confident knowing I now have an effective method of keeping track of my food intake and symptoms. Awesome app for people with IBS!
I suffer from gastritis IBS and other issues this app is a great app for tracking and suggested food.

reviews.t: It’s been only 2 minutes since I tried it, and I LOVE IT
reviews.b: This is exactly what I need! I found an app I really liked before this, and thought that was the best one for me. I was totally wrong when I scrolled further down and gave this a shot. 100%. Thank you.

That’s my prime completely so far. I’m still getting familiar with this App. It seems very helping and I do have multiple issues it addresses.
I’d Really like to be able to to use Both my IPad n IPhone back n forth like some others do- this limitation is inconvenient n annoying.
Why is this this way?
Easy to use

I used their app for 1 year. I finally got an apple a doctor. The app stopped working. I contacted them and was told to delete the app and reinstall. I asked if I would loose my data and was told no. My appointment is tomorrow and I have lost all my data for a year. Very disappointed with customer service
89.99 a month??? That seems like a mistake. Can the developer respond to this? The app is great but I will not pay that to keep using it.

I have endometriosis, SIBO, IBS, PTSD, and chronic pain. The number of symptoms and lifestyle triggers and what not I need to track on a daily basis is really challenging. Finally with this app I can track all of it in one place. This is such a gift. Thank you for making my life easier.
It would be great though if the app (or a different slightly tweaked version) was focused on folks with endometriosis (you have the foundation!!) or that is more explanatory, not assuming user issues come from IBS exclusively.
Free , Easy and great !!

I’m trying to figure out what foods are my triggers and so far I’m really enjoying Cara, though I do have two suggestions:

I’m someone that has to get up really early for work (3:30) so sometimes my first entry of the day gets tracked under the previous day, which is going to throw off my data. The day’s entries should start new at midnight.

The other thing I wish was different was the ability to add different custom trackers, like an appetite scale, so that when I don’t track breakfast because I skipped it, I can know that it was because I didn’t have an appetite and that I didn’t just forget to track my breakfast.
I can’t really rate this yet because I’ve only just begun trying it out. Wondering if someone can tell me where the easy to follow low FODMAP list is found as shown in the preview. Thanks.
You can track stuff. It’s a lot of information. Kind of a pain but that’s just how it is
This app is incredible. It allows you to track all sorts of things, and you can track only what you are interested in. I find it very useful and I am glad it is free.
helpful
App is so helpful and informative. Great way to track all symptoms.
Well thought out app. Easy to use.

I’ve known I’ve had IBS since high school but was never given any insight in how to deal with it so I’ve basically just put up with the feeling for years because everything I researched overwhelmed me. Found Cara Care and it makes it so simple to track everything without being overwhelmed.

One issue is it says I need to confirm my email but it won’t send me the confirmation email to confirm.
Options to edit and add features to customize are amazing

This app lets you track everything that you put in or that comes out of your body, so you can easily see connections between things you're eating and how it's making you feel, physically and mentally. It’s also helped me to to drink more water, which is great. Cara is an awesome food tracking app that's focused on your health and wellbeing, rather than something trivial like losing weight like many other food journal apps!
I have been using this app for a little over a year now to track pain, sleep and food. It is easy to use with a clean interface. Love it.

I love this app. It helps me monitor everything to do with gut and kind of general health. The only thing that is inconvenient is a glitch where I have to log something more than once for it to show up.

i have had this app for two days and it's been really helpful for me. i have health and lots of stomach problems. this helps me see the food and how much water i consume through out the day. i really recommend this app! if you have any health problems this would be a good app for you and help you track what is going on! GREAT APP AND YOU DONT EVEN HAVE TO PAY A DIME!

Not only for allergies but also for tracking mood, energy levels and more, this app has helped me to be more conscious of all sorts of habits and patterns  related to my mental and physical health! It took a little playing around with to figure out the functions and I’m still deciphering the reports but just the act of inputting all the data has helped me to be more mindful of correlations between choices I make and how I feel. Totally worth a try if you’re curious!!
Just started, but like it
I always have my phone so this is the easiest tool to use to track stuff and keep up with my medication and what I eat.

I used this app forever ago and remember it was useful, so I re downloaded it but I can’t get past imputing my age I just get a white screen. I’ve tried reloading the app but it still happens. I tried recovering my old account but doesn’t work. I’d love to use it again.

I wish this app would sync with Lose It to make it easier to log food. Lose It has scanner capability, lists of foods including supermarket and restaurant brands, ability to write your own recipes and more. Cara is good for tracking mood, stress, and stool type. I haven’t made it to the good/bad food days. Heck, haven’t been able to track much food at all.

Great app for tracking food and symptoms and more. However, it has stopped updating for me as far as recording my trigger foods and my food eaten on my best days. It’s said the same foods for weeks and I know it’s not current. Not sure what’s up but this needs to be corrected.

I was excited about this app, but when i tried to add ingredients for a meal, the keyboard was covering most of the list of ingredients. I couldn’t scroll down, i couldn’t hide the keyboard… it was just useless… i couldn’t choose the ingredient i needed. So i had to delete the app. Too bad…
this morning it forced a data wipe and now requires a login, I’m deleting the app

I just started this app and it’s great so far for tracking symptoms. It’s a useful tool to keep a record of tummy troubles and goes into great detail. I also use a calorie counter app to keep track of that and before discovering this app I used to just add notes of my ibs symptoms. Now with this app I can clearly see my symptoms by day and identify triggers and/or see what helps.

Don’t understand the purpose of providing email address when I receive no emails or any feedback.  App is confusing with little clear instructions on how to use.  Only one app available for Cara Care.  I don’t receive any benefits described on website.

I’ve been dealing with food intolerances and this app has helped a ton to figure out which foods they are. BUT there’s two things I can pick out that if we’re fixed would make this app a 5 out of 5. #1 Coffee and Medications/Supplements aren’t included in the best/worst foods tables. A work around is creating a unique item but this really should be fixed. All items that can be ingested should display. #2 You can either track the intolerances for current day or next day, but not both. Depending on what I’m eating sometimes I get a reaction the day of and other times the following morning. To me, having an option for both would be more ideal.

Update:
I stopped using Cura for a while but always come back because it’s the only quality food intolerance tracking app. I have a third issue. #3 I wish there was a centralized location to manage custom “Favorite Dishes”. Overall, this is still a great app in comparison to other similar apps available.

reviews.t: Reason to believe it’s a data scam
reviews.b:
Hey there- firstly, they do an excellent job with their free app (no knowledge of the paid program) but from reading about privacy policy **NONE** and reviewing what sort of data they’re after and gleaning, a fair bit of suspicion was raised. Another reviewer claimed the app is reading the clipboard at each time we turn on the app….. if this is true, imagine how many credit card numbers & passwords & emails they might have.  Personally, I do t know how this reviewer got that information but from a PHI data security standpoint, this is a nightmare.

As reference, I do data science and research in a medical facility. Please be cautious.

reviews.t: Great for tracking IBS and other symptoms all in one place
reviews.b: I was previously using other apps (plural) that were all lacking something and required using multiple things.  But having this one that uses the Bristol stool scale and all of the other symptom trackers is so helpful and much easier.

reviews.t: You may lose all your tracking data
reviews.b: I liked the app overall until the best/worst foods feature stopped working. I reached out to Cara Care’s support, but they take several days to respond to each message. I have an account connected to my email, so I thought my information was being backed up. I uninstalled and reinstalled the app. While that fixed the best/worst foods feature, I found that a significant chunk of my tracked data was gone. Support from the app is very slow to respond, and ultimately had no solution. They said sorry and that my “tracked data must be somewhere.” I will no longer use this app, just because my tracking data disappearing renders the app until useless. If being able to retrieve your data is important to you, realize you may lose your tracked data with this app with no option to restore it even if you’ve got an account with a confirmed email. And support will tell you they have no idea how long it will take to help you.

I love this app. I have been looking for an app that can help me keep track of what I eat and all of the my symptoms. It is great that the app has several tabs that you can select such what you eat, exercise and your bowels movements and stress level. Along with when you take your meds. I think this a great app that can help people that have tendency to forget things. Especially if you go to the doctor and they ask questions about how you feel. You go to the app and review your notes.

The app works great except any time I try to enter the food I ate, it immediately crashes. It’s the only tab that causes it to crash, the others all work. A fix for this would be helpful, I’m having to document my meals in the notes section instead of in the food section. Please fix!

reviews.t: Filled with bugs 🐜 and terrible layout!
reviews.b:
hello 

is app is very poorly laid out and confusing to maneuver. It is also loaded with bugs. It says you can add custom tags but every time I try to add a tag there is nothing there. So far there is no place to contact Tech Support it’s not worth the aggravation
Helpful way to track food and your bodies reaction to it.  Now I have a better way to know what foods to avoid. Also great recipe ideas. I feel better and a little more in control

I apologize if there are thpos here. For some reason the in-app pop-up that prompted me to write a review only shows the moving cursor & not the words I’m typing. ANYWAYS (haha) this app is a game changer. I was disgnosed with Crohns a month ago and I had lost a lot of weight :( My nutritionist urged me to make a food journal but my ADHD made that difficult, which is why this app is incredible! Very user-friendly and informative.
Decent app.  I have some issues with the UI, but the largest issue I have is that the app reads the clipboard every time you open it.  Why is it doing this?

For months I have been trying to get the app to email me to setup my account. I have not been able to get this email sent and customer support has not been helpful at all! They keep asking me if I’ve confirmed my email which I keep telling them I’ve been unable to do because the app has not sent me the email to do so. And yes, I have checked my spam! If the app won’t send me an email, how can I set up the account?
Why is logging food so hard? It’s an okay app, but not intuitive, and I hate that I have to add ingredients one at a time.

I love that the app really gives you a well-rounded look at your well-being. There are so many kinds of symptoms you can track and that’s very helpful. The only thing I wish it had would be something like a barcode scanner so if you’re not eating something you made then it’s easier to track the ingredients. Similar to how MyFitnessPal has the nutritional information uploaded, I wish this app would have the same level of information of your foods.
Voiding was taken into consideration. My bladder and bowel problems go hand in hand. This would be a great place to track both.

reviews.t: If your sick this may help
reviews.b:
If you suffer from stomach related issues this app could help solve the answers to your health questions. 
”Why am I so tired?”
“Why do i feel sick all the time?”
“How many cups of (water/coffee/OJ...) did i have yesterday?”

This has helped me figure out what my body rejects and what my body can handle on a daily basis. 

Keeping tabs on my diet has helped so much. 
My wife has Crohns so i had her download the app to try it out.

reviews.t: Helpful in Letting me keep track of things
reviews.b: I’ve been having Digestive Problems like crazy and this app definetly helps me keep track of things like the food I’m eating and the symptoms I’m having, and it lets you analyze what might be causing your problems. I would recommend this to anyone who has digestive issues that might be linked to food allergies, stress or sleep or whatever you might think are causing the poor digestive health.

Great to track your food etc. 
I wish it had more ingredients that were known items and possible dishes that generally include some preset calories. 
Doesn’t work well as a calorie tracker. Jus types of food and how you do with them.

I’ve just started using this app.  I downloaded two other highly-rated apps before CaraCare.  It was difficult to figure out how to use, understand, and personalize those apps.  One of them had a very annoying ad for their premium program on every page and with every click.  I couldn’t locate the tutorials, and they weren’t nearly as comprehensive or as easy to use as CaraCare.  CaraCare is intuitive and easy to understand, easy to use, easy to personalize, and surprisingly comprehensive and thorough.  I used a migraine tracking app for many years that made a huge difference for me in understanding why I get migraines.  It led me to a diet that has cut migraine days 15 days a month to less than 1 per month.  I’m excited to find CaraCare and hope that by thoroughly tracking my IBS symptoms within CaraCare, I will be able to also make this chronic and life-limiting problem a thing of the past.
this app is good if you use free options. but if you want all the premium features go somewhere else. even $19/month is a lot, but the $89?! ha! theyre ridiculous

reviews.t: Great for tracking but needs some improvement
reviews.b: Really nice for tracking symptoms/food/meds etc and seeing the correlation. I would give five stars once the app is updated with traceable nutrition (fiber/protein/fat etc that is so important for IBS and other digestive health) food quantity and a better database for both foods and meds. Thank you
I recommend to others frequently.

I was really excited but after 6 days just a list of what I ate most , on my best or worst days, was not helpful to me. since I primarily eat similar things the two lists were almost identical. Also, the it was cumbersome to list all ingredients by hand and their was no grouping of similar foods (I.e. butter or milk = Dairy) My urgent suggestion to move you to 5 stars!:

1. Add bar code scan for all food ingredients (See My Fitness Pal)
2. Add automatic grouping of foods by Fodmap categories or common allergies

reviews.t: Where is the “easy to follow food list?”
reviews.b: Annoyed!

I don’t usually write reviews but I’ve found this app to be extremely frustrating. 

A) If I want to record food/symptoms from the past, I have to manually put the date in each time. There’s no option to go to the date and add everything (this option only exists if you have nothing else on that day but once you record something, the option goes away). This makes adding information from the past extremely time-consuming and almost impossible. It’s best to record the day of, but it’s too late for me. Recommendation: Please add an option to track additional food/symptoms on the daily overview.

B) For some reason, you can’t record the severity of nausea/vomiting without calling it “bloating”. I don’t have bloating but in order to record nausea/vomiting and how bad they were so that they show up as severe symptoms on the tracker, I have to say that I have bloating. Recommendation: Create a separate scale for nausea/vomiting.

C) This is minor, but if you need help or advice on the weekend, you’re out of luck.

This app is honestly well-designed and probably very useful, but these issues are making it difficult for me to get the GI information I need.

The app is pretty intuitive... I've been using for a bout a month now. I wish more foods were recognized... but other than that I enjoy using the app.  The customer service rocks. I had a question I submitted through the app and they got back with me super quick and followed up the next day with more details!
Great!!

reviews.t: Has all the necessary things to track your diet
reviews.b: Colorful and user friendly

reviews.t: Ok but lots of room for improvement
reviews.b:
It’s generally an ok tracker but there are a LOT of opportunities for improvement:
1) doesn’t allow you to track AMOUNT of food that you have, which is.... pretty annoying. You can add ingredients to a meal (which is tedious for bigger/more complex meals) but it can imply that each ingredient is of equal proportion, which may not be helpful for actually figuring out what’s bothering you
2) the food database is pretty limited, and you can’t scan barcodes to add anything
3) can’t track calories and nutrients, I need to track protein intake and have to use a different app
4) UI isn’t very intuitive, it wasn’t apparent how to add tags 
5) Takes a full day for someone to respond to the chat bot
6) can’t track your energy levels
7) app crashed and now I can’t open it on my Home Screen 

I haven’t found an app that does everything which is incredibly surprising. I’ve been using this for about 5 days and it takes 6 days for it to come up with likely symptom triggers, so we’ll see if it’s still worth it in a day.

reviews.t: Can’t even get it to work
reviews.b: Keeps telling me to restore my account, then tells me the app isn’t available in my country WHILE I’M USING IT

I really want to use this app. But it is so confusing and hard to use. After several attempts (been messing with it for 30 mins on this attempt) and I’m giving up. I can’t even do something as simple as add maple syrup to ham. It seems like I’m forced to choose from existing options which include something called “maple sirup”. Oh good grief. Anyway, that’s just one example. I’m going to try “MySymptoms”.

reviews.t: No CSV export is a deal breaker
reviews.b:
I have been using the app for a few days and While the app is extremely easy to use and removes friction in tracking meals/stool/meds/symptoms, not having a csv export option is a huge deal breaker for me. The level of analysis that can be achieved within the app and dashboard is minimal and is not conducive to the detective work required for someone with IBS to pinpoint trends over time and identify what irritants might be present in one’s diet.

Additionally most doctors prefer seeing raw data in a spreadsheet format rather than what an app deems to be medically useful, so the shareable web dash is not useful for this use case. Extremely disappointed I put the time in to record my health info in this app for several days only to find that CSV export is not an option. As an app developer myself, I know how easy it is to include this feature and I’m astonished to find a health app without it. If this is something that is important to you, I do not recommend this app.

i wish cara would get purchased by a big calorie tracking app like MyFitnessPal or merge with Cronometer...I think Cara’s really useful for tracking BMs & gut health stuff but it’s so tedious to enter what I eat and use their database, it’s an impediment to my using the app.

Love this app. Would highly recommend. Don’t like the fact that there is so much wasted space. Where are you can add your own “bubbles” (add/ edit customize tag). It did at one point fill up the whole page but now it’s only a row of two. I also wish I could delete anything that I don’t use when it comes to the workouts. I also wish you can rearrange your customize tabs. (You could also do that in the past). Developers please take this into consideration. Thank you!

It’s like the makers have never actually tried tracking a day’s worth of food in this app. NO basic foods/ingredients are included. It doesn’t even include Tylenol as a medication. The interface is terrible. The insights are more basic than what my grandmother would tell me watching me eat a lunch.

I’ve always wondered if there was an app that can help me record what I eat daily but also my bowel movements. This app allows you to do all that plus more, which is the reason why I decided to give it a try. It’s a great tool and I really enjoy it can’t wait to learn more about it.

reviews.t: Great help with logging info for me & MD appts!
reviews.b: This app is wonderful. It allows me to log all the data I need for follow ups with my specialists and is helping me isolate the foods that are my triggers.
This app is off to a decent start however the ability to scan food items is very much needed. It’s very time consuming entering every ingredient to food items.

This free, well-designed app helped me 2 yrs ago when I had to figure out which FODMAPs worsened my IBS. I thought I knew all my problem ones, but kept having flareups. After tracking my symptoms and food in Cara for 2 months, I figured out I was also sensitive to oligos in wheat. Since my reactions came 24-72 hrs later, I didn’t spot the pattern until I had the data clearly in front of me in Cara.
Very helpful to track what upsets my stomach as well as a great tool and data to bring to my gastroenterologist
It keeps on crushing, I couldn’t access the app

I have been using Cara for years. I started using it when I was having GI issues and needed to track symptoms to figure out what the deal was. Even though I’ve (thankfully!) solved those issues I’ve seen Cara evolve to so much more. Now I use it to track my mood, period, migraines, exercise, sleep, and more. I’ve probably downloaded 10 health tracker apps and always end up coming back to Cara because it’s the easiest and most powerful free app you’re going to find. Highly recommend.

reviews.t: Great but needs easier food entry
reviews.b: I like the app but entering the food could be easier.  For example, if you go to a restaurant chain it should recognize the ingredients.   Also would be nice if it would have landscape as well as portrait.

I have spent two weeks diligently recording my food and digestive life and now I cannot share or send the info from the app. I also cannot log out or restart the app in order to reset it. Customer service is spotty.
Love the prompts, simple, very well designed

reviews.t: Exactly what I was looking for
reviews.b: So far, I haven’t had to buy anything and it tracks everything I need. I’m still within the first week, but so far, so good. Thanks for this app! ❤️

reviews.t: Pretty good, but could be better
reviews.b:
So, I’ve been using this app for about 6 months now and it’s good for keeping track of my symptoms so I can go back and remember when something started and it has a lot of different types of categories for tracking. I also like that I can add my own symptoms to those categories if one isn’t already listed. 
 The part that confuses me is the food tracking. I can’t figure out how it decides what food goes on my “bad days” or “good days”, there doesn’t seem to be any rhyme or reason to it. For example, I’ll enter all the ingredients for a granola bar and it will just pick out one random ingredient like brown rice syrup and put it on the “bad day” list, but then it will go and put another ingredient like chocolate chips from the SAME granola bar and put it on the “good day” list! That doesn’t make any sense! The WHOLE granola bar should go on the “bad day” if I’m experiencing symptoms, not just one ingredient, otherwise tracking all these ingredients seems really tedious and pointless.
 The other frustrating thing is the drop down menu for adding ingredients to a dish. If I’m entering spaghetti for example, it should give me a list of common ingredients that one might use in spaghetti. Instead, the list is totally random stuff I’ve never even used before and I end up having to enter each one myself. It would be great if the list was of things I enter frequently. It also doesn’t have a lot of pre-made ingredient options in the list, I’ve had to create a lot of my own and I don’t think those are tracked as well (or at all) on the good/bad food lists. 
This app has so much potential to be really great, just make the food entry system easier to use and make sure it’s accurate. An option to be able to scan bar codes would be really helpful as well!

This app is terrible. I live in the USA and I think there is a language barrier. First, I don’t know what half the foods on the list are. And many foods I eat, like turkey, are not on the list. There are better apps. Especially for a fee.
Amazing. Makes life easier

I wish there was a function for folks with IC. IC is really common if you have IBS and it would be so easy to add it in with an icon for bladder flare ups and urine elimination data points. Also more and more nutritionists are helping people who have both IBS and IC.
Just what I was looking for in a diet and symptom tracking app.

reviews.t: Difficult to add and track meals
reviews.b: This app is super awkward. Basically, you need to track food the minute you eat something. You also need to enter each food or ingredient that you want to track at a time, press save, then add one more food you’re trying to track. It’s also really difficult to go back in and look at the food you’ve eaten for that day or past days. It’s just not a versatile or easy to use tracker.

reviews.t: Finally, something I can stick with...
reviews.b: I have tried everything. This is finally sticking. Great to give my health coach a link to view my tracking. Looking forward to PDF export coming back. One feature I’d love to see is to go back to a day in the past and add something without having to change the date and maybe even the time.

reviews.t: Lots of bugs & no tech help
reviews.b: Lots of bugs setting up my profile and changing devices. No tech help.

I have undiagnosed IBS. This app has helped me so much! I can track my food, water, stool, meds, and so much more! You can also write notes down from that day. For girls, think an app that helps track your period (which this app can do too). What I mean by that is, it can tell you what foods upset your stomach and what foods your stomach likes. Like for me, cheese upsets my stomach and yogurt helps calm it down. Overall, this is like all health apps combined pretty much as far as food goes. The complete best thing is that it’s free! There’s no fee you have to pay to use it, it’s free. I will never go back to a different app ever again!

reviews.t: Everything I need for my IBS/IBD in one place
reviews.b: Love it!

I love this app but all my data got erased. At least I get to start new because I had left it for some time but having to reenter everything is going to be a huge pain. Still love this app to help track but hope it doesn’t happen again.
Just downloaded it, but pretty easy to use so far, enjoyable UX, and seems useful to tracking my health.
The app is good but there are a few things that could be better such as scanning food labels it is so hard to put in all it ingredients
This app is great for tracking meals and digestive symptoms. I have a history of digestive problems and food sensitivities. This app helps me see what I’m doing right and wrong.

reviews.t: READ THIS if you are considering Cara Care!!!
reviews.b:
I’ve never written a review before and I’ve always thought, if ever I write a review the app has to be really awesome. Well guess what. I am writing a review. 

This app is amazing. I struggle with IBS and it’s hard to find out and see that patterns between food, bloating patterns, stool patterns, effects of medications/supplements etc. Cara Care accounted for that. It’s more than tracking what you ate and when, when you went to the bathroom and what was it like, how many glasses of water did you drink? No it’s here’s what I ate at this time, I can put a picture of the food in, I can choose from a bank of foods/ingredients that show what in in that items (fructose, gluten, etc) and if a specific item is not there I can write it in. I can add foods to my favorites bar for easy access. I can say when I went to the bathroom and comment on what it looked like or add in my own descriptors. I can say I had x glasses of water, carbonated or not, or add in (like I did) I had Tea instead. And then, get this, it COMPILES all this information into a graph to show your worst symptoms and what you had those days, and your best days and what you had those days.
And you are telling me I get all this FOR FREE?
God I love this app. It’s the best thing for no only IBS patients but for people who want to track their lives, diet, exercise, bathroom habits, hydration, mood, periods, sleep patterns.
And if you’re wondering does this system actually work? why indeed it does, I’ve found out I cannot eat a bunch of random things that I would have never thought but ALWAYS cause problems. And more.

If you are looking for an app to track anything like this give Cara Care a try. It doesn’t come up initially with a search like food tracking or something but if you find it down load it. It’s free and heck it might be your most favorite app ever (it is mine) I’d delete social media if it meant I could keep Cara Care. And that’s saying something for a teenager.

Best tracking,
A Very satisfied customer.
This Has been very helpful tracking

This app is PERFECT for keeping track of my health! Not only does it help me track my digestion and food sensitivities but it also helps me track how much water I drink, helping me stay hydrated! And I love all the options for data input!

I used this app for over 2 years, and it tracks everything I find useful to tack. However, a couple of weeks ago, the service became severely degraded. The summary of how my bowel movements were for the day just showed some code, instead of whether today was ‘mild’, etc. then I noticed that my favorite meals no longer kept the ingredients I had saved under the meals. I tried reinstalling but that did not work. I don’t know if it’s a problem with a new update or if I’d been using it so long that it was having difficulty with how much data I’d tracked, etc. would really love to be able to use it again!
I don’t have IBS but I have many other gastric conditions and this app helps me manage so much! My doctors are so shocked that I track my stuff so well and I always suggest this app to my friends :)

reviews.t: Great idea but some clunky UX makes it more frustrating to enter food than necessary
reviews.b:
This app could be very help but there are a few things that often push me to avoid entering data. This has remained true for the year I have used the app. Still frustrated as of April 2020. 

Minus one more star because a recent update seems to have wiped out my favorite meals so that there are no longer ingredients in them! Useless. 

I only use this to track bowel movements now. The food tracking features are not useful, sadly. 
——
Older review (still valid April 2020):

1. The autocomplete list gets full of slightly different spellings. I have at least three entries that say “Coffee” for example. This messes up any correlation analysis. Recently this has become even worse. 

2. Entering food can be more painful than necessary. Why do I scroll down three pages to find the entry for chicken when I type “chicken”? Why isn’t the chicken I always use sorted to the top?

3. Quickly entering several dishes usually requires me to keep pressing the text entry field instead of automatically staying in entry-mode. This requires closing and opening the keyboard constantly. 

Even nicer would be if I could type a list of foods separated by commas or double-spaces and have Cara split up my phrase into all the component foods intelligently. As I’ve entered about 95% of all the ingredients I will ever input to the system it could find nearest matches relatively easily, especially with fuzzy-match to deal with typos. 

There was a brief period where the app seemed to do this and it made entry sooo much better. Then for some reason it was removed and now I’m back to giving up on this app. 

4. I am very often back-filling data because I don’t record things right away. The day and time selector is very annoying and painful to use. How could 1-minute increments possibly be important to tracking food? Put it in 15-minute increments and you save me a ton of time entering information. Make a better date selector. I know this drop down menu mess is often used for dates on iOS but it’s a garbage date entry device and wastes my time. 

It sounds small but 99% of my time in the app is spent entering data so that needs to be ultra quick or the benefits are quickly diluted. If I’m spending an extra 10-20% time trying to manually curate my entries and bouncing between keyboard and non-keyboard mode it adds up.

It is helpful to me. 
To use everyday. 
Morning and midday. 
And afternoon and evening.
It’s a good concept but poor implementation. It’s difficult to navigate and there’s no consolidated way to view your data

I really like this app! I wish they wouldn’t have gotten rid of my symptom summary on the main dash page though. Otherwise it’s really easy to use and customize, and I’ve gotten some great insights from it.

I used to recommend this app to anyone with food intolerances. 

Now I won’t. They keep trying to “fix” the app. And instead it’s now clunkier, with wasted space for marketing new programs, instead of having the needed overall symptom severity tracking on the home screen. 

I wish I could get the older version back. At least that one had everything it needed.

i love this app but every since the new update was released i can’t open it. i have tried updating, restarting my phone, and even deleting the app and redownloading it. i can’t get past the loading screen before it crashes. please fix this issue!

reviews.t: App won’t open now as of 4/6/20
reviews.b: I went to open the app on the morning of Monday 4/6/20 and it shows the loading screen for about a second and then abruptly closes. I rebooted my phone...same thing. I saw there was an update in the App Store...same result after updating. I really don’t want to delete the app for fear of losing all my data. Please help!!!

I can’t believe this app is free!! I gladly would’ve paid for it though, this is hand-tailored to IBD. So long as you’re keeping up with it it will help you identify trigger foods and you can actually see how hydration & exercise can improve your overall symptoms! It tracks sleep, moods, stress, tummy pain, periods, meds, water, just about everything! And not only that but it offers little tags to specify and elaborate whatever’s going on. For ex: if you have a head ache, the app tracks how severe the pain is, is it pressure, pounding, cluster, is it in the front or the back of your head, and you can even create your own! 

[I will say that I wish it let me record half-tablets when taking medication (but you can put in the mg amount so that’s what I’ve been doing instead) and I also wish it let you track the tags on your symptoms along with the symptoms itself. I could be feeling really nauseous and dizzy but all that shows up in the tracker is a mild headache.]

But all in all it’s really been a lifesaver for me. I have really bad ADHD and it’s always been extremely hard to stay on top of my meds (vitamins included), how much water I’m drinking, my mental health & just any kind of routine in general. Plus with this new Crohns diagnosis & trying to learn what I can & cant do & eat now & dealing with all these crazy symptoms was making my depression & anxiety 10x worse. This app has finally given me some sense of control over my body & life again.

I love the idea but this app needs work. It is not useful to list foods on worst days if they were also listed on your best days. It’s not exactly easy parsing that yourself on a tiny phone. Next it should not be days but 24 hours. If I have symptoms first thing in the morning it’s not related to that day and conversely if my symptoms occur after dinner it likely is related to that day. Unfortunately the app only gives you an option of tracking either same day or previous day; it needs to be 24 hours. Finally, many features don’t work or don’t work well such as saving favorites to use later.

reviews.t: Very Helpful, Impressive UI for Free App
reviews.b: I’m new to tracking my health in this way but Cara has made it easy to start. It’s also normalized some of my concerns via the supportive community. I also love the various graphing features.

Due to some occasional constipation, my dr advised me to track my bowel movements. This app enables you to track way more than that, but I’m able to track when and quality of each BM in 6 taps, so I’m happy with it.
The new update sounds good, however since I updated the second I open the app it crashes, so I can't check it out or use the app anymore. Hope this gets fixed soon.

I absolutely love this app. You can track so many details that you wouldn’t even think of tracking for ibs. They also have a ton of helpful articles for free to further educate yourself on the condition. Thanks to this app, I can’t tell my doctor exactly how often I’m having each symptom. There are helpful graphs in addition to this that show you how severe your symptoms are. I often forget which foods I’ve eaten in relation to my symptoms, but not anymore! GET THIS APP!
This app helps me keep track of EVERYTHING! And it’s free! I love it.
I use this app every day. Helps me keep track of what food I eat and how it effects my crohn’s . I would highly recommend it to anyone that needs to track food versus symptoms

6 months ago, I would've given it 5 stars. After the big update a few months ago, I now give it 2 stars. They added some recipe section that I don't use and added more food to the database. That is causing the app to run a lot more slow. The biggest problem is that they took off the download to csv and pdf option. The web interface is useless and doesn't tell me anything about my health. Please bring back the download option so I will keep using the app.
Good for Tracking and simple to use.

This has been a lifesaver at helping me track my symptoms. It's easy to use and there's little charts to help me see symptom correlations. I would recommend this app for anyone with IBS or GI trouble.

reviews.t: Provides Healthcare Provider with a comprehensive look
reviews.b: I found this app to help provide my healthcare provider with a more comprehensive look at my symptoms.So far it looks to be what I needed for this purpose. The food diary is a little clunky but for a general look it does the job. I have not seen if it is synching my exercise/steps but got my needs that is not a problem.
This is a great app.. perfect especially if you have gut issues. Helps in trying to pinpoint what might be your problem.

I’ve only been using this app for a few days but it’s a great app for tracking food and symptoms. I have an autoimmune disease and I like that I can create custom symptom tags to track the symptoms unique to me. I also like that I can turn off tracking for other areas that I’m not personally monitoring (bowel, water intake, exercise). It’s highly customizable. The support from the app developers/app team is great too. They helped me further customize my data to get better results. This is an excellent free resource and could benefit many people, so I hope more and more people use it. Thanks!

This is the only app I’ve found that lets you note EVERYTHING about your day and is free! I’m so bad at keeping a journal for my doctor, but this app has helped me so much. Plus you have contact with the people who run the app which makes things much easier as well.

I wanted a way to track intake and outtake as well and this has been awesome! I’m new to this app but I’m loving it so far! It’s very well laid out and I can track my medications and all that too! Love it! So happy it is a free app too!

I find this app really helpful to track my symptoms then look at patterns to what I have eaten in the last 24-48 hours.  If I had to write everything on paper & look back I would never do it.   Using the app has been easy & time efficient.
Makes tracking my poops easier. Checking previous entries is kinda confusing and only shows dots but I cant actually see what i typed in that day

This is one of the few apps I would pay for if it weren’t free! There are no ads in this either, and I’d accept ads for this too. 

I haven’t used this long, but the information it gives, and all the tracking options, are so helpful! I can’t wait to keep using it to get better results. I don’t have IBS or anything but am trying to see which foods give me heartburn/acid reflux. Thank you for making it!

reviews.t: Cool features, but missing one thing
reviews.b:
So far I’m liking this app.

Pros:
• Tracking for bowel movements, medications, symptoms, emotions, stress
• Meal tracking: you can add a title like “Sandwich” and add the ingredients— there are quite a few to choose from when you search. If this meal is a safe, yummy one you can add to favorites for later reference.

Cons:
• For an IBS app, I would expect more FODMAP tracking. It would be great if each of the ingredients I logged had a red, yellow, or green icon to let me know if it’s high, medium, or low in FODMAPs.
Really helps me track my symptoms and work to try and figure out what’s going on with my body

reviews.t: Best help I’ve found through this difficult time
reviews.b: Going through the process of understanding food tolerances and GI upset is incredibly difficult. This app has helped to keep a daily log of my symptoms, meals, and overall health. It has been a great tool along the way and I’d recommend it to anyone else who is struggling through the process of finding out just what that thing is that in causing an imbalance!

reviews.t: Good for all types of tracking
reviews.b: As someone with ulcerative colitis, migraines, and depression, this app makes it easy to track all different symptoms and food in one place. I went from using 4 different apps to everyone in one place with Cara.
Needed something to track BMs for my Crohn’s disease. Seems like it might have this functionality but it was too confusing to figure out..

I have severe GI issues. I’m vegan, highly stressed all the time, and travel a lot. I have been diagnosed with IBS (who hasn’t really?) but I don’t follow the FODMAP diet due to most of my vegan foods being no-no’s. I choose to go the probiotic, supplements for bloating, and metabolism boosting route. However, because I chose this route, I often have symptoms. Cara allows me to track them and actually have something to show when I go into the GI specialist. It’s easy to find patterns on my own, and I love how thorough the tracking system is. It’s wonderful to keep an eye on what may be going on in my life that is making my GI upset worse. Real talk. Few glitches here and there with functionality, but overall, I like this app and find it useful.
I was recently diagnosed with IBS and am in the process of finding trigger foods. I started an elimination diet and this app has really helped me find the foods I can’t digest well.

Makes you wonder how good this app
Is when you cant get past the opening interview

reviews.t: Link to Restore Account Doesn’t Work
reviews.b: I had to delete the app b/c it stopped working after the latest update, but the link to recover the account does not work.

reviews.t: App crashing with latest update DO NOT DOWNLOAD
reviews.b: The app does not open anymore. It crashes immediately. I’ve been emailing the developers for three days but no response.

I use this app to track pretty much everything: my food, my medicines, and etc. I’ve been using it for over a year now and it’s gotten better each and every time they’ve made changes.

The only issue I have is the app keeps crashing when I open it for some reason... a minor bug but it is annoying that when I really need it, I can’t use it 😭 guess I gotta have a backup now 😂
After yesterday’s update, the app doesn’t open. It crashes every single time you attempt to open it. Please fix it.

reviews.t: Love this app when it isn’t crashing
reviews.b: This app has been a favorite of mine to track with, but now I have been having issues where it crashes when I try and open it. I tried restarting my phone but that wasn’t the issue. Hopefully it can be fixed soon

Truly the best tracking app I’ve experienced for making sure I know what’s going on with my body and trying to see correlations between food and symptoms or other trends in your health. There are no ads and it’s so helpful.

I've been using this a few days now and it is exactly what I was looking for. It takes a little fiddling to get used to it but I picked it up quick and it is very simple to add to foods and symptom quickly. The goal is to get as much info recorded as possible and then it will give you feedback and connections. The ease of use helps to keep you consistent in recording info. Those that want the calorie tracking in it I think are missing the point and it really would add more time to recording info to have that feature. I do like you can take pictures of your meals. Really great app and I'm so glad I found it!

I found myself needing to track my food for some possible digestive issues and pain. I tried tracking in another app but it tracked calories, which I don’t need to do and I found it was making me a bit silly with that info. Plus it didn’t allow me to track pain. Then I found this app. I can turn off the things I don’t want to track and it allows me to get all the info I need. I already recommended it to my sister and I can see how it could benefit someone who doesn’t need to track anything but just wants to see an overall picture. I do think if nutritional information is added later it would be great to be able to turn on or off. Overall I have been really happy!

So far...so good. I am loving using Cara. I love that I can track all sorts of things in one app. To me, it is like journaling. Also, I love that I can just take a picture of what I am eating. AND it’s ad free in the free version. Amazing.

It really does help me understand what is causing me issues. I downloaded it to figure out what foods were causing me trouble - but this app also correlates stress and activity as well as the food! Love it!! Not to mention it’s free with no ads!!
This is only my second day using Cara, so far I’m impressed.  I’ll give a better review once I see all that this app can do for me!  Thank you!

When you export your data to email to share with your doctor the link you get goes to nothing but a blank page. Over a month's worth of data just impossible to share with GI specialist now. Very frustrating.

reviews.t: Good tracker, not good identifying patterns
reviews.b:
As others have noted, the app tries to identify foods on your “best” and “worst” symptom days. The foods it chooses seems random and I have never found the best/worst lists to be helpful. I do a better job myself at figuring out likely triggers. Disappointing because I think a program should be able to do this. Supposedly it gets better the longer you track but after many months I’m not optimistic.

The app also only seems to look at isolated days, which isn’t great if your dinner triggers symptoms that start overnight after midnight (then it assigns the symptoms to the next day and can’t seem to connect them). I try to get around this by entering symptoms for 11:45pm if I think they were triggered by something I ate previous day. Since the app has time data for all meals, it would be nice if it could connect meals & symptoms by time rather than just by day.

The other big issue for me is that it makes you enter enough data to get 140 “points” per day, by tracking food and symptoms. If you don’t get enough points the entire day doesn’t count and the app scolds you and restarts you at 0 for a streak. You can’t go in the next day and add in data for the previous day. It makes you feel bad even if you simply forget to enter dinner. It should be possible to go back and enter data and then have the prior day count as part of a continuous streak.

The 140 point are also difficult for me to meet because I do intermittent fasting. So the app scolds me even though I am tracking everything but simply don’t have enough meals to reach the arbitrary 140 points.

reviews.t: Great App - does exactly what’s needed!
reviews.b: This app has really helped me with tracking my food and correlating it to my symptoms. I am grateful for that! The only thing I beg, is to allow use on more than one device!  I am not permitted to have my personal cell phone at work, and have to use my work phone while I’m there. I downloaded the app on both devices, only to find I had to reverify my account anytime I use a different phone. It’s cumbersome to do that a couple times each day, as I try not to touch my work phone in the evenings. I know this probably applies to very few, but it makes tracking harder and I just don’t understand why that limitation is there. (Please help!) Otherwise, well done and highly recommended!
Love no ads, but sometimes crashes when adding a larger amount of information

reviews.t: Wonderful, but could use more detail on food
reviews.b:
I really like this app so far. It's so user friendly and helpful. The one suggestion I would make is having an option to insert more than one meal at a time and being able to measure amounts of food eaten, ie having one glass of wine vs 5, or eating a little of a certain food vs a lot since that could be helpful for the different foods that individuals are more likely to react to. 
Regardless a very helpful app!

I have Crohn’s (IBD) and this app is awesome! Just what I need to help me track my symptoms and see any correlations between what I eat, my treatment approaches, and how I feel, etc. Amazing this app is free! A big thanks to the developers! You guys are awesome!

reviews.t: You’ll get to the answer with Cara
reviews.b: I can’t think of a reason for this app not to get me where I’m trying to go. It asks questions I didn’t think to ask myself so there’s a complete picture of my duet and guy being formed. Super detailed yet easy to use.

So far for the most part I like the app as it allows me to track a lot of things. I wish it was apparent how to edit times though. And back edit / add information. Maybe the edit option exists maybe it doesn’t. I’ve just started using the app so I am not sure.
This app covers all the bases of what to track and allows you to take notes. I find it very helpful.
I would have given it 5 stars, but you are unable to add holistic supplements like probiotics and so forth into the app for monitoring.  It is very ease to use, and very helpful!
It doesn’t seem to have a list of drinks, e.g. soda, tea, milk, or coffee. Only water, that’s frustrating when trying to keep track of everything and it’s not an option.

reviews.t: Still THE best - ride out the update
reviews.b:
(I changed my review from three to five stars since they’ve been so diligent about taking feedback on the latest update)

Absolutely *the* most comprehensive whole body app around. Yes, the new update has some bugs, and yes, they are working on it. (I’ve sent them extensive screenshots and they’ve replied to my annoyingly detailed messages so kindly)  This is not just for IBS or gastrointestinal issues, my psychiatrist actually recommended it for my bipolar meds and sleep/meal/exercise tracking. If you’re looking for a calorie/quick weight loss fix, this is not for you. If you’re looking for something that will help you improve your overall wellbeing for a lifetime, download this app. Whole health is comprehensive and involves far more than fat/calories, and this app covers it ALL - sleep, skin, physical pain vs mental pain, so many others that I’ve forgotten! You can adjust the lineup as needed in order of most frequently used. I cannot say enough good about Cara, and now include their team in that praise as well. I would easily pay for this the same I do for my Calm app, and it’s FREE and ad free. Download this! No question.

reviews.t: It’s free but it’s worth money.
reviews.b: They thought of everything.

reviews.t: Loved it but now I’m not a big fan
reviews.b: I have to keep a food diary because doctors are trying to figure out what I had. I loved this app because I could track everything! However, the new version doesn’t allow up to print a PDF which is what I need since I see so many docs and not all of them will accept the email link. So I guess I have to find a new app ☹️
I just started using this app and it really is amazing!!! I am working with my MD to figure out my issues/diet and this allows me to track everything so easily!!!

Just started using the app and so far it’s great! Love that it’s so detailed on each aspect of IBS.  As it says the longer you use it the more helpful it will be, and I think their right.  Will follow up further along i get.

I’ve tried a few of these kind of apps, but rarely even opened it a second time. So far I’m 3 days in and making multiple entries a day! I’m not certain what makes the difference but as an adult with autism this one just clicks so far.

reviews.t: Exactly what I was looking for
reviews.b: I was looking for something to easily track my stomach symptoms and this is great. The only problem I have is there isn't a graph or tracker for stomach acidity/acid reflux. There's only a tag added onto bloating and I don't see a chart that shows when I had that symptom.

The app is not working. When selecting my health issues I could hardly see the options. Once I got through that and to my dashboard it would not let me select anything. I have a iPhone 7 with up to dat OS.  Got to delete and reinstall. Hope I can get it to work. I really need help and this sound perfect for what Dr wants me to do for tracking.

I like the idea of this app, but the food database is weak. It’s necessary to enter the ingredients for everything you eat. It doesn’t even have a database of common foods like breakfast cereals. So you have to read the ingredient list and enter each one. As a result, I gave up using it because it’s too much trouble.
Started using Cara a little over a week ago and it’s helping me be mindful about my food choices. I love that it helps me correlate and see patterns with my food choices, moods, and digestive issues
The best tracking app I’ve come across. Highly recommend!

The first time around using this I wasn’t thrilled and didn’t stick with it. I wasn’t expecting the app to function the way it does so I ended up deleting my account.

This time I’ve got a clear goal in mind, make my tummy happy. It’s nice to be able to see what foods I’m eating and how I’m reacting to them. Other apps focus more on nutrients and calorie intake when it comes to food tracking so this is nice, I’m not trying to diet or bulk up or anything so inputing all of that information was always an extra task that I no longer have to deal with.

I love using this app to track my food and symptoms. I configure notifications to remind me to enter my foods. Recently, the marketing team has been abusing the notifications being enabled to push their videos and blog posts. There is no way to disable these notifications without disabling all notifications and when I reached out to their support, I never got a reply.

This app recently got updated, and unfortunately it made it significantly worse 
:(
Now it’s very slow and glitchy when you are typing something in...and if you type a food in the title of the meal name, it no longer automatically populates any of your ingredients whereas it did before. I’m not sure what was supposedly improved with the update, but both my husband and I agree that it’s way harder to use now. Please fix. 
Thank you!!
I tend to eat snacks, not meals. There is no quick way to just enter a banana or 1/4 cup of mixed nuts. Too frustrating.

After a recent update my ability to share my data with my nutritionist was made impossible.  I contacted CARA 3 times over 10 ten days without any response .  Without the ability to interact with my nutritionist this app is useless.

No introduction on how to use it. Doesn’t save entries. Freezes your phone!! Help center doesn’t work. My email was “in use” but I’ve never used it on this app before and can’t talk to anyone about that. Waste of time.

reviews.t: Was great - now needs some work.
reviews.b: I loved using this app. It’s a great way to track my symptoms and then analyze the data to find my stressors. I’m really disappointed with the update. Their new dashboard is too basic. It’s basically only a JavaScript landing page - there are no other pages within the website. They also took away the option to export my data to a PDF which my nutritionist and I find very disappointing. Hoping to see them make changes soon.

I dislike that the foods you eat at the end of the day are linked with symptoms that you had at the beginning of the day. I wish there were a feature to link bloating directly after a meal, since this is a symptom that appears right after a meal. This is the change I would most like to see.

This app doesn’t track food eaten with stool consistency. The only data collected on stool is the percentage of a consistency compared to stool overall.

I don’t like how the home page sorts trigger foods alphabetically. I liked the old format where they were sorted by the strength of the data. I wish there were a setting to change this.

reviews.t: Not as good since the update
reviews.b: Can't go straight to the entry screen through 3D Touch anymore, the ingredients no longer auto-populate, and the app just feels clunkier and less responsive in general.

I’ve had GI issues for a while and have been looking for a good, free and easy app to navigate, and this app is more than I could have ever ask for! It’s great for keeping track of your day-to-day and creates correlation graphs which are SUPER helpful! Would 100% recommend and I really hope it stays free cause it’s great!

Cara is a decent app, but they screwed up some things that were working fine. For example, now when you open up sleep tracking or poop tracking, you have to scroll side to side to find all of the various options. Previously you were able to see all the options vertically in your phone, so it was easy to simply tap them—no scrolling required. Why the app designers decided that adding a step would be a good thing, I have no idea, but they were wrong!

Also, previously when logging meals, when you typed in the title of your meal the app would guess which foods were included in your meal and prepopulate your entry with those foods. Usually it wasn’t 100% correct, but it was handy to not have to retype in all the foods you’d just typed into the title field.

Since the update, this function has disappeared. Very annoying! Now if you type in “Chicken with rice” to the title field, you will have to type “chicken” and “rice” AGAIN to log them as foods contained in the meal. Stupid. Why did they remove a feature that was basically working?

The other thing that’s lacking on this app is the ability to visualize and search back to see when certain symptoms started or stopped. 

It lets you log, but it’s lacking in the ability to actually do much with the data. 

Still, it’s a free app. If they upped their game I’d be willing to pay for a more robust feature set (and fewer stupid features).
Cara stopped working - perhaps corrupted- so data not updating. All the info I’ve entered in the last 4 weeks is gone. What a waste of time.

reviews.t: Fantastic for GERD, IBS, psych disorders
reviews.b:
Honestly, this app is ridiculously good. I’ve never written an app review before.. that’s how good this app is. Some of the UI could use a little work but the developers are clearly listening to suggestions and improving things (had a new update today!). Has really helped me track what I WANT to track, rather than being forced by an app to track calories when I list foods. Leaves a lot of room for personalization. No ads, no cost. I enjoy this app enough that I would happily pay for it.

Works well as a mood tracker too for depression, anxiety, BPD if you don’t want to go into incredible detail about mood and just want to see how your lifestyle choices impact mood.
10/10/2019 - How long is the data restore supposed to take? I’ve received this notice for a few days now.

I use this app all the time. I don’t mind the new upgrade but I don’t know if I actually like it on its side. Also, there are duplicates and when I try to edit them I can’t scroll down. Please fix this. Other that that I really like this app.

The idea is great but the user experience is not so much. As an example, when you try to enter a food the keyboard just covers half the screen without adjust to make things fit, so that you cannot see what is going on and often can’t find the thing you need. There is no way to remove the keyboard once it is open.

I loved this app and found it super useful for tracking my symptoms. With the new update, it has become buggy and impossible to see any real trends since it shows the same foods on good and bad days. I really don’t like using it anymore after the latest update and will be switching to another app

This app is great! I haven’t been feeling great and needed a way to keep a food journal, but this is so much more! It’s so helpful to be able to track food and then mood and pain associated with eating. The only thing that could be better is if there were a Notes section to add a little more information for tracking purposes.
